reviews.text: This is my third rental! and just like the other it did not disappoint! Beautiful color and shape. I received so many compliments in this dress. I usually wear a size 8 but the 6 fit great and I was able to go without a bra which is rare because I'm a 32 DDD. The fabric stretches a little bit which helped in the hip area. I felt amazing in this dress and would recommend to anyone, the quality of the fabric is great!

Gorgeous color, unique cut This dress is very body hugging and there isn't much give in the fabric. It looked great and the solid color meant I was able to wear a patterned shoe. I got many compliments.
It runs really small. A girl with curves, bigger than a size 8 will hardly fit it. I squeeze in it. Tight. But it is a nice dress.
The color was great for an outdoor summer wedding. It was  very good - felt very slimming. Definitely had to go for the bigger size tho!

This dress was PERFECTION!!  I absolutely LOVED this dress!!  I ordered it for a welcome reception and it was so comfortable, stylish, and easy to move in when the impromptu dancing started! I am usually a size 0/2 depending on the brand and the size 2 fit me like a glove! I got so many compliments and the color is gorgeous!
Gorgeous color, comfortable thick fabric. Compliments all night. Runs small, wish I had a 6. Felt at times I was constantly pulling it down. Still great and wish I owned this dress.

Loved the Color! I just loved this dress! I received compliments all night! The dress was very forgiving and hugged my curves. As the other reviewers have mentioned, this dress does run small. I settled for the 8 because the 10 was unavailable, but I definitely recommend renting a size up.
Great dress - very sexy yet not too fancy/revealing. Fit was OK on the size 6 but still a tad tight. I'm normally a size 4. Definitely order a size up as a backup.

Beautiful dress that fit like a glove. RTR was a great experience  I usually wear a size 2 or 4 but this runs slightly small. The 4 fit but was snug across the hips which is not comfy for dancing at a wedding so I went with the size 6. Color was a little more purple than expected but still beautiful. You could tell this was an expensive dress because of the fabric. Couldn't see my stick on bra or undies underneath. My only complaint was that the paint was rubbed off of the zipper which I'm sure happens with continued wear. My hair covered it but may not be suitable for someone with short hair.
Great dress, perfect for a summer wedding! Fit nicely, thicker material.

Fun color, unique neckline, and very comfortable! I usually like my form fitting, so this lil number was perfect.  It had just enough give to it, so I had no trouble dancing, or sitting down and eating :), but not so much that it didn't keep its shape.  I'm 3 months preggo so I assume that's why I wore the 6 and not the 4.  Thank goodness for safety sizes!
Derby Dress! Wore this to the kentucky derby! Not my absolute favorite fit by this designer but still got a ton of compliments, love E & J.
Runs small This was my back-up dress and I'm glad my primary dress fit!  This dress was really small, especially around the bust.  No stretch at all.

The dress was great. I loved it.  It is definitely form fitting. I wish I had gotten a size 4 instead of a 2 knowing I was going to be eating and drinking all night. The color was absolutely amazing.  I wore it for a wedding in the beginning of October. It was a barn wedding mostly outside. I received a ton of compliments on the color. I would highly recommend this dress.
This was the perfect dress for a spring/summer wedding. I got so many compliments! Stunning color! Definitely cannot wear Spanx with it! :/ But luckily the dress is so flattering I didn't need it!

Great Spring/Summer dress! Highly recommend. Loved this dress and so did everyone else... I had so many compliments on it! The material is stretchy and comfortable, but very thick which I think causes the fit to run a little small. I'm usually a size 4 in dresses, but I felt more comfortable in the size 6.
It was a friend's wedding. I am glad I got the size 6.  The 4 fit fine in most places, but I have a wider back and it was a little snug there.  The color really stood out.

I really did love this dress, the only complaint I have is that it is really tight in the bust area. I got many compliments on this dress, it fit perfectly, except for being tight in the bust - I am a 36D, so it may not be a problem for everyone. I am also broad throughout the back and shoulders so I had to go with the 8 rather than the 6 because it was just too tight across the chest.  The color was not quite as pink as the picture, but it is still a beautiful color. I was able to dance all night in this dress for my 40th birthday and the quality and feel of the fabric was very luxurious!

Perfect hourglass shape I wore this for my wedding rehearsal dinner. The color is so bright and different. Since the material is quite thick, it gives you a great hourglass figure! The cut around the neck is very different and looks great, as well as, the uneven hem on the bottom. Would 100% rent again!
Snug & Gorgeous Thick material makes it not so revealing despite the snug fit. Definitely go one size up if not 2 sizes up.

Transitionable, flattering fit, beautiful color This dress was surprisingly flexible for work (throw on a black blazer) and evening. The color is intense and eye-catching, works greats with black stockings and angle boots. The racer back is a sexy touch. Fabric is stretchy but holds up to structure, so it helps create that flat stomach look. Runs slightly small, so I went one size up, especially since I was wearing it to work in the daytime.

It was perfect for a fall wedding; the color was strong but not out of place at an outdoor function. The fabric is thick and has some stretch, so I found it forgiving and form fitting.  Find some seamless undergarments!  A strapless bra worked well for me.
Loved this dress!  Very form fitting but flattering.   Considered purchasing this dress!  Love it so much!

I loved the fit of this dress! It was so flattering and the color was eye catching! I absolutely loved this dress and received compliments all night long. I usually wear a 0 and sometimes a 2. I read other reviews and decided to order a 2 with a 4 for backup. I ended up wearing the 2 and it fit perfectly. I paired it with Slate and Willow Smoky Stud Earrings and nude strappy sandals. The dresses arrived a day late and they were soaking wet due to a Thunderstorm somewhere in route here. I immediately contacted RTR  and they shipped two more to me overnight. They were here in time for the event. So pleased with this experience and that RTR did everything to make it right.
Great dress for an outdoor wedding! Great color, very flattering cut but as everyone else says, size up! I am a true 4 but the 4 fit like a tiny 2. Glad I ordered the 6 as backup!
BEAUTIFUL DRESS THIS BRAND NEVER DISAPPOINTS. FELT AMAZING AND GOT LOTS OF COMPLIMENTS. LOVED THE COLOR. VERY COMFORTABLE.

Perfect dress for a wedding. The dress is beautiful and the unique neckline and bottom make it stand out.  I normally wear a 4 or 6 and after reading reviews ordered a 6 and 8.  I ended up wearing the 8 and honestly could have gone with a 10.  I have a larger butt and thighs and this dress was pretty tight in my legs and rode up my legs when I walked.  Definitely worth the rental, but order at least 1 size up, maybe 2.

Sex Appeal, Class, & Eye Catching Color! Let's be real, I had some help from my good friend, Spanx, but this dress is a bombshell!  It's tight as tight can be, but the fabric quality is great & you don't feel like you can see every lump, bump, & line.  It shows off your figure, but the high neckline and just above-the-knee length makes it appropriate for a family affair!  I used to be worried that the cut near the armpits would highlight those lovely fat pockets, or "my pudgies," as my mom refers to hers, but somehow it doesn't.  Or, at least I didn't think it did.  I would highly recommend!

Color was perfect for a summer wedding. Wore a size up.  Comfortable to dance in. I am usually a size 0, but I wore the 2. The 2 fit me perfectly.  I received many compliments at the wedding I attended.  I was able to dance comfortably the whole night. I would definitely recommend this dress...just make sure you get a backup size bigger than your usual.

Beautiful Dress This was a beautiful dress. However it ran very small. I usually wear a 0-2 and JUST squeezed myself into the 4. Even though the dress was tight on me, it was surprisingly still really flattering. Great material!

An friend from high school told me I looked hot.  A compliment from another fashionista is the best! Pros:  The fabic is nice and thick, yet has some good stretch to it.  I was able to dance all night.  The style is a fun twist of the typical bodycon dress, which makes it fun.  The color is great too!

Cons:  This dress runs small, very small.  I usually wear a 4-6, but knowing it was a bodycon I ordered the 6.  All reviews said tot size up, so my backup was an 8.  I should have went for the 8 and 10!  The 8 fit but was a little tighter than I prefer.  Size up for sure!

Sexy, classy, comfortable  This dress is absolutely stunning - incredibly flattering and sexy but still very classy, and in an unusual and eye-catching color that works for any season. Beware that it runs extremely small (I am usually a 0-2 in dresses and the 4 was tight on me).

Amazing fit. Rich color. Great hem detail. This is a beautiful but tight dress.
Wore it with nude pumps.
Strapless bra recommended.
Perfect dress for the occasion, wore it to a yacht party for a destination wedding weekend! Vibrant color, material is very rich, very fitted but fit like a glove! So many compliments!
Wasn't able to wear this.  I was unable to wear this as it was WAY too tight.

Fun and Flattering! This dress was comfortable, conservative but trendy. Beautiful color too! The inside liner was a bit tight, but the outside layer was a little more loose so it hid how tight it felt. Overall super cute and great quality.

Stylish and comfortable I'm glad that I read the previous reviews. The dress does run really small. I typically wear a 0 or a 2 but I had to wear a 4. It fit really well and I got compliments all evening. Great choice!
Color and material were great Not too short for my height !

Beautiful color and material! LOVED wearing this. . . After reading the reviews, definitely sized up and I'm glad.  Usually wear a 4 or a 6. . . never an 8.  I followed the advice of contributors and ordered the 6 and 8.  GLAD i did.  Wore the 8.  It was a beautiful dress and fit.  Very classy, but sexy and the color is beautiful.  Wish it was still hanging in my closet.
Dress looked great and everyone loved it.   Very form fitting and flattering.  Def will need a size up, especially if you want to dance.  The dress can ride up a little when dancing.
Great color and fit! Looked great with nude pumps. Great dress for a dinner date with the hubby!  The fit was amazing and will definitely order again!

Received so many compliments!  This dress was wonderful! It is definitely form fitting but has a nice stretch! I am 116 lbs, 5'4, and range between a size 0-2. I have a smaller bust in comparison to my hips. If you get a back up size, it should definitely be a size up. Would highly recommend!
Great Color - Easy to dance in all night! The dress fit true to size, it was a great color for a summer wedding. It also has some stretch to it, so I was able to dance all night!
Body-hugging with a unique cut Fun bold color. Body-hugging and very flattering. Wore this to a work holiday party. Definitely recommend!

GORGEOUS! I felt like a million bucks in this dress! It was perfect- top to bottom. I love the neckline, the length, the exposed shoulders and the asymmetrical hem. Sassy and fun, but covered up top and long enough to be tasteful. Sophisticated and sexy is how I would describe this gorgeous dress. I paired with gold dangly earrings and a pair of show-stopping heels. I could absolutely kick myself for not getting a SINGLE picture of me in this dress- I never wanted to take it off! Accidentally spilled a bit of my drink on the hem (mountain dew & vodka) and while it did look wet for a bit, once it dried there was no staining and no one was the wiser. The material was just thick enough to smooth everything out and hide any lines caused by bras or underpants. Dress definitely runs small- I usually wear a 0 or 2 but the 4 was the first one I tried on out of the bag and it was perfect- didn't even try the 2 on. 
I HIGHLY recommend this rental!!

SO perfect. I want to BUY this dress it was so perfect.  Someone else rented the dress and wore it for the rehearsal dinner, but with the help of a statement piece...we both got to wear it and it wasn't obvious!
Runs too tight so doesn't look great Size up! I got this in my size and while it fit it looked tight in my opinion. Very pretty color though.

Worked perfectly for a rehearsal dinner. Lots of compliments on the color and cut! Super tight! I went up one size and still snug. But the material was thick and comfortable showing off curves in a flattering way.

Loved this dress so much; was super comfortable! This dress was so comfortable and fit great, though I did wear a size up than I normally wear. Received lots of compliments at the wedding I wore it to. Really wish I owned this dress!! Definitely recommend for any dressy occasion, you will feel great in it!
Great dress!  I really liked the dress and so did my boyfriend. I wore it to a dinner party.

Beautiful fit and color! I wore this to dinner in Vegas and it looked great! I ordered a size up based on previous reviews but I would say this is truer to size rather than super small. The 2 was form fitting but still had some give at the arms and back. A 0 would have fit tighter but not unflattering. I would take what event you're wearing it to into consideration since the loser fit is obviously less provocative a look. The top is fitted enough that I didn't really need a bra. I tried it w/ a strapless bra which fit but the padding kind of ruined the lines of the style for me.
Great dress really enjoyed it. It was a tight dress so be prepared for that. Summer wedding was my event and it was a great color for that time of year.
I LOVE this dress - I got a TON of compliments. It is does small and fit tight! I would suggest ordering a size up! I wish I could have kept this dress :)

Bold Color - Show Stopper! I received many compliments in this dress! It does run a bit small so I would recommend bumping up a size. I usually wear a 2 and went with a 4 based on other reviews I ready. Overall - great dress! Would definitely recommend!

Work cocktail party - dress was perfect! This dress is gorgeous! Beautiful color and good, thick material. The only thing I would say is that it runs a bit on the small side and the material is not forgiving if it's too small. I usually wear a 2 or 4 (32 C cup, 26" waist), but ordered a 6 based on other reviews. I'm glad I did because it fit just right! Would highly recommend :)
Great dress, great color! Great dress, great color! Does run small, I ordered a size up like most other reviewers recommended.
Comfortable, easy and looks fantastic I'm typically a size 6, and this fit perfectly. The color was fantastic - unique but not loud. Couldn't have been more perfect for the occasion.
form fitting, flattering cut, great option for slim and tall body type with smaller chest !   comfortable material
Gorgeous! Got tons of compliments.   Fit great.  I am 5' 2" so it was an inch or two longer than I would have liked.  Fabric is high end.
The color was amazing. The fit was slight tight, runs small. Got compliments all night. I Loved it! Runs small.

Everyone was raving about the dress, I rented it for my 30th Birthday! It was snug in all the right places, covered up problem areas, and is definitely a dress that commands your attention. The perfect 30th birthday dress!

Super Cute Party Dress I got both the medium and the large, thinking I would wear the large and the medium would be a back up.  You never know, miracles do happen.  Oddly enough, although the medium was a bit tight, it looked much better than the large did.  The large had plenty of room, but ended up making me look heavier than I am.  Anyway, I wore it to a law school party.  It was stretchy enough to dance comfortably in, and I felt fun in it.  Perfect for a cocktail party or night out dancing.

This dress was a perfect choice for a black tie fundraiser. I got so many compliments! As others have noted, the side zipper is a challenge! Once I was actually zipped into it, the dress is very comfortable.  The sleeves are very narrow so if you have larger arms it might be a challenge. I was glad I could wear my regular bra-I did end up pinning my bra to the shoulders of the dress as the top seemed a bit stretched out from previous wearers.  The length was great-showed off my legs and hugged me in all the right places without being too revealing. The venue of my event is always cold so having sleeves was perfect.  I would definitely rent this dress again!
(It's my cousin) Great, comfortable dress to wear for my sister's 21st bday in Vegas! Super comfortable and fabulous!

Not my favorite, but still a crowd pleaser! It was a little loose.  I'm flat chested, but I have a big ol' booty (and I didn't think this dress would have much give) so I ordered a "M".  I wasn't able to get the safety "S" I wanted. I'm 3 months pregnant so I figure I'd want a little room.  Not the case. "S" would have been perfect. *Also, it was a little itchy, but that's normal with an all-sequin dress. This dress is ideal for a medium-tall height, hour-glass body. Order a SMALLER safety size.

didn't work out! i rented this dress for a wedding.  I'm pear-shaped and got the large but it was way too big in the shoulders...which make me look larger.  it was also extremely scratchy from the sequins.  just by taking it off, it left a big scratch mark on my hand...glad i didn't wear it.  Fortunately, RTR overnighted me a replacement dress that ended up working great.

Loved this dress, I wore it to my husband's company Christmas party and it was perfect!  This fit true to size, the rousching on the sides made this very flattering, I thought the length was appropriate and it was very comfortable. My only complaint was that my hair kept getting caught in the sequins. Overall a great dress!

Gorgeous dress and I received lots of compliments on it! Hugs the body pretty tight, but the rouching in it covered up any flaws. It was a little long on me, but I'm only 5'2''. The shoulders also were a little lopsided and kept falling off to the side, so it appeared somewhat asymmetric. Overall, I was very happy with it. It was stunning and great for a night out!

I got so many compliments on this dress. Plain enough, with just the right amount of sparkle! I have a booty and thighs, so I needed a dress that would fit my pear shape. The small amount of stretch was perfect. The only con is I am a small on top, but needed the medium for my bottom half, therefore, I had to keep pulling up the sleeve as it slid off my shoulder at times.  I was a little worried about the length being too short, but it hit me mid thigh and it was perfect! I highly recommend this dress!

This dress was comfortable and looked great! This dress is perfect if you have an hourglass figure. If you have a large chest like me, you can wear a good supportive bra which is such a plus. The dress looked great and was very comfortable all night.
Loved this dress! Great fit and shape-true to size!

Sexy little number! I was 2.5 months post partum and had a winter wedding to attend. This dress had some stretch to it and the sequins offer some forgiveness in the tummy area. I think the dress is on the runs small/true to size end. It's very short - I am 5'2 and it was mid-thigh on me.

A Head-Turner! This dress was INCREDIBLE and perfect for my company holiday party.  It was actually my back-up dress that was shipped overnight because another dress was too large.  RTR was extremely accommodating and sent me this stunner in under 24 hours.  I wore the dress in a medium and it was the perfect balance between hip-hugging but still had some stretch for dancing.  I received a million compliments and will definitely order this dress again!

Perfect Bachelorette Dress - If you want to be the center of attention, this is your dress!  I rented this dress for my Bachelorette party. Definitely get a size up as a backup. My arms wouldn't even fit in the large. At first I was a little uncomfortable because although the XL fit in my arms and up top, it was a bit loose around the middle. However, I got compliments all night and seeing the photos, I'm really happy I went with this dress. Sexy and warm enough for a fall Bachelorette party, but not too short. I do RTR for most special occasions and have never been disappointed!

Spectacular dress! Elegant, sexy, well constructed, figure flattering & hugs in all the right places I reserved a M and L because I have an hourglass figure and hate when clothes pull and span across my hips or chest.  I tried on both sizes and they were equally tricky to get on.  It definitely takes time and patience.  Thought I would be a large, and started there, but once it was zippered it looked baggy in the bodice, too wide in the shoulders, and a tad too long.  The M fit like it was custom fitted to my measurements without being tight.  Honestly, I expected a beautiful dress, but this experience exceeded all of my expectations.  The dress was elegant and had good structure to it, but at the same time it was extremely comfortable to sit, move and dance in all night long.  My husband LOVED it and I received compliments from friends and strangers all night long.  

I looked at photos of this dress from many other reviewers to decide on how to style it.  I rented the Kenneth Jay Lane Melissa Necklace and the Slate + Willow Crystal Direction Drop Earrings (which honestly looked like a set).  I wore jet black hose and simple black pumps.

This was my very first RTR experience and I will definitely be doing it again.  Thanks for making this mom feel like a million dollar diamond.  I will be back!

I wore this dress for my Anniversary my husband loved this dress on me! The dress fit great hugs u in all the right places and can hide worrisome areas like your tummy!  This dress was awesome I felt do beautiful in in and received tons of compliments! Loved the fit and the look of the dress on me no cons on this one ladies. Rent it!

I love a little black dress, add some sparkle to it- perfect. Wore it for my 30th birthday weekend. very comfortable dress. the material is forgiving and will stretch if need be. Perfect length, nice v neck

Super fun and perfect for a bachelorette party I am attending my future sister in law's bachelorette party this weekend and it is glitz and glam themed. This dress is perfect for the event! It is very cute and slimming. I like it because it is not super revealing but is still a fun, flirty, and sexy style! I will upload a picture after the weekend!

Cute dress Definitely runs on the smaller side of true to size. I'm between a Small and a Medium, and I was able to get the Small on, but it was very tight. Maybe I would have worn it for a night out in Vegas, but I was going to a work cocktail party so I went with the Medium. Also, it gave a me a very mild rash on my arms from the sequins. This sounds like more of a problem than it was, but it's something to consider if you have sensitive skin. Very comfortable otherwise. I didn't worry about anything accidentally being exposed .

It was my grandmother's 80th bday and this dress was hit. Received many compliments and I loved it.. I was concerned that the dress would run small but it was true to size.  It fit me very well. I received many compliments about it. I definitely don't regret renting it.  The only bad thing... the sequins kept snagging my hair and taking the dress off was a struggle.

Back-up Dress  I ended up not wearing this dress due to how tight it fit. I knew I was pushing the XL limit and feared I'd spend the night feeling like I was going to rip it or actually rip it. I fit into it, but I felt the dress was 1. too tight 2. the sleeves were itchy 3. the dress was too short and kept riding up. Beautiful design and make, but it just wasn't for me.

Beautiful dress, runs small. I ordered this dress for a Christmas party. Ended up wearing my back up as this was a very tight dress (even with Spanx) and I was not comfortable in it. I wanted it to work because it's beautiful and sexy. A flattering dress for many body types.

This is a wow dress !   Amazing dress, I didn't end up wearing this one to our party.  But it was beautiful.   My original order had another dress that was my first choice.  It didn't fit , I called RTR and they sent me another choice of dress for a small additional fee.    The fit was awesome, even went over my large bust with no issue.   Only downside is you will need someone to help you out of this one.    The zipper is kinda hard to reach.

Perfect party dress!  I received compliments all night wearing this dress. No one would have imagine the price I rented it at! I'm not a small girl and this dress fit perfectly. For a mom who doesn't get many chances to dress up this dress really made my night!

Not too short little black dress I was modestly surprised. Dress is not as short as it seems in the photo. Standing up, if you pull the dress all the way down, it reaches the top of your knees. And sitting down, its only about 5-6" from the knee. So it is very appropriate even for an event with grandma. The wide open top still gives it a sexy flair. Only con is dress is a bit scratchy and itchy, even with the liner inside the dress.

Was a fun dress to wear! Was very slimming and simple to wear! Was very comfortable. Long sleeves were perfect for a cool night. Sleeves were a little tight at forts but are stretchy.  I wore nylons with dress and by the end of the night sequence and torn up nylons, wish I had brought a second pair to change into.

I wore this to a bachelorette party and it was a major hit! Several compliments from strangers! lol The fit is a bit snug. Definitely wear some shapewear underneath as it clings a bit. Other than that, it was a GREAT DRESS!!

Stage appearance and event! This dress was really difficult to get on and get situated but one on, it was beautiful! I had tons of compliments on how great it was! I ended up going with the larger backup size because it was comfortable. The smaller may have worked once it was on but it didn't think I would be able to get it on correctly!

LOVE, LOVE, LOVE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
 Beautiful color, great shape for hourglass body type. Will rent again

Loved it, would rent again!! The overall fit was amazing. Fit every curve of my body and it even fit my 36DD boobs. I know i was shocked too. I would recommend a little help on the side zipper as that was the only struggle for me. Other than that thumbs up for this dress and i would deff rent it again.

SHOW STOPPER!!!  Got compliments on this dress all night!  Perfect party/wedding/cocktail dress! Love, love, LOVED!!!!!  The material has the perfect amount of stretch to it.  I felt comfortable eating, dancing and drinking all night long!  Sexy but not trashy.  Other reviews say it is tough to get into the dress and zipper it.  For me the dress was easy to get into and I had no problem with the zipper.  The length was perfect.  It hit me from right above the knee to mid thigh.  But on a shorter person it might be a little long.  I had no problem keeping the girls in and I'm a 36 DDD.  The dress is almost a no-shoulder look and I can't wear a strapless bra.  So I safety pinned my bra straps to the dress and you couldn't even tell.  I so wish I could keep this dress because I felt like a movie star in it!

The sparkle in this dress is amazing! Perfect for date night or a special cocktail event. This dress is true to size and fits like a glove! I wore it out for date night with my husband and he loved it! No complaints about this dress at all. I loved it!

I felt like I lit up the night I loved the fit. The xl was surprisingly tight in the forearms, which is not normally a problem for me so I went a size up. I loved the fabric and received a ton of complements. I was able to move around very easily.
I didn't wear it! This dress runs SUPER small.  Very difficult to put on! Too bad it was really cute.

I was a sparkly disco princess! The only issue was that I had to be careful with snagging my Diana Ross wig. It was sparkly and beautiful-I was videotaped and it was perfection. Not too short. I wanted to buy the dress.

This flattering, sparkly dress gave me an extra boost of confidence and glam for my 30th bday bash! I felt like the belle of the ball in this knockout dress! The dress was snug in all the right places and could easily zip up (the zipper is hidden on the side). The v-neck is deeper than what I would normally wear but my friends thought it was flattering, sexy, and still classy.  The material is thick and has more stretch in the torso than it does in the arms (they were snug) but the sleeves weren't too short.  I didn't have much trouble with the sequins snagging aside from when I initially pulled the dress over my head. I wore normal underclothes, nude heels, and shiny gold earrings. It was perfect and I felt like a star!

I got so many compliments on this dress! My first RTR experience so I was nervous but I loved it!  The dress was a good length and could be scrunched up to be shorter or pulled down to be longer. I'm small up top but have thick thighs and a booty so I was hesitant about the fit. The large fit perfectly, definitely ran TTS. Beautiful dress for my sorority semi formal overall and will definitely rent again!
Dress looked great - sequins were very elegant! The dress had alot of material around the waist bc of the ruching -- if you are small waisted, something to be mindful of.

I received so many compliments on this dress, it really was the perfect holiday party dress. Dress fit great!! I am SO glad I went with the medium as the small was a little too snug in the top. RTR made this process so easy and I will for sure be renting again!!

I wore this dress to a Gatsby themed birthday party.  It worked out great.  I dressed it up with jewelry, a headband and the right shoes and it was a hit.  It is very comfortable and versatile.  It is runched through the bodice which makes it figure flattering.  I tried the large first but it was very tight in the bust and I ended up wearing the x-large.  The sequins did get caught in my hair pulling it on and off, but the tips to look for the hidden side zipper were very helpful.  It ended up being a little warm inside the event and I had some difficulty pulling the sleeves up as they fit pretty snug.  Overall, I would definitely rent this again.

Nice party dress This dress was nice and I liked the fit.  The dress sent to me definitely showed signs of wear... like an unraveled hem and the ruching had been ripped a bit.  Overall it was fine but I wish the dress I had gotten hadn't so aggressively used by other renters.

Great for a fancy DC engagement party It fit well, but some of the hems were starting to fall.  I pinned up one side with a safety pin and was satisfied with the silhouette. As a curvy individual (36G), I was a bit uncomfortable with the amount of cleavage showing, however, that wasn't a surprise since many of the pictures warned me that would be the case.  It was easy to put one (carefully) and I thought the sleeves were comfortable. No issues with overheating or needing to readjust the hemline throughout the event.  8/10 Will gladly rent from this business again.

I wore this to a campus ministry fundraiser for my church. It was the perfect length. I felt dumb, but I was in a hurry putting the dress on and didn't see the hidden side zipper. Had I used the zipper I could has worn the large size I ordered as the back up. Because of my error, the dress felt a little big but still very comfortable and I felt confident. The length was perfect (right above my knee and I'm 5'3). It has side ruching  which provided a wonderful silhouette. I loved the long sleeves as well because I am very self conscious of my arms and this dress helped my confidence without feeling frumpy. I would definitely recommend this dress and may rent it again. It was wonderful! Thank you RTR!
I got so many compliments and i felt amazing. it fit my curves perfectly and made me look thinner than I am.

Great dress! Sexy but classy! I wore this for a wedding. I ordered the Med and Lg. and wound up wearing the Med.  It is a little hard to get on and off (as others said) but it's manageable with the side zipper.  I felt so good in this dress and I could wear a regular bra too.  I received so many compliments! Would definitely rent again!

Incredible dress!  Felt like a million bucks! This dress was perfect for the formal cocktail party.  I felt super sexy wearing this dress!  It holds everything in just the right place.  Very flattering for an athletic build with a mommy tummy.

Pros:
Dress hugged all the right places and was warm enough for a November event.

Cons:
As others noted, it was hard to get on.  I rubbed a little dove soap over the zipper, which worked like a charm.  Once it was on, it fit like a glove!

I got so many compliments and the dress was so sparkly. It was perfect! I ended up going with my backup size XL instead of the L, simply because the fit was a little more comfortable and the XL dress looked newer than the L dress. The sleeves were slightly longer than I would have liked, but it wasn't a big deal. The fit was absolutely perfect - the ruching in the middle was great.

Runway Status in a Snow Storm I rented this dress in the small and medium.  I definitely should have worn the small but I went with the medium because I thought the small was "too small" for me.  I've recently lost some weight so I am not really used to being able to fit in a small.  Anyway, I wore the medium and it still looked great.  The dress is very comfortable.  The zipper is on the side.  Be careful getting in the dress...you may want to have some help because it is delicate.  Also, I've worn one of these sparkle dresses before and I always forget about the long hair issue.  If you are thinking you are going to wear these kinds of dresses with along flowing hair...forget it.  Your hair will be getting caught in the sequens all night long.  It's very annoying.  If you're renting this...TOTAL up-do kind of dress.  

When I review I usually capture my whole look and upload pictures.  However, on this night...there was a huge snow storm and I looked great for all of 5 minutes.  I didn't get to enjoy the dress as much as I wanted to so I am definitely going to rent this one again and upload pics then. 

This dress is a great find.  I totally recommend this dress...even for girls with a big bust!

I absolutely loved this dress and received many compliments throughout the night.  I felt amazing!!! The dress fit true to size.  I did wear spanx underneath and it was still comfortable.  I was able to dance without worrying about the dress being to short or too tight.  This was my first time renting and it was a great experience.  I will definitely do it again.

I wore this to a Justin Bieber Concert and it made me feel great! I'm actually a 38DDD bust and this dress did not allow everything to all hang out.  I tend to want to wear clothing that is too large, I don't like my imperfections showing, however the ruching on this dress made me look flawless.  Personally I wish the dress was shorter.  On taller people it probably is, however for me it fell mid thigh.
Flattering dress, not curls friendly Flattering fit, but my curly hair kept getting tangled in the sequins so I did not wear it. 5'1, 170 lbs, hourglass figure.

The dress is beautiful and comfortable.   It was a bit big at the shoulders, so perhaps the next size down might have been a better fit.  After about 2 hours the dress edges/sequins did become a bit itchy.
Gorgeous! I loved everything about this dress! It fit like a glove and was perfect for my friends little black dress themed bachelorette party.  Not only was it gorgeous, it was also comfortable.

This was a great dress for my growing belly.  I was 20 weeks pregnant in this picture. Fit is true to size.  My only complaint was that the v neck cut was a little low for me.  I felt I was having to adjust the dress all evening.

Fantastic! This was the first time that I rented from here. I was very excited but also quite nervous. I actually ordered two dresses in case I did not like one. I ended up wearing this one to a reception. It was absolutely perfect!! I got so many compliments on the dress and I couldn't help but brag that I had rented it! The fit was true to size. Some of the comments I read before I ordered said it was kind of low cut. I did not have any problems with that at all. I think this was attributed to my large 36DD bust size that took up most of the material! The only thing I tweaked on the dress was that I pinned the bottom up a little bit to make it a tad shorter. The length was good but just a little to modest for my personal likes. But I took the advice from another renter and pinned it. Worked like a charm. I will definitely be renting again!!!

Awkward fit and very little stretch in arms I was not pleased with this dress. Some parts of the dress are stretchy, but others (like the arms) have no stretch in them at all, making it difficult to even bend your arm (and I do not have thick arms). Also, it says on the main page for this dress to size down and I would highly recommend to size up. I believe it runs small and again...not much stretching. Overall, I wasn't impressed and ended up getting a completely different dress sent as a replacement that worked much better.

Great sexy dress for a formal event I received many compliments on this dress and this was a win for my first rental.  I am 5'10 so the dress was shorter than I thought it would be, but I didn't mind showing off my legs.  As for the fit, the arms were very tight.  I strength train, but my arms are proportionate with my body and I struggled with the Medium and Large.  I don't know if I would do another long sleeved sequined dress again due to the arm fit.  I also wish the dress was more fitted around the mid section to accentuate the waist more.  Still I was happy with the dress and i will definitely rent the runway again.
Really pretty dress. Would rent again:) The sequins will eat your pantyhose!!! Watch out!

Wore it for my friends bachelorette party and definitely had the sparkliest dress there!  The dress was comfortable, but didn't have a lot of give, and the sleeves were definitely very tight, so I would order the extra one in the next size up just in case.

I never felt so comfortable at a formal event!!   I loved, loved, loved this dress!   I wore it for my company holiday party which happened to also be a masquerade ball, it was absolutely perfect for this event!  I've never worn a dress that was so flattering to my figure and so comfortable!!!  I wanted a dress that was fun, a little sexy, hid most of my "problem areas" but it also needed to be appropriate for a work function.  This dress met all my requirements and more!  What drew me to the dress was the longs sleeves because I wanted to hide my chubby arms.  I was nervous about the size and fit in the sleeves; scared they'd be too tight. But when the dress came and tried it on everything fit perfect with room to move.  This dress was so comfortable and hid all the "problem areas" and more!  I can't say enough about this dress, I would rent it again in a heart beat!!!  One side note about the dress, it does have a invisible zipper on the side, so it was a little tough to zip up alone so have someone standing by in case you need help.

Great for a black tie political event! This fit so well everywhere, especially for a pear shape!  Great to accentuate the waist, and looks great with a big necklace on top (like the model pic).  Beautiful color and great overall.

A classy evening I felt like royalty in this dress, and received compliments all night.  I wore this for my company's Christmas party, and my husband said he hasn't had a similar reaction to seeing me in a dress since our wedding day (quite the poet!).  I didn't feel it needed a necklace so I wore it with a chunky, sparkly bracelet and long, crystal earrings.  If my event had been outdoors, I would have worried about the length as it did skim the floor even with heels. However, I think it was the perfect length for being indoors all night.  The fabric also afforded enough movement to join the dance floor later.  

A major plus: I was able to wear a normal bra because of the wide shoulder "straps"!  I did need to tuck the bra straps inward a bit and used garment tape to keep them there (just to be safe) but I did not have any issues.

Actually Long Enough! :) I always get nervous when things come in "longs." Usually it's never long enough for my height (6'). However, this dress ACTUALLY is a long!!! Many compliments on this dress. I did have a little difficulty with the fit in the shoulders. Having "swimmer shoulders" is not great for this dress, it is small in that area; by the end of the night I could not wait to unzip it. If you have large shoulders, order one size up.
This was the perfect bold, elegant dress for my fancy gala. Fits like a glove. Comfortable. Elegant. Nice soft fabric.

Incredible, comfortable gown great for dancing! This is such a fun dress! Wore it for a black tie optional work party and got so many compliments. It was very comfortable and the skirt flows nicely when dancing. I found the neck to be a little tight at first, but got used to it quickly. With 3" heels, the dress was the perfect length. The detail at the waist makes the dress look very flattering, and the color is fantastic. Wore with the Kendra Scott Grayce Necklace (from RTR); a big necklace adds a nice layer to the simple nature of the dress design. I highly recommend this dress!
The red color is gorgeous. I liked the dress, it was different from other dresses girls had. Got lot of compliments, the only bad one (from my husband :-) was that my butt looked big in it.

Great dress for a wonderful night! This was my first RTR purchase and I have no complaints. It was a great last minute purchase that fit well and suited me perfectly. I got a lot of compliments all night!

Red Hot! This dress is gorgeous (and SO flattering)! I am 6' and I did not wear heels and it was the perfect length, so if you are tall and wanted to wear heels it might be a little short. Other than that it was a perfect dress! I highly recommend it!

Perfect formal gown! Overall, this dress was so beautiful! I wore it to my husband's work gala and it was the perfect gown! I received so many compliments all night on the dress and color! I'm not usually one to wear red, but this one was so beautiful! The fit was great, although it does tend to run a bit long. I wore a 2R (I am about 5'4") and decent heels and it was still a bit long. Other than that, I loved it. I felt so elegant!

Perfect for a Christmas gala I rented this dress for a Scottish Christmas gala and it worked perfectly. The color set off the colors in my clan tartan beautifully and it was super comfortable. The one downside was the top portion was slightly too large, but due to some unexpected last minute issues, I felt it would be more comfortable to wear the bigger size. Other than that, everything worked beautifully.

This dress is SUCH a head turner! Holy cow, this dress. THIS DRESS, Y'ALL. Simply amazing. I felt like royalty the second I looked in the mirror. The flower girls, whom I had never met before, even asked if I was a princess. My boyfriend's jaw LITERALLY dropped when he saw me. This dress! The waist fits right under the breasts, so no need for a bra. I actually loved where the waist hit because I have an athletic figure; the way the skirt fell from the waistline accentuated what little curve I have. I honestly don't know what dress size I am. I got the 8, thinking that would be fine. The waist was tight around my rib cage. The 10 fit perfectly. The fabric is THICK. Not great for outdoor weddings if the temperature gets above 80 or if you sweat easily. I am 5' 10", so I got the long. With 3-inch heels, it hit right at the floor. I was picking up the skirt to walk through grass. Very flowy -- perfect for spinning around on the dance floor! But be mindful that people don't step on your skirt. I didn't want to return this dress and I'm honestly just thinking about swiping my boyfriend's credit card to buy the darn thing. I give this a 12 out of 10.

This dress is elegant and the color is eye catching! Stand out in the room with this gorgeous dress! I ordered my normal size and one size bigger. I ended up wearing the bigger size and it was still a bit snug. I normally wear a 4, but I would've been more comfortable in an 8. The dress is flow-y but doesn't drag on the ground, even with minimal heels. I actually wore wedges and it was perfect. And I could wear my regular bra with it too! This designer and I get along great as this is the second dress I've rented from them and felt like a million bucks!

I got so many compliments on this dress! The nurse of the year gala was a night to remember  the 4 I originally ordered was perfect in size but the fit around my ribs was a little snug for comfort especially sitting down. I went with the size6 and fit perfectly!

The experience and ease of the renting was superb. The delivery was hassle free. I'm a fan of RTR! This dress fit like a glove. True to size but slightly small. Hides all the imperfections that plagued most women. Length was perfect. Zipping in and out was slightly a task. Assistance was needed.
Wish I could keep this one! Fit beautiful. Size down if you have a small bust/waist. Empire waist and foley chiffon smooths out any bumps. Color is a rich red with very warm undertones. Loved it !
Its was so great! so many compliments!  so flattering at the bust. I am heavy chested and it looks great
Lots of compliments.  Stand out color! The high waist was tight.  I ordered the 6R but I used the back up size 4R and it fit like a glove.

Couldn't zip up over my rib cage

 It's more of an orange-red in person.  Very classy and I would've worn it but I couldn't get it zipped up.

I felt so elegant and classy.  I rented the 2L and 4L based on the size recommendations of the website. But this dress was slightly long even with 5 inch heels on. With that said, this dress was beautiful. The chiffon made me feel like a princess. My event was a formal event for graduate school with faculty members, and I really wanted a dress that would be classy and elegant and this dress delivered. I received many compliments.
I loved how it was elegant and classy yet simple. It flowed lovely on the dance floor  The dress runs true to size. It's so comfy and will definitely get you compliments.

I loved the dress from the moment it came out of the package. I got so many compliments <3 I ordered the 14R and 16R, the 14R didn't want to zip, and the 16R did after I played with the zipper awhile (I think it was still rather new to RtR) Once we did that we were able to get the zipper on the 16 up with no problem. With a comfortable height heel it was the perfect length and I got so many compliments on it. It definitely needs a statement necklace to really bring the vision together, since it's a high neck.

Worn for a black tie attire event. I am 5'8" the regular length on this dress was actually just right even with heels. If you have a big chest but a slim waist - size up. Typically I wear a four but I couldn't zip up the black past my cross back because of my chest and I didn't even wear a bra.
Received many compliments on the dress. Comfortable
The dress I am barely 5'3" so the dress was a tad but long, but overall fit was perfect

Gorgeous Color & Beautiful Flow We chose this dress as bridesmaid dresses for my sister's wedding. My other sister was 4 weeks post partum and we wanted something classy and flattering that she would feel comfortable in. These did not disappoint. The red is bright and striking and the style is very elegant and flattering. The zippers are difficult, but I've encountered similar issues with many other chiffon gowns where the zipper is hidden and may be the nature of the fabric. Overall they moved and photographed beautifully. No one could believe how fabulous they looked and that we had never tried them on before renting. So glad we chose to go this way for bridesmaid dresses and would definitely recommend.

Sassy Red This was my first choice dress, I was eyeing it for months, this was my first time using the website, my boyfriends best friend was getting married, all the pieces were falling into place! I really loved the way the model looked in this dress, and I thought it would look great too. The color is more red than I thought it would be. And the material is much heavier than I thought. This was a spring wedding, so to be honest the material was a little bit heavy for my liking. Like I said this was my first choice, by some twist of fate they didn't have my first choice size so they let me pick a backup dress, and I am sooo glad because I did not end up wearing this dress. I have gained some weight so I didn't know my real size but the 22 was a little snug, and like a lot of other reviews it was sooo hard to zipper, my dad couldn't even get it! (My mom could haha) It was a very beautiful dress, I really loved it but for the occasion and my current weight it just did not work out. I would consider renting this dress for an event in the winter or fall but maybe in a different color, the red was just not what I thought. Overall I had a wonderful experience with Rent the Runway. I am so happy I had a second choice. Things just work out sometimes!

First time renter, loved it! This was my first time renting. I originally wanted this red dress, but based on other reviews, I thought I would need a regular length and that was not available, so I went for the same style in the blue/purple color. It arrived the day before my friends wedding, which was out of state. I am 5' 9" and the regular length dress was at least 3 inches off the ground when I tried it on bare foot. I was so upset. I called and one of the RTR team members was able to help me find another dress (this hot red number that I originally wanted!) I was so happy, but she told me that it was still in the process of being inspected, so it may not wind up being available. I own a few dresses that were back ups, but after going to 5 weddings this year, I wanted to try something new! The dress was at my door at 9 AM the next morning. The color is FABULOUS, but I feel it is something you can only wear once, so renting was perfect. I wore it to a "black tie optional" wedding and it really stood out. I wore the 14L with 2 or 2.5 inch wedges and it was the perfect length. As many other reviewers say, the zipper is a little tricky and there is no slack in the waist. RTR proved to have excellent service and I will definitely be renting again! Rent this dress if you want to WERK IT, girl!

Beautiful, versatile dress for multiple event types Wore this dress for a black-tie formal wedding. It was very comfortable and elegant. Such a stunning dress another wedding guest had it on ;) It's very versatile, and I imagine would be beautiful at a range of functions. The only cons were 1) it was very long for my height (5'4") - I wore 3"-4" heels and it still dragged a little, and 2) the waist band was a tight in my normal size (0R) when zipped, so I ended up wearing my backup (2R). This is probably why it was a bit long. All in all, it was a beautiful, comfortable choice that would be elegant for so many occasions.

Easy, beautiful dress I wore the 8R, should have probably picked the 8L for the height of my heels. Beautiful dress, comfortable with the exception of some rubbing at the neckline in the front. Got tons of compliments!

Perfect dress for a gala! Received compliments all night. I know formal dresses tend to run small, so I went up a size (typically wear a size 2). The dress fit perfectly, nice and snug around the waist giving the dress great shape. I paired this with a lattice clutch and teardrop earrings. Beautiful dress, would definitely recommend!

Gorgeous color Loved this dress. I actually have rented it on two separate occasions because I loved it so much. The 8L wasn't available when I rented so I got the 6L and it was a little tight but worked fine. I would definitely recommend it. It almost reached the floor, even with my height so this would be great for tall ladies.

Spectacular! This dress was just what I wanted!  Something long and formal, room to move around and forgiving on the hips/thighs.  I didn't love my arms in it so planned ahead to have a bolero jacket over it.  The top was a big "saggy" with extra material but other than that it was wonderful, I got endless compliments.  I'm 5'8" and wore 2.5" heels to keep it off the ground.  Glad I went with the Long, a regular would surely have been too short.

Loved it!  The fit was nice a little snug around the middle area. I was happy with the flow of the whole dress. Lots of compliments! 
One thing rent Petite if you are under 5'5" I am 5'2' and it was long even the petite size. Solved with heels.

This dress was gorgeous! Elegant, but comfortable and so fun to wear! I got tons of compliments! I had ordered a 2P with a 4P back up. Two days before the wedding, RTR contacted me to say the 2P had been returned in irreparable condition o was unavailable. I was very nervous, but the 4P fit beautifully! I loved wearing this dress every second that I had it on. It flowed when I walked and was great to dance in. The color was amazing. There was another guest at the wedding in the same RTR dress in blue. She had a very different body type than mine, but looked equally lovely. This dress is a winner!!

Dress was absolutely stunning. The dress was beautiful. I little different color than i was expecting, the red wasn't as red, but beautiful non the less. I ordered the regular and needed 5 inch heels just for it to skim the ground. The zipper was extremely hard to zip. I have a large chest and I wore the dress with out a bra, the bra made it look odd and it was snug enough to fit perfect. I would rent this dress again!
Perfect prom dress! This dress fit like a glove!! Very flattering and comfortable

Got so many compliments! Definitely go with the long option if you're tall or want to wear heels! I'm 5'10" and the 8L was perfect with 3 inch heels. The zipper is sort of a pain but not a huge problem. I was worried about needing to go up in size because of bust size, but the 8 fit perfectly. I got tons of compliments all night and it was easy to dance in too!

This dress was rented for a black tie Christmas wedding and it couldn't have been more perfect! The zipper was the only issue I had. It took my mom a few tries to get it to zip up which of course made me nervous but once it was zipped it was perfection! I decided to wear flats with the dress because I knew I would be doing A LOT of dancing. The dress was as close to the ground as it could have been without it dragging, which was perfect. I was also nervous that the color would not be a good winter red but yet again it was perfect! All in all I strongly suggest this dress! It was so comfortable and I wasn't worried about sucking in all night or anything stupid like that. It allowed me to really enjoy myself! Thank you RTR!

Perfect Red dress for an Emmy Award and a Wedding!  I was getting compliments ALL NIGHT LONG! Everyone was telling me that the fit and color were perfect! My only issue was that I kept stepping on it all night, but I was able to deal with it. It also went well with my Emmy Award!

Wore to walk the red carpet, got compliments all night!  I had originally chosen a different dress, but when it showed up I just didn't love it. I had chosen this dress as my "backup," and it was much more flattering and looked somehow "younger." However, the original size (18W) I had ordered for the backup was too tight in the bust (a frequent concern of mine, as I am a 40G). A RTR stylist had the next size up shipped directly to the hotel and it fit perfectly! This dress is beautiful and so flattering. Definitely stood out in a sea of black. I loved the way the gown swished as I walked, made me feel like a Grecian goddess. I would recommend a strapless bra for girls who are a little bigger in the bust - although if you had tiny enough bra straps, you could use fashion tape to secure them. I just had a baby five months ago, and I felt that this dress camouflaged my leftover belly. Would definitely rent this again! This was my first experience with RTR and I've already placed another order for an upcoming wedding! I may never buy another dress again!

Used this for engagement photos. This dress was amazing. Loved the fit, loved the quality of the dress. No complaints.
The dress was pretty long, I'm 5'3 and wore 4 inch heels in order to make it manageable.

Fab, fun and comfortable! The red makes a big splash, the full skirt hides a multitude of bumps, the swirling chiffon is super fun to dance in and it was comfortable because I was able to pin a racer back bra in place.  Highly recommended for the pear shaped!

Loved this dress.  Perfect for the wedding I attended. Ordered the 4 and 6.  4 was a little tight in the chest so went with the 6.  The zipper was very hard to get up.  Ended up having to rub a bar of soap over it in order to get it zipped.  It flowed beautifully and I received a ton of compliments all night including from the bride.

Needed a dress for a Black Tie Preferred wedding - looked great! Does run small. Ordered this dress in a size 8 with a size 10 back up. Typically wear a size 8. When I received on a Thursday, the 10 just felt too snug. So RTR shipped me a size 12 for next day delivery for Saturday before noon! Their customer service is phenomenal. No charge and it had to be shipped to where we were staying for the wedding. The wedding was Saturday night so I was concerned it wouldn't arrive in time. It did come late around 2pm but the important thing is it arrived! Overall fit great - a little big in the chest area but I loved the look. I did wear Spanx for my stomach, which I recommend.  Another RTR success story! I ordered the same jewelry the model wore.

A formal ball I was not able to get this dress in the petite size for my weekend, so went with the regular.  I wore 2 inch heels which is all I can tolerate, and the dress was a bit too long.  Might have been doable, but I had another dress that I just happened to like better, so I went with the other one.  I did love the fit and the look of this dress.  Very nice flow to the skirt and was quite comfortable.  It would have been lovely but the other dress was a tad shorter and I simply liked it better.  I will certainly consider this for my next formal event, however.

Everyone wore red to this event which really made an impact instead of the typical LBD! Really liked wearing this dress! I am 5'5" and carry most of my weight in my stomach which wasn't a problem with this dress as it's slightly high waisted so the waist band came above my belly button for a flattering fit. The top portion was slightly  big in the front (I am a 42C) yet wasn't an issue. The zip sticks due to the gathering at the waist band so you will need someone to help you zip up for sure. Also this dress is very long, I had on 3 1/3 heels and it just hit the floor. Overall, a great dress for my first RTR rental.
Fabulous color! Perfect fit, very comfortable. I wore flip flops since the wedding was on a farm so it was tiny bit too long.

Lovely dress. Beautiful bright dress and flowing materi Very forgiving in trouble areas in the tummy region.  Very comfortable and true to size.  I have wide shoulders, so this was not very flattering on me.  Length was perfect, down to my ankles.

Glamorous  I received so many compliments on this dress even in the few steps I walked from the taxi to my event. The color is GORGEOUS, and the dress flows so beautifully. Only hitch is that it is very tight at just one point mid-waist. I panicked when I tried it on because I thought there was no way I could wear the dress all evening when it was so snug to zip up. But, a backup size wasn't available, and the other dress I ordered wasn't the right vibe for the evening. Ultimately, I wore this dress and (once my friend and I struggled to get it zipped for about five minutes) it was great. I was comfortable all evening. Once it was zipped, it was a true-to-size fit. If you choose this dress, I would highly suggest that you make sure to get a back-up in the next size up... just in case the zipper is an issue for you as well.
I will rent again for sure  Fit great. I rented the 6 and 8 and ended up wearing the 8. I'm just about 5'7' and rented the regular length. I wore 3' heals and it was perfect.

RED HOT The dress fit my body perfectly and I felt sexy and classic at the same time. I received compliments all night, even from the bride, and the only bad thing I have to say is it was a little too long for my petite frame. I stand at just over 5 ft tall so I ordered the 2P and wore my 4 inch heels but the dress was still about an inch too long, however I made it work. A gorgeous dress and very flattering!

Tight for bigger chests but gorgeous! It fit well, I usually wear a 2/4 dress size. I had a LOT of trouble zipping it up but it eventually worked! i am 6 feet tall and wore 4 inch heels and the dress was only about an inch too short, so the long would be perfect for those tall girls out there.

Overall great experience !! I absolutely LOVE this dress and it to so, so many compliments. I was so sad when I had to send it back. I wore it for a military ball and it was perfect. Sleek and flattering and fit me like a glove. I'm 5'6 and ordered the 4R and it was the perfect length. Overall RTR was a great experience and I would definitely rent again !!
Everyone loved the dress! It fit very well to size!

I wish I could buy this dress! Pro: Very elegant, great dress
Con: It was very long.  This was fixed by wearing very tall heels.
first time RTR experience beautiful dress! got so many compliments. it definitely stands out. It's a little long, so make sure to wear high heels.

Great fit, super comfortable without sacrificing style! This dress is perfect for someone with an our glass shape- it is very fitted through the waist (natural waist) but very forgiving thru the hips and fits true to size up top. I like that I could wear a normal bra with this and was super comfortable in it all night long! It's easy to dress it up with statement jewelry pieces.

I absolutely loved this dress! It fit perfectly and was flowy and comfortable! No complaints:) I am tall and thin and wore the 6R which went to the ground perfectly without heels. It fit me well in the chest, but I have a small bust.
Got a lot of compliments!!! Beautiful dress!  The dress runs true to size. The length was perfect!

Perfect dress to feel classy at a black-tie event! The fit of this dress was great - only fitted area was the waist. I was able to wear a strapless bra and with 3 inch heels it was the perfect length.
Lots of compliments! Great for my petite frame

Comfortable and classy! The dress fit my body well and was very comfortable. I received several compliments that I looked skinny and so the dress is also very slimming. Loved the purple color. I got a size up because I was worried about the sleeves being tight based on other reviews, and the size up fit perfectly.

Beautiful color, form-fitting, material does not give I wore this dress for my friend's rehearsal (a wedding I was a bridesmaid in). I loved the color & fit of the dress. My only complaint would be that the material doesn't give at all. I was glad I wore it to something that didn't require a lot of movement, but it would've been a no go for dancing.
Perfect for winter wedding Snug in the hips, I had to go for the larger size. A bit tight in the sleeves, so made it a little uncomfortable for dancing.

Very classic, pretty dress I rented this dress for a Friday night wedding and it was very appropriate for the occasion. The dress is definitely more purple than it appears in the picture, but it's still a deep, pretty color. I usually wear a size 4 or 6 in dresses, and wound up wearing this dress in the 6 because there's absolutely no stretch to the material. I couldn't have lifted my arms at all if I had worn the 4. That being said, it's still very comfortable as long as you're okay with the lace overlay not being the most flexible material.

Pretty dress.  VERY conservative... I rented this dress for an NYE party thinking it would be short and cute, with added lace detail.  Well, the material was great, but I looked like Mother of the Bride.  I am 37.  I am also 5'4".  This dress went past my knees, and the neckline went all the way up to my neck.  Not a party dress for someone my size...I felt matronly.  Luckily, the always fabulous ladies at RTR overnighted me another dress without any hesitation.  The dresses don't always work out, but the RTR team never disappoints.  :)
Back up option - wound up being perfect This dress was great, super comfortable and longer than I expected - very satisfied

This back up dress ended up being the winner, hands down.   The color was gorgeous, even for a spring wedding.  Length was perfect when standing, just needed a little more care when needing to bend over.  I agree with other reviewers that the sleeves were tight at first, but really didn't notice it the rest of the night.  Those were the only two reasons for a 4, not 5 star review.  Excellent fit for girls with girls.
The dress was amazing.  Rent the Runway is a really fun service, and everything was nice and clean. Everything fit well and the dress was perfect for the evening.

If you want to dance and move your arms, pick another dress This dress is a beautiful color, BUT it has NO stretch or give in the shoulder or arm areas. I wasn't able to close my car door and giving a hug was a struggle. Unfortunately, I couldn't last the whole evening in this dress, so I had to quickly shop for a dress between the ceremony and reception.

I got so many compliments, everyone loved it!  Normally I wear anywhere from a 6-10, thank god I got the 8 and 10 because the 8 was very snug. I ended up wearing the 10. The arms were slightly tight and the waist was slightly too big, but I wore a small black belt and it looked great.
I wore it to sorority recruitment and it was great Ran true to size, very comfortable
Loved the color!  I loved this pretty lace dress. It was short on me so I stood up a lot. But still beautiful. I also felt the sleeves were tight on me. I wouldn't rent again based on length alone.
Great compliments! The dress fit great and I got plenty of compliments. It was a little long but I'm short so that's to be expected. Great color!

Comfortable, flattering fit, received several compliments! I wore this to a formal company holiday party. Initially I wasn't crazy about the color (stronger purple tone than the photo shows, and I usually don't wear purple) but it looked better on. It was very comfortable (no issues wearing it all night) and flattering. The lace gives it an extra touch of looking fancy without being over the top. I received several compliments!

Beautiful dress and great color! I wore this dress for a family member's wedding/anniversary celebration.  The dress fit true to size as it said.  It hit just above the knee for me with the length.  It was a little snug around the waist area, but still easy to move around and dance in!  The sleeves fit well but became a little tight as you raise your arms up.   Overall, the color is amazing and perfect for a fall or winter wedding/formal affair and comfortable to wear  thru out the day. I would rent this dress again!
Communication from RTR is outstanding.  Love This color. Dress is true to the size. Not too long or short. Just perfect. Material is ok- does not scream fancy.

Amazing dress! This dress fitted great. I was worried that the arms would be too tight since the lace doesn't stretch. But it fit great and I felt really good in it. The color is a little brighter than I expected but it made it plum-y color that I really loved.

STUNNING dress This was my overnighted 2nd choice dress (and they could only send one!) but the stylist helped me choose the perfect size.  The dress fit like a glove!  As others said, the sleeves are a little tight, but I barely noticed all night.  I had several people at the wedding compliment my dress & my husband wished I could buy it!!  This one is a keeper!!  (Oh, and it's deep purple...much different than the product photo.)

Great dress, perfect for my office Holiday party.  True to size and color is as pictured. I wore this dress to my office Holiday party.  I ordered a size 0 and a size 2 and I ended up wearing the 0.  Others mentioned the arms are tight, while they did not have any give, they were not tight on me.  There really is not anything I would change about this dress.   It was absolutely perfect, and the color is exactly as pictured.  I also wore the necklace that is pictured with the dress.  It looked great and was nice to not have to think about the accessories!

Love the color  This was a very pretty dress - but there is no stretch (like the description says) and when you raise your arms, the whole dress moves up and gets super short.  The 6 was a little bit loose in the waist and hips, but I don't think it would have been comfortable if I wore it more fitted.

I wore this for my company's 25th Anniversary party.  I really liked this dress and received a lot of compliments on it. It's a classically pretty, and the lace sleeves are flattering. It is a little tight in the arms, but it wasn't an event where we were dancing like crazy or anything. I usually wear a 2 and I found this true-to-size, if not a little loose through the middle.

Gorgeous  So many compliments! I loved this dress I want to own it. Very pretty! And flattering. The purple lace is actually more purple than it looked in pictures, but a very pretty color. Wore to a rehearsal dinner. Great length when walking around. Sleeves fit perfectly as well.

Perfect! Beautifully made, perfect fit. Ideal for early fall wedding. I am just about 5 feet, and wear petite everything. Always worry about dresses that come in regular sizes. This hit a bit above knee length (longer than on the model) and was entirely appropriate for the wedding we went to. I loved it enough that I may rent again for another occasion this fall.

Perfect dress for a fall wedding This dress is so flattering, and fit like a glove.  It's overall just perfect. The color and the lace were perfect for a fall wedding. The only complaint is that it doesn't give much in the arms, so if you're planning to bust a move on the dance floor, this isn't the dress for you.  My arms are on the athletic/small side even for my size, and although the sleeves themselves were not snug around my arms, I could not lift them up very well in this dress.  This didn't bother me though because it looked so good on. I definitely recommend this dress.

Runs Small I was unable to wear this dress because it was a little too small.  I usually wear a 10, so I thought I'd be safe with receiving a 10 and a 12, but even the 12 was too tight to zip up.   Be careful with these designer dresses, they run smaller than they say they are.

Very pretty! I ordered the 8 with the 10 as a backup. I have larger hips, so the 10 fit better in that area, but the top had so much extra fabric (since I don't have a big chest), so I decided to wear the 8. Sitting was a little uncomfortable and the sleeves are very constricting. I had the dress on for about 5 hours and was glad to be taking it off. However it looked great and the color is gorgeous!

Favorite RTR dress yet. Size 0.
Height 5'1", weight 100lbs
Bust 34B
Fit great. I did notice the arms as other people mentioned, but I didn't find them tight it was more you couldn't raise your arms completely over your head. I was able to dance easily, I found the fit comfortable and length perfect.

Loved It! I am usually in between a 6 and an 8. I read the reviews and saw that the recommendations were to go up a size because of the tightness in the arms. So I ordered an 8 and a 10, I wore the 8 and there was a lot of room around my waste, and hips. But was snug around my shoulders and bust. I loved that I could wear a regular bra! (Always a bonus in my mind). Simple and comfy, I wore it to a company holiday party, able to dance and have fun!

Great dress for a fall wedding I usually wear a size 6 but it was a last minute rental for me so a 6 wasn't available. I read all of the reviews about the arms being small so i decided to take a chance with the 8. It fit great! i think the 6 would have been uncomfortable in the arms. I got a lot of compliments on this. It is a great plum color for a fall wedding.

Perfect for a fall wedding!  I am typically a dress size 2/4, but these designer dresses do tend to run small, so I ordered a 4 and 6. Well, the 4 barely got over my hips, but the 6 was perfect. Felt beautiful in it. The only thing is that since it's form fitting and doesn't have much give, it got very tight and short when I sat down. But standing up, there were no issues :) Overall, I loved it! Currently searching for my next wedding rental.

Dress was perfect for a Christmas party I went to! Dress is true to the other reviews, it runs small in the arms. I am normally a 4 but ordered a backup size 6 and I am glad i did. The 4 fit my body but was tight in the arms so the 6 was more comfortable. If you have at all athletic arms i would suggest going 1 size up. I got plenty of compliments through out the night and the color of the dress is better in person. I would recommend this dress!

This dress is the perfect color and weight for a crisp Fall Wedding. I received so many compliments! This was my first RTR rental and I will definitely be a repeat customer. The dress came on time and fit me like a dream, I'm normally a size 2 and that was the right size for me. I'm also very petite so the length was perfect for a conservative Fall wedding. I took off one star because the dress smelled lightly of moth balls when it came out of the box, however, I just left it hanging in my bathroom overnight and the smell went away. Also, the sleeves were a little snug when I lifted both arms above my head. Fortunately, the length of the dress on me kept me flashing everyone when I got twirled on the dance floor.

The lace was thick and well-cut so the dress gave me a flattering silhouette. I was also able to drink and eat all night because the forgiving plum color. I attached a collage of different photographs from different cameras to show how beautifully the dress appears on film. So many people stopped me to compliment on the dress and asked me where I got it. The best part of all, an ex of mine was also a wedding guest and he couldn't keep his eyes off of me all night. Sometimes all you need is a gorgeous dress and killer heels to make you feel like a million bucks. Thanks, RTR!
pretty dress I loved this dress. I was a little too snug in the chest area, besides that, it fit great!
Very flattering and versatile dress Loved the dress. Quality was great. The sleeves were a bit more snug than I would have preferred but overall wonderful dress for a formal summer wedding!
Fits great, very wearable for a lot of settings. Wore for a work holiday party and would rent again for another function!

Beautiful dress and color! I wore this dress to a church Christmas event, so I had to be relatively modest, but I wanted something unique. This dress fit the bill perfectly. The lace was beautiful and the color was great! It was a great deep purple. I was concerned about the sleeves, as other reviewers said they were tight. The sleeves were fine for me, but the shoulders is where I struggled a bit. That's the only reason for the 4 stars instead of 5. I couldn't lift my arms very high - where even driving to the event was a little tricky! It didn't bother me all night though (as arms up isn't a super common thing for me to do, lol). If you need good upper body range of motion, maybe pick something else. But overall, this dress was a wonderful choice!

Got lots of compliments! I didn't think the sleeves were too tight, like others have said, but it isn't the easiest dress to wear while sitting. Not a lot of give to it. But the length was perfect, and I got many compliments on it.
Very pretty dress.  Beautiful color.  Flattering.   True to size.  Sleeves a bit tight, but loosened as the night went on.  It is a flattering fit.  I would wear again.

The color and quality of the dress definitely stands out! The dress fit perfectly; true to size.  At times I wear a 0, although chose the 2 as the sleeves were snug.  I received many compliments on the color which changes depending upon the lighting.  It is more true to the plum color rather than the purple it appears to be in the picture.  I am 5 ft; 3 1/2 inches and about 113 lbs.

Got  a lot of compliments on the dress, and the purple tones.  The arms were a VERY tight squeeze, and a bit uncomfortable.  I have more muscle tone in my arms, and am an athletic build. The 6 would have been too baggy around my body, however when I lifted my arms (or tried to) with the 4 on, I hardly could move -- no give in the arms. However it didn't stop me from wearing the dress, because it was beautiful!

Wedding I am normally a size 8, but ordered an 8 and a 10 because I had a baby 9 months ago and I wasn't sure I was quite down to my normal size. I can wear size 8 jeans, but this dress I had to wear a 10. I am also nursing my daughter so if you are bustier, you might need a larger size for comfort. The 10 was doable, but the sleeves were definitely tight. It also tends to ride up when you move your arms because of the tightness in the sleeves. It was very hard to handle my daughter in this dress.  I was surprised at the length in the dress when standing as other users said it was short, but it was fine. It is definitely not something you can bend over in though and have to be very aware when sitting down. Perhaps if I had gone up one more size for comfort, it wouldn't have been as bad. The dress is a great dress, but a bit tight for me. I feel like it runs a bit smaller.

I loved the fit of the dress and received compliments at my sisters rehearsal dinner! Sleeves are restricting to where I should have gone to a 12 but the dress fit was too big so I wore a 10. Would only wear again if I was just sitting around and looking pretty. No dancing, hugging or large arm movements in this one! Loved it aside from that.

Fell in love with this dress I wish I had gotten a picture in it, because it was so perfect! I've worn this designer before and it just fits me like a glove (5'3", 108lb).
