The color is definitely more purple than maroon (I'm an Aggie, I would know!), but the purple is absolutely gorgeous... Like a very deep eggplant. It hit me about 4" above the knee, so was a bit short when sitting, but not short enough to cause any problems! I felt beautiful & classy at my husband's Christmas dinner. Would highly recommend! Wore it with RTR's antique cascading crystal necklace and it was stunning. Didn't have to wear any more jewelry with it! Also worn with light patent gray stilettos.

This was my free birthday dress, which worked out great because we went to a wedding on my birthday. If you have big thighs, like I do, this dress runs very tight through the thighs. Made it a little difficult to sit and stand as often as you do for a wedding.

Beautiful dress.  Very flattering.  I loved this dress! I don't like to wear the same thing twice, but would think about renting this dress again. It ran small in the arms for me so I wore 1 size up, but the body did not look boxy even increasing the size. We wore as bridesmaid dresses to a very small intimate wedding and they looked beautiful in person and the pictures.

Lots of compliments, great color for a fall wedding! Overall great color and fit for a fall wedding. Like other reviews, it is a little tight in the arms but besides not being able to lift my arms all the way up it didn't have any impact. The lace has a slight amount of wear but was not visible to others. It ran very true to size, was slightly shorter than I anticipated ending at mid thigh but overall a great choice.

Flattering semi-formal dress I rented this for a wedding in July in VA. It was very flattering dress and I received many compliments on it throughout the evening. I usually wear a 4, but the 6 fit better. I am short - 5'0" and the dress was a great length, just above my knees. Only set back was that arm range was a bit constricted - I couldn't reach my arms all the way up. Also I was lucky because the wedding I was attending was indoors. I wouldn't recommend this for an outside summer wedding. I also appreciated that the lining covered everything except the arms. The lace is thick and sturdy, not going to easily rip if you accidentally get caught on something. Highly recommend this dress!

Perfect color for a fall wedding As everyone said, it's lace so the sleeves and bust are initially right but not uncomfortable. The deep plum was perfect for a fall wedding. It was classy and incredibly comfortable paired with nude heels and clutch and rose gold jewelry.

Comfortable and Pretty! This dress was very comfortable and elegant. I'm a petite 5' 1", so I struggle finding dresses that aren’t TOO long. This one was perfect. It hit about 1-2 inches above my knee. Other reviews commented on the arms being too tight, but I didn’t have a problem with that. I do wish the dress had been a bit more form fitting. It has more of a sheath fit, but it was still gorgeous none the less!
This was perfect for a bridal shower!  Fit well. The dress I got in size 8 had a few stitches in the zipper so I couldn't unzip it all the way. The size 10 was way too big.

This dress was stunning and I got lots of compliments! This was an amazing dress and perfect for the occasion (fall wedding), but it was just a little big in the chest. However, I am very tiny and it wasn't noticeable. Loved this dress!

I did receive many compliments on the color and the style of this dress. This dress was a bit tight - I normally wear a 6 and I'm glad I opted to get the free additional size in an 8 because that's what I ended up wearing. It was very tight in the arms.

The color of this dress is GORGEOUS! Got tons of compliments all night.  The shoulders/arms have no give and run a little tight. It wasn't uncomfortable, but I'm glad I don't lift weights or it might not have fit! Made dancing to shout a little difficult but it wouldn't stop my from renting this dress again.

Great w/ cowboy boots! Love the deep purple color of this dress and the romantic lace. I wanted a dress that would work with cowboy boots since the wedding reception was in a barn -- this dress definitely did the trick! The 4 fit my 28" waist, 42"(ish) hips. Arms were snug, but not uncomfortable. Only thing to look out for is how the skirt rides up while sitting down.
Perfect Thanksgiving dress was compfortable
This dress was perfect for the wedding I attended, and it was perfect for dancing! Fit me like a glove, not too tight!

Sophisticated! The first time I tried this on it fit weirdly but on the night of the wedding it was like a glove! It's a very pretty dress for girls with curves. It did seem more conservative because of the sleeves, but it was still short so that I didn't feel too conservative. Would definitely recommend for a conservative or chilly fall wedding!
Beautiful color and made me feel great! I wore this dress to an October wedding in New England. It was very comfortable and was a beautiful color! I wish I owned it!

Beautiful dress for a fall wedding! Fit: Not the most comfortable dress but also not the least comfortable I've ever worn.. There is no stretch to the material, especially in the arms, making it difficult to zip yourself up all the way. Also, the lining is stitched to the lace overlay at an awkward spot, making the dress feel tighter around the upper stomach. I loved that I could wear a normal bra with this!

Look: The dress is pretty forgiving and gives the look of an hourglass figure. The color is beautiful, perfect for the fall, and the lace makes it both sexy & classy. I'm not sure if it was only my dress or all of them but it seemed like the lining was longer than the lace. This was mostly visible when sitting.

Overall, I loved this dress and would definitely rent it again for an event where I wouldn't be dancing as much!

Perfect for a winter gala I loved this dress! It fit true to size. It was a heavy fabric that made it great for a formal winter event. I wore it with a black fur-edged shaw and gold jewelry. It did have major zipper issues. My husband nor my mother-in-law could not zip it though it was not tight. I had to forcefully turn it around on me and zip it myself using a few tricks. One other flaw was the hem. There was a crease in it that made the dress fall in a weird way. It could not be ironed out. I enjoyed my night in this beautiful dress.
This dress was stunning.I felt beautiful and elegant. People stopped me left and right to compliment Fits true to size, its a heavy dress but stayed put all night long

Fabulous dress! I wore this dress for a black tie wedding and it was perfect for the occasion. The hem was coming out of the dress when I got it, so that was a bit unfortunate, but to be honest no one would have noticed but me. Danced the night away and didn't have to adjust it much because of the interior boning in the bodice. Totally recommend!

RTR made my dress-acquiring experience easy-peasy! As many others have said, this dress is beautiful and I was very impressed with the RTR service and attention to details. The dress is an iridescent midnight blue (not purple like some pictures appear) with a black damask-like pattern. It was perfect for my event. However, I was not happy that the ribs on the bodice worked their way through the fabric and poked me all night. I also didn't love the stiff hem (it looks like it needs to be steamed out, but that didn't work to get the weird ruffled look out). The bust was a little big on me (I'm 36C) and the zipper was impossible to do alone. The length was perfect for me.

Comfortable and elegant for a formal wedding! I loved this dress and the patter made it so much more interesting than just a standard black dress! I wore this for a formal wedding at the NY Public Library and this dress fit the venue and attire perfectly! I loved that it had pockets and the shorter hem in the front let me show off my new shoes! The only issue I had with the dress was that I originally planned to wear the 6- it fit better and was a little shorter but when I put it on, we had issues with the zipper. I had 3 people trying to get the zipper closed and it would not move. It wasn't because the dress was too tight either, there was plenty of room in the dress but it was as if the zipper was separating from the fabric like it had been ripped out previously and was sewn in again but too close to the hem. We couldn't get the zipper up or down once it got halfway so I ended up having to rip the zipper some just to get out of the dress. Luckily the 8 wasn't too much larger, just a little longer so I was able to wear that in it's place.

AMAZING DRESS! I wore this dress to a formal wedding and loved it!  First let me start with my measurements - 32DDD, 25 waist, 40 hips.  I ordered this dress in a 2R and 0L.  The 0L fit my waist better but I ended up have the oh so lovely armpit fat so I wore the 2R.  I didn't have to keep adjusting the top of the dress throughout the night though the waist a about 1 1/2 inches too big.  It also didn't show a lot of cleavage, which I liked because this was a wedding after all.  The color of this dress is what I fell in love with!  This picture does not do it justice.  The blue is much more vibrant in person...especially in natural lighting.   

I would definitely rent this dress again!

Fashion Show Worthy! I was hesitant about this dress because I am on the shorter side- 5'3" but as you can see, it fit perfectly! It fell the right length in the front, mind you I was wearing 3" heels, and graced the floor in the back. The dress itself was heavy, but not unmanageable and very comfortable. There's no need to wear a bra with this unless you want to. I did not have to tug or pull at this dress once during the evening. Bonus, the pockets are deep enough and well hidden so you can stash your lip gloss, money, cell phone without these items being noticeable or prominent. Overall, this dress is Golden- I highly recommend it!

AWESOME dress Fit was true to size--I got the 0L because the 0R was taken and figured hey, I'd have a little bit of a train! I love that the dress had an inner layer that latched under the zipper, which cuts down on your "oh crap, this zipper might not zip and/or might catch my skin" anxiety. I usually don't wear strapless dresses, but this one was very well-done, with hidden boning that kept it up and the flare in the skirt definitely balances you out if you have defined shoulders! I didn't wear a bra and the top felt secure the whole night. I know everyone talks about the pockets, but I have to talk about them too because--POCKETS. They're great ones too, not the normal crap pockets they put in women's clothing--I had my lipstick in the pocket all night and there was no chance it was going to fall out. This dress just feels really great to wear--It has a good weight to it, and it makes you feel almost regal.

As always, RTR service is amazing--I got the dress a couple days before I thought I would, which at first freaked me out (did I put in the wrong day!?), but was actually just them being extra on top of their game.

I wore this to a senior prom and it was perfect! I really liked how classy and unique it was.  I loved this dress!! It broke my heart to send it back. It was very different from most of the other prom dresses and I loved how elegant it was! This dress is designed to have a hi-low style, but I am so short that you really couldn't see it. That was totally fine with me, just keep that in mind! I wore 4 inch heels but the dress would still drag a little on the ground in the back. I did not have to worry about the dress falling down at all during the night, it stayed up really well and that was fantastic! And there are pockets!! It is a little hard to see in the picture they have for this dress, but the dress is a beautiful deep navy color with the black design on it. When I ordered it, I thought there would be more of the black color but I was pleasantly surprised with the blue!
Awesome dress. This dress was AMAZING. I got so many compliments and it is awesome fabric, super sturdy and stayed nice all night. I would totally recommend it for taller girls also.

Loved it!! I loved dancing in this dress. The pockets were my favorite part! And the material was beautiful. I got lots of compliments! It was a very hot day & night and the wedding was all outdoors, so the material was a little heavy, but it was still perfect for a black tie event.

Beautiful design and cut that stood out. Very elegant and fun to wear. Enough weight but not heavy!! No cons. Was extremely comfortable to wear. Perfect for smaller chests. Wore to a fall Wedding. Was warm enough and had a lovely thick material that felt soo royal. Flowed beautifully!
It was the perfect dress for my sororities formal. Very comfortable and I danced the night away. I absolutely love this dress and felt like a princess.

There's nothing better than wearing something that you feel confident in. I had some help with the zipper (why these expensive dresses have such chintzy zippers I'll never know) but once it was zipped and fastened, I had no issues. The dress was true to size and the top stayed put all evening and gave a flattering silhouette. It was a dream to dance in with the flouncy skirt. I loved the tea length in front with the longer back-it worked well with my Amazon lady height!
Dramatic yet elegant.  LOVED the pockets. Fits true to size.

I went to a black tie masquerade I am 5'5", so the dress didn't have the dramatic high-lo effect on me, but with 4" heels the back draped perfectly above the floor in the back.  I didn't end up wearing a bra (I wear a 34DD) because the top was snug and showed the top of the bra over the neckline, but it was perfectly comfortable all night!  Super helpful to have pockets, too.

AMAZING DRESS! SO CLASSY! I have rented several dresses with rent the runway, and this one was probably my favorite. It fit like a glove, and me feel like a movie star. For each order I usually rent a 4L and a 6L, and have always fit into the 4L without a problem. This dress was no different.  I was pumped when i remembered the dress had pockets halfway through the night, and that made posing for pictures even more classy :)

So much fun for a black tie wedding. I got so many compliments. I always wear long black dresses to black tie and this was different but still formal. There is tulle underneath the skirt and it's pretty puffy - I would size down. The long was the perfect length for me.
Peferct fit! Received lots of compliments. True to size. really helps shape your waistline.

I danced all night in this fabulous gown. Worth every penny!!! The dress runs long, and for someone who's 5'4, even with heels on, it's still long in front. Get this dress, grab your best girlfriend and have her pin up the front to show off your gams, and you're good to go!! I loved the weight of the dress, how it moved and how gorgeous the fabric was. Would absolutely rent this again!
My friend and I picked dresses in 2 different sizes and a backup choice. That's 6 dresses to try on! Pockets!  I felt fantastic!

So many complements all night, everyone loved it! This dress is easily the most gorgeous, elegant dress I've ever worn. My mouth dropped open when I saw it in person. It is so flattering and you feel gorgeous in it. I did find that it was a little tight, even when I went for the larger back up size (4). But you couldn't tell -- just felt a little tight in the ribcage area (which is a usual problem area for me). I got so many complements all night on the dress, especially the color. Everyone thought it was beautiful! I would give anything to have this in my closet permanently!
BEAUTIFUL DRESS!!! Fits true to size.  I loved the weight of the dress, how gorgeous the fabric was and it had POCKETS!! Love it.

Fun dress! This dress was perfect for the black tie wedding we attended in January- very comfortable fit and it has pockets! I was a little worried about the high-low cut as it's not my favorite style, but the cut was very subtle and elegant. I was really impressed with the quality of the fabric- Very fun, playful, pretty dress overall!

Received so many compliments at the Ball. Rented this dress, because I like the hemline..different from what I thought I would see at a Ball I was attending.
When it arrived, I found the dress to be of a substantial weight...(wouldn't wear this in the summer..)and it draped beautifully. I am fairly busty, so I tried both dresses (8 and 10) on..but since I was the only one home at the time, I found I couldn't zip the 8 up by myself..I think it would have fit perfectly if I could have, but I wore the 10 because I could zip it and found the bodice was just a bit large...
But overall, it was a beautiful dress...I wore it with a very colorful necklace...and received compliments all night.
Love Rent the Runway!

Loved  I had 2 sizes to choose from- return was easy. I received so many compliments on the dress! Loved the pockets! Bust is snug- but has built in corset so no need for a bra. 

Fabric is incredible. Felt so fancy all night!
worked great got a lot of compliments! a little tight and hard to zipper but otherwise was lovely.

Perfect dress for a formal affair - especially when it's cold!  This dress was so much fun. I got lots of compliments all night. It is classic, beautiful, and comfortable. The material is thick, so it is best to wear when it's colder outside. Huge plus - it has pockets, so you don't have to keep up with a clutch all night. The blue is richer than it appears in pictures. It does run a bit large, which is why I am glad I rented the 0 (I'm normally a 2). Size 0L was the only size left, so after reading other reviews I risked ordering the smaller and longer size. the back touched the ground with my 3 1/2 inch heels. I recommend renting this dress if you size down.

Dress looks a little frumpy on a larger bust! If you have a larger bust, I would say this dress isn't quite meant for us girls! The dress fit the bust fine, but ultimately looks a little frumpy and is not tight enough in the waist/rib cage area.
The hue of blue and brocade material set it apart from everyone else  Fit was true to size. It was damaged on the side...eye hooks werent there. But the bust fit well so thankfully didn't need them

This is a gorgeous, sturdy dress.   I received so many compliments about how pretty my dress was. The minute you touch the fabric you know it is a quality dress. The only downside is that being overweight, I felt like it added a lot of bulk and may not have been the most flattering for a size 14. At 5'4", I got the regular lenth. With heals, the length was fine.   Again, this dress really is beautiful.

Looked beautiful in photos - but had some issues The 6 would have fit perfectly but the zipper was broken and wouldn't zip more than half way. I ended up going to the larger size but had to wear a strapless bra with it. I wore shoes similar to the ones the model is wearing - def make sure you have statement shoes to wear with this dress!

Too large I rented this dress and another one for a formal wedding.  I ended up wearing the other dress.  This dress was way too large in the bust.  Otherwise, I thought the dress fit well.  The fabric had a nice weight, which would have been great to keep me warm during a winter wedding.

Felt like Cinderella I loved the hem of this dress. I ended up renting the same necklace and ring from the model photo and it was the perfect accessory for this dress. The pockets were amazing! Like Cinderella I ended up leaving my formal gala early and ran down Navy Pier in Chicago with the dress flowing behind me to catch another party. The only thing I would change is the waist didn't lay as flat as I would have liked so it made me look a little rounder than I would have liked. I'm always concerned with larger arms that a strapless dress will squeeze the top of my bust and give me a muffin top but I didn't have that issue! A great fit and a fantastic dress!

I attended a military ball.  I received so many compliments on this dress and the color truly pops more than the website leads on to believe. I am 5'8" and the R length size was perfect to show off heels with this dress and I loved the pockets. The only two (small) complaints I have were the zipper and the boning in the bodice. The zipper was difficult to use especially in the bodice region but with an extra set of hands, I was able to zipper it up! The boning absolutely helped make the dress but did get extremely uncomfortable after wearing it for 6+ hours. All in all, I was sad to return this dress!
I got a ton of compliments all night. I love the high-low. It's much more blue in person than in the pictures on the model.

The Quality of my dress stood out from all other girls at the Marine Corps Ball. BEST IDEA EVER!!!  I received my first dress (a completely different style) on Thursday and it did not fit properly at all!  So I contacted RTR right away and they sent me this style that I chose the next day!  My event was on Saturday so I was able to get it before we left for the trip.  RTR will send you a back up size just incase you are worried about it not fitting.  It was the best experience of my life and I highly recommend it. I had a beautiful and high quality designer dress that NO ONE else had and it looked so much better than the cheap materials affordable dresses are made of. I got TONS of compliments on my dress! I am going to do this next year!

Just the most beautiful dress ever!  Pros: great fit, length was perfect, the black and blue was very elegant for a black tie wedding, great silhouette
Cons: you could tell, after close inspection, it had clearly been "worn in." The hem was a little weird and the zipper and hooks were tough. 

Beautiful dress, I got TONS of compliments. I'm on the shorter side and so the hem in the front hit right above my ankles and the dress grazed the ground in the back. I thought this was the perfect length for me and the occasion. I'd definitely recommend this dress!

a classic with pockets! Even though I'm tall, I ordered the 2R because I had been able to try the same dress on in a store, and it was definitely the right length for me even in heels.  The hem of the dress didn't hang as well as I was hoping as it had gotten rather squished and bent, but a little pressing went a long way.  Overall, it was super comfortable and fun to wear.  Plus, the dress has pockets, so you know it's a winner!

Fun and comfortable dress for a wedding I usually wear a 4 in dresses, and the 4 fit really well (not as tight as I usually like at the bust, but I'm also a small cup size).  Loved the extra room in the hips.  4R was plenty long, even in regular length my heels would sometimes catch the back hem.  Stayed in place all night with no need to pull up or adjust like some strapless dresses.
Every woman came up to me to ask where I got my dress from. They said I looked like a celebrity! It fit very well. However, I could have probably used a size 4 since I have a very small bust.
Loved the navy and black; very unique dress This dress is beautiful, very cool shape and I loved the color.  However, this is a lot of dress, and I'm not sure that it photographed that well.

The dress is beautiful! LOVE the pockets. Lots of fabric - got kind of hot.  Fitted at bust, flows out at waist. The 4 fit snugly at the bust (34B). The 4L slightly touched the ground at the back with 4" heels on.
My dress! The dress fit perfectly and was absolutely stunning, got a ton of complements!

Lovely dress with a great shape and silhouette. Loved this dress. It fit true to size. It was about an inch or two off the ground since I am very short but it worked well with platform heels. I added a belt to break up the proportions. It was a heavy brocade, if it was hotter out it would have been uncomfortable.

Felt beautiful and fancy my boyfriend's jaw dropped! I was a little nervous because a backup size wasn't available, but my regular size 8 fit - with a little help getting zipped up by a friend. Cinched my waist in exactly the right place and I loved the structure of the gown. The colors and pattern show much up much better in person. Got lots of compliments from teenage girls and older women alike. Everyone wanted to know where I got my dress!

LOVE this dress! I received so many compliments on this dress and it was perfect for a black tie wedding. I am between 5'7" & 5'8" and I wore 3 inch heels and the length was perfect. The boning on the dress I received was starting to poke through a little bit and was slightly uncomfortable when sitting down. Also, the seam at the bottom was very wrinkled, but a quick iron flattened it right out. I would definitely rent this dress again!

I had to get help to stuff me into the top of the dress! The dress was beautiful, but the top was very small in size.  I also noticed that the top rolled a bit at times, revealing the reinforcement.  The fabric is fairly heavy, so I found that the bottom of the dress would curl up a bit and my heels often got caught in the back.  Overall, it still looked great and was a great pick.

Great dress, lots of compliments! The dress fit well. I was glad to have ordered the 10P as a back up. They were out of the 8R and the L was too long and didn't have enough room in the bust. The 10P fit perfectly (although hit a little longer than shown on the model). I got lots of compliments and felt comfortable in the dress all night. Perfect for an evening winter wedding!

I got stopped by someone as I was walking by to say I had the best dress of the night! So I stressed for a day over which sizes to order as some said the dress ran small... some said it ran big... no idea! I ordered a 6, which is my usual dress size and it fit perfect.  I got nervous and ordered an 8 as my back-up and I wouldn't have fit into it.  I would've had a better chance fitting into a 4 if the 6 hadn't worked.  For height, I'm quite tall and I wore 3 or 4" heels and the back of the dress was slightly touching the ground, which I thought was perfect.   For bust, I definitely don't have a lot going on, but the strap that this dress has and the tight fit of the upper portion was perfect.  I felt comfortable all night (while dancing) and I can't remember ever pulling up the dress.  Enjoy it!
The dress was unlike anyone else's! And the process was so easy  Fit was great. Loved the pockets (no need for a purse). Got tons of compliments!!

Loved it! This dress was so fun! I wore it to a formal wedding & it was so comfortable and great for dancing. I received a ton of compliments. It was a little big on the chest, so I had to keep pulling it up, but the boning was tight so I couldn't have worn a smaller size. I wore the regular length and it was perfect, could have even been slightly shorter. I loved the detail with the high/low hem that showed off my shoes. And the fabric was so pretty. Plus, it has pockets! Perfect for my phone and lipstick. This was a great dress, so unique and fun!

I was complimented so many times on this dress, it fit perfectly!  I picked this dress specifically because I am 5'0". This dress hits mid-calf on anyone of normal height, but looks perfect as a floor length on someone as petite as myself! The pockets were perfect as well! The dress is a bit heavier, so wearing in the late summer probably isn't best, but in the late spring, it was perfect. Would absolutely recommend this dress!

Beautiful dress that made me feel beautiful in it. The dress was beautiful.  I ordered both the 10 and 12.  The 10 was a little tight around the chest so I went with the 12.  It was easy to move and dance in and I loved the pockets.
I got so many complements--the fabric was so beautiful up close.  I sized up and was glad I did; the dress was a perfect length with heels and so beautiful close up and in person.

Not for the short torso! BEAUTIFUL GOWN! I would recommend this gown to anyone with one caveat - this is not for those with a short torso. As pictured, the torso is fitted through and slightly below the waist. For me, it hit at the hips, which just caused the dress to flow right over my hips...with extra volume. However, I'm a 34DD/36D and a 29.5" waist, normally wearing an 8/10. This dress fit perfectly in through the waist. I would imagine it would flow nicely over the hips if I had a longer torso. I'm 5' 2" and front of the high-low hit just above the ankle. The back flowed just enough to skim the ground, but not drag as a real train. The pockets are wonderful though. The color is beautiful! It's hard to describe, but the damask embroidery just shimmers, and the blue is dark enough that the print is not overwhelming at all! It's truly beautiful, just wish I had a longer torso.

Made me feel larger than I am I did not end up wearing this dress. The fabric was amazing, the pockets were amazing, the back of the dress was amazing but the front view was too wide. I only weigh 113 lbs and I felt as tho there was too much fabric for my body.

The dress was stunning. <3 The most gorgeous dress I have ever worn.  Fell in love immediately online, and it was more beautiful than I pictured when it arrived.  I ordered a 2L and 4L (because there were no regular lengths in my size) and ended up wearing the 2L.  I used temporary hemming tape to tape it up about 5 inches all around.  The dress was heavy, especially with 5 inches of fabric hemmed around the bottom, but it was amazing.  No issues with the dress falling down while we danced at a long wedding reception, a perfect fit for a wonderful night.

I got tons of compliments I got the 8R and 10R, the 8R was too small in the bust but I felt to bottom fit better.  I wore the 10R but the armpit areas smelled a little like BO and the hem was coming out in the bottom of the dress.  I wore extra perfume and put some double stick tape in the hem to make it work, but I got lots of compliments

This dress was perfect for a wedding, and went well with military uniform as well! The fit was perfect.  I usually wear a size 2, however being 4 months pregnant I went with the 4L and it fit wonderfully!  I had so many compliments on this dress and I felt so glamorous.
Lovely fabric and easy to wear. I usually wear a 6 but wore a 4 with this dress.  It fit well but I went down a size. Very comfortable dress with pockets.

Beautiful Purple Dress for Fall/Winter event I wore this dress to Thanksgiving dinner and it was perfect. Fit great around the waist but also added a belt to give it some extra style.  The top fit great especially for me which I usually have trouble finding dresses that are fitted but still fit me in the top.  The pockets were an added bonus and the color was amazing! (The photos don't do it justice)  The back was cute with a cut-out, giving it more character.  So comfortable and got a bunch of compliments.  Would def recommend!

Got to see old friends!  I really liked the material for the dress and the fit. It even had pockets! It was comfortable and still very elegant. My only qualm was that I am about average height and it made me seem a little shorter without heels. I would have gone a size down to fix that.

Elegant, sophisticated dress, perfect for a formal wedding. A great dress for a formal wedding.  I received many compliments from other guests.  No need for a purse with the pockets and the fabric was absolutely beautiful.  Definitely will rent again.

felt like Joan from "Mad Men" This was the first dress I ever rented from RTR.  It was an awesome experience!  I had tried the dress first on at the showroom in NYC.  The dress came right on time and was perfect.  I got so many compliments about the dress, it was super comfy, and very flattering.

Perfect dress for a formal winter wedding! The dress fit great and was extremely comfortable all night!  I would recommend going down a size than what you normally wear. The dress also has pockets which is always a winner in my book! I am tall (5'8") so the dress hit me right at the knees which was perfect. Definitely recommend!

simple and classy This is the perfect cocktail Attire dress. I felt confident and poised because I knew the dress would be a hit, and the pockets give you something to do with your hands during awkward conversation lulls.

Great material  This was worn for rehearsal dinner. I was happy with the material and the fit, although I wish I would have gotten a 6.. It was a little big on straps. It's more purple than in the pictures online. I was happy with this dress. And the pockets were a great addition

The color is beautiful The dress is really nice.  If you have a larger chest like I do, you will need to find the right bra to wear, otherwise the dress fit is a little funky.  Surprisingly, a push up bra worked best. I am not a curvy girl and this dress made sure everyone knew that.  Overall a fine dress.

Classic, elegant, and perfect for the occassion Rented this dress for an October Wedding. 

I'm glad I read the reviews -- because the size 2 fit perfectly, when I am usually a 4/6. With this dress, go with your waist and bust measurement when selecting a size. I am 5'7, pear shaped, and the size 2 fit almost perfectly, falling to just about the same point right at the knee as it did on the model.  

I was a little disappointed when I first opened the box and saw that the dress was much more purple than it appeared to be on my computer screen, 

I also felt that the addition of the belt was necessary for me as I am long waisted and the waist on the 2 was just a touch too high. Overall a great dress -- I had several people tell me that I should buy it!

Classic and elegant - can I keep it?! Everything about this dress was stunning from the color to the feel of the fabric.  It's a generous cut; I'm usually a 10 or a 12 but I wore the 10 and could probably have worn the 8 if it had been available.  I paired it with a black shrug and nude patent heels and it was perfect for my friend's 40th birthday celebration.  If you're looking for a classic, elegant dress you can't go wrong with this one!  Excellent RTR experience all around.

I loved the dress and it even had pockets!   The top was tight on my bust.  It looked fine from the front, but looked pressed down and misshaped from the side.  The dress fit perfect otherwise.  Bright side: I didn't have to wear a bra (that is a happy time for big breasted girls) and I did get a lot of compliments on the dress.
perfect for a family wedding This was a great dress, but definitely ran a bit big, I had to use some strategic safety pins. Overall really pretty dress that stood out.

classy and elegant I got so many compliments on this dress, I wish I owned it! It fit perfectly, though admittedly, there isn't much give in the fabric overall. But the cut is flattering, flirty, and classy for any formal event. It isn't to short, and the material is gorgeous! I'd definitely recommend this dress!!

Runs LARGE After a dress I had ordered was not available, RTR overnighted this dress to me as a courtesy backup.  Print is much prettier in person.  Unfortunately the dress was HUMUNGOUS and there was no way I could make it work without swimming in it.  I ordered another dress for a wedding I was attending.
LOVED this dress! I got tons of compliments all night!  This dress fits extremely well and it very flattering. I loved how it was fitted at the top and A-line at the bottom. Great dress!

I loved this dress! Perfect for running around, sitting, eating, everything! I'm normally a 4 or a 2, typically a 4 but definitely ended up wearing the 2 in this, I didn't even try on the 4 that shipped as well! The dress fit perfectly through the bust, though it was a teeny bit big through my waist. It was perfect for the black tie preferred gala that I was both working and attending, since I couldn't handle a long dress and run around in it! Even though I'm 5'9'' the dress still went to right above my knee and was appropriate for work and I got a lot of compliments from guests at the event. The dress is definitely much more purple than it appears in the picture but the shade was very flattering, I just wish I had a picture!
Got a lot of compliments! Really comfortable dress, with pockets!

Amazing pattern and color! This dress was definitely a hit at the wedding that we attended. I received many compliments on the color, especially in the sunlight. I had to go down a size to make the top fit snuggly.

This dress was absolutely perfect for the wedding! Everyone was obsessed with the pockets!! The primary reason I chose the 8 over the 6 was that the 6 had a rough zipper and the 8 left room for a nice push up bra.  I dressed it up with sparkly jewelry and black heels with rhinestone flip flops later on.

I rented this dress to wear for my Christmas Party for work. Everyone loved this dress! This was my first rental from RTR. I read the reviews and ordered a size down for my backup dress and the size 4 fit perfectly.  The dress was both beautiful and comfortable. I also rented the necklace shown with the dress and it really made the outfit. I was impressed with how easy the process was and the careful packaging of the items and I will DEFINITELY rent again in the future!!

I felt like a million bucks in this dress! Great if you're a curvy girl. It fit beautifully and looked great from the front and the back. And it has pockets! This is a dress that I would definitely buy and wear over and over again.

Royally comfortable, extraordinary color, and love the pockets! I'd been searching high and low to find a purple dress to wear as a bridesmaid in my friend's wedding, but purple is a hard color to find! Fortunately this Yoana Braschi dress was perfection! The color in person is much more vibrant and purple than in the model photo. I normally wear a 4, sometimes a 6, but I could have worn a 2 in this dress. I felt like it was loose fitting all over, however, adding to the comfortability. It could easily be worn with or without a bra. The pockets we awesome - I was able to run around and dance, and have my phone handy for snapshots. The fabric is quite thick and heavy making me slightly warm while tearing up the dance floor. The cut was modest enough for a wedding, yet chic and stylish. I received many compliments on the dress; everyone loved it. I would highly recommend it and even wear it again!

Beautiful pattern and has POCKETS! As other reviewers have said this is fitted more to your bust size rather than the hips. I ordered the size I normally wear in jeans and it fit perfect on top and slightly big around the waist but not too big that I needed to go a size down. I loved the pockets on this and the vibrant color! The color on the picture doesn't show as bright as it really is. Would love to rent again or own this one!

Gorgeous Color / Easy to Wear A gorgeous, easy-to-wear dress that received tons of compliments throughout the night. A particularly good color for pale complexions. The top was a bit tight across the bust but the 2 wasn't available. I was very happy with this rental.

Gorgeous dress and fit so well!  I wore this to an evening wedding and it was perfect.  Fit fantastic for a girl with curves! Very flattering! And of course, the pockets were wonderful to keep lip gloss and phone. There was a very very small tear in the dress near the hem which I was barely noticeable. I emailed them right away so that they knew I did not cause the tear and RTR was great about it.

Perfect Dress This dress is amazing.  I'm actually debating buying it... that's how much I love it.  The fabric is gorgeous- really rich-looking.  I was at an Indian wedding and this dress actually held its own with the beautiful, colorful saris that most women were wearing.  As for size, definitely only pay attention to the 'top'- the bottom part is flow-y enough that it hides hips.  I am a 6 or 8 on top, but an 8 or 10 on the bottom, so I ordered an 8 and a 10.  The 8 was okay, but I think the 6 would have been better.  There is a little poofy-ness in the front (because of the pleat), but it's clear it's the dress and not your tummy.  (So this would be a great dress for someone hiding a baby bump because you definitely wouldn't notice.)  Highly, highly recommended!
Beautiful color, fabric and fit. Wore this dress for NYE.  Loved it!  Stood out from a sea of black.

Runs large, order one size down. I am normally a size 4 or 6 - depending on how well I behaved in the month prior. For this event, I was definitely in 6 territory. I read the reviews about this running big, so I ordered a 2 because RTR didn't have a 4 available. It was very tight, but I pulled it off. I would have definitely done well with the 4. 

Long story short, one size down and you'll be all set.
-- I did not end up wearing the dress because it was way too big.  However, it was beautiful!

Gorgeous fabric, flattering silhouette, and pockets!  Love it. I usually wear a size 10, but at the last minute that wasn't available, so I'm lucky & surprised how well my backup size 8 fit.  It felt pretty tight across my (36D) chest, but it looked good, and I was still comfortable enough to dance unrestricted.  I was actually able to wear it twice: first at a cocktail event for work, and the next night dressed up with sparkly jewelry and fancier shoes for a more formal wedding.  I got compliments at both.  The shimmery dark color is really beautiful without being overly flashy.  I was expecting it to be reddish maroon from the pictures, but in person it's more purple.

Super cute dress - loved, loved the pockets.  Unique at the event, which is hard to do! Definitely runs big as other reviewers have commented.  The only issue with the fit is that it was a bit short-waisted, so it puffed out a little bit right over the tummy.  It sort of fell right between an empire and a regular waistline on me, so that was a bit awkward.  A skinny patent leather belt helped, and I think was really necessary to define the waist better.  Overall, though, very comfortable, lots of compliments.

Gorgeous Colour, annoying fit. I rented both the 0 and the 2, and while the 0 fit better, the snug waist caused the front pleat to kick out more than desired (probably enough to trigger the 'when are you due' questions), so I went with the 2 so the front pleat chilled out a bit, addtionally I wore a thin black belt with it, and used fashion tape to seal the pleat for the first few inches. I adored the colour and print though, and was able to wear a regular bra.

Loved the dress! Tons of compliments! This dress was perfect for my body type - small bust/torso and large hips. I got tons of compliments on it and I loved the pockets. The pleats were a bit much in the front, but it didn't detract from the overall success of the look.
Loved it!  And loved discovering that it has pockets! The size and fit descriptions were quite accurate.  The dress was comfortable and flattering.

Gorgeous color but didn't end up wearing The picture on RTR does not do the color of this dress justice - so gorgeous. This is a great dress for pear shaped bodies. I am a 4 up top and 8 on the bottom, so I rented the 4 and 6. They both worked, but the 4 was better because it was actually more flattering. I ended up not wearing this because it was almost too poofy at the bottom for me, and I did have another dress in the closet that I could wear, but was bummed to waste the rental. 
It was a modest length too - I'm 5'8''

The color was better in person more of a purple. The size is true to fit. The dress fit perfectly. It came to my knees and is a little low in the front but I was ok with both. It was very comfy and has pockets! I got lots of compliments!
Very comfortable and received many compliments Fit true to my body type, hourglass shape

Mad Men Style with Pockets! This was my first RTR rental.  The dress was even more beautiful in person than I expected.  I usually wear a 6 or an 8, so those are the sizes I ordered.  However, I probably could have worn a 4.  The 6 was a tad big for me, so I added a skinny black suede belt and it looked perfect.  No one could tell that the belt was not part of the dress already, and even if I had the 4 I think I would have added the belt anyway just to further accentuate the flare of the dress.  The pockets were awesome. Even though I was carrying around my phone and wallet in them you couldn't tell.  I am 5'6' and the length was just about to my knees.  It wasn't too short or too long- it looked great with 4" heels and didn't even look too bad with the flats I changed into for the reception.  The dress did not appear in person to be quite as purple or have as much of a sheen as it did in photos, yet it still photographed very well.   I wore it with black sheer pantyhose, pearls and black wrap - it was classic yet modern at the same time.   I've never gotten so many compliments before!

The dress runs a bit large, so I ended up using the size down as the dress I wore. It was amazing! The dress runs a bit large, so I ended up using the size down as the dress I wore. It was amazing!
The pockets were deep enough for my phone, ID and money to hide in, so I didn't bring a purse.
I received a lot of compliments!

Almost fit While the dress was really pretty and well made, it didn't make it to the wedding.  Most of the dress fit fine, but it just wouldn't cover the girls if you know what I mean.  It would be very helpful to break down some of the dress description for not just "busty" girls but those of us who have the the challenge of larger than usual breasts.

Great color, great fit! Rented this dress as an emergency backup when the dress I had planned to wear didn't fit right and what a lifesaver! The fit was fantastic, not too loose not too tight, and I no clue that it had pockets! Wore this to a formal wedding and got tons of compliments.

First experience with RTR and it worked out great.  I wasn't excited about this dress at first but it ended up being a great find for a black tie optional event. The fabric is beautiful and the pattern makes it a little more exciting. I wore it with some nice sparkly earrings and I felt that was enough. I got lots of compliments especially on the pattern and color. Definitely runs larger, I'm glad I went a size down for backup. It hit jus above the knee in the front and lower in the back, which was very flattering. I would rent this dress again.

Perfect formal dress! I wore this for a formal wedding in Chicago.  I have 3 small children so I needed a formal dress that I could bend over, kneel down or chase after kids without feeling uncomfortable or showing too much!  This dress was checked all those boxes while still making me feel young and beautiful.  I was able to wear a comfortable t-shirt style bra (thicker straps) with the dress.  I kept asking my husband if the straps ever showed and they didn't all night.  The pockets are great also.  I got compliments all night and many more on photos I've posted.  The only negative I could think of with this dress would be if you are have a larger chest.  I'm on 36C and the size 10 dress fit perfect (just tight enough) but would probably be too tight for anyone with a larger chest.  Overall though, I give this dress 5 stars and highly recommend it!

I wore this to a cocktail party for my birthday. This ran a little big, I could have worn either size, but I felt more comfortable in my backup smaller one. The pockets were a great feature, I really liked having them, however I wasn't expecting to feel like there was extra fabric in the pocket area so the dress pooched a little in the lower stomach area. I received tons of compliments at the party! Great colors, comfortable and fun dress!

Super Cute! This dress was rushed to me after the one I ordered didn't fit. I called and talk to one of the reps and she was so helpful in helping me find another dress to rush. I felt great in this dress! Loved that it had pockets and it hid any imperfections I had. Over all I would recommend this dress!

Subdued enough to not be too flashy at a wedding, but NOT your little black dress! Loved the color. Loved that I didn't feel flashy, but wasn't wearing black (like most of the other wedding guests). The pleats in the middle accentuated my baby bump a little too much (since I haven't told anyone!) but would be perfect for someone who is 4-6months pregnant (or not pregnant- and not worried about a tummy). It has pockets, which was my favorite part. Will rent again!

A Great and Comfy Party Dress! I wore this for a festive and informal wedding in San Francisco. The construction is sturdy so I didn't need to wear a bra, and the silhouette is super flattering. I wish I could have kept it - it was so cute and comfy and I got a TON of compliments.

Fabulous fit and flare style and truly knee length on me! I tried this on at the Henri Bendel showroom and immediately knew it was the dress for my party. It's a little loose around the waist but I couldn't have sized down to an 8 without the chest being tight. I think it runs a bit large only because all of the other dresses I tried on that same night I need a 12 because I've gained some weight recently, and this was still loose in a 10. So definitely order two sizes if you can't get to the showroom. But the pockets, the length, and the gorgeous material made this a stand out and friends kept commenting all night on how pretty it was. I told all of them: "Rent the Runway, baby!"

I just rented this again for my brother's wedding...I got so many compliments on it and had to tell everyone there about Rent the Runway!

Amazing dress that made me feel like the belle of the ball!  And such an easy process! I had asked for the dress to arrive on Friday for a Saturday event and it actually arrived on Tuesday which was fabulous!  It gave me extra time to decide on what to wear with it.   I could have worn either of the 2 sizes - - one was a bit more roomy but both looked great.  This dress is so rich - the fabric looks like it might be heavy but it is light and airy.    The pockets were a very useful part of the dress.  You really can wear your own bra with this dress.   I am an hourglass figure person and the waist hit me at just the right spot.  In this day and age of the LBD, I had so many women (in LBDs!) come up to me and ask me about my dress.  In outdoor lighting, the hot pink in this dress can be a little scary for the conservative person but inside, it blends into a beautiful pink/purple hue.  I can't wait to rent again.  Thanks RTR!!

Beautiful pattern and color I got a 2 and 4 and ended up wearing the 2. It was still loose in the bust and waist and the length was just below the knees. I should've gotten a 0 but somehow I feel it would've been hard to breathe in a size 0. I do have a pretty long torso compared to most people so that could be the cause of the less than stellar fit. I LOVE that this dress has DEEP pockets! My keys went in without pulling the dress down or messing with the shape, it was great! There's a very slight high/low hem on the skirt which is cute. The little cut out in the back is just the right size and placement to allow you to wear a normal bra. And the purple is so much more vibrant than the picture shows, really gorgeous in the sunlight. I would totally rent this again, probably in a size 0 for a better fit :)

Great cut and print! I'm usually an 8, but the 6 fit just right. As an A cup I was intimidated, but the V cut isn't scandalous. Also a great length to keep it fun and flirty without having to worry about sitting/bending. It has POCKETS! Great experience because the dress is a low-key color with an elegant print- meaning I was able to look classy without effort. Heads'll turn when you wear this number.
Great experience, fun to shop, arrived on time, and easy to ship back. Received many compliments.  Fit true to size and loved the pockets. Color is great but more purple than photo indicates.

Was super comfortable and perfect fit for a night of wedding dancing!  The color was great, it is more purple in color than the picture appears. The fit was true to size, fitted through the waist. Super comfortable for a fall wedding, the hem is a little longer in the back which I was not expecting but it still looked great! Highly recommend this for semi-formal/weddings!

The material and color was fabs. However not for someone 5ft and below As I am 5ft the neck is large, even for a full busted girl like me. Also the lower half is too large and falls 2 inch below knee.

This dress was gorgeous, comfortable, and classy!  The fit was great! Comfortable, easy to move it. pro: it has pockets, stunning design, no need for special under garments. Many people were staring at me as I walked by!
A different dress for every occasion  Fabulous dress, has pockets for lipstick!!

It was cute for a wedding.  I rented both the 4 and the  6 bust is usually the deciding factor for me. I went with the 4 because the 6 made me look large and 4 was a little bit better of a fit.

Pros: It has pockets! I got a lot of compliments
Cons: I couldn't breath in the dress. It had no give to the bust or the waist so after I ate I was uncomfortable, after dancing for a bit I couldnt take a deep enough breath to catch my breath. I had to go to the bathroom to unzip the dress so I could catch my breath.

Great for a late fall or winter occasion Very comfortable and got lots of compliments.  Obviously I loved the pockets - who doesn't.  Even though it looks burgundy in the pics, it's definitely more purple.
Meh The fabric is lovely but the dress fits big and made me look frumpy. I didn't wear it.
This is a nice dress... Good fit. flattering.

Perfect for a bachelorette party in Vegas! This was my first time renting a dress and I was in need of a great Vegas bachelorette party outfit. This dress was perfect for the occasion! This dress does run big, so the small fit comfortably and was not too tight fitting. Past reviews said they were scratched under the arm by the sequins, but I did not experience this. Loved this dress and would recommend it!

Dancing Til Daylight Indeed! Perfect Bachelorette Dress! I wore this for Bachelorette Party! We were in Vegas and this dress made heads turn, I was walking through a casino and every single table had their heads turned. One person stopped me and asked if I was in a Pagaent and wanted to take a picture with me and my friends. Such a fun dress, I really did feel glamorous and it made me stand out from my group of friends as the obvious Bachelorette. The dress does have a lot more color on it than you think, got hints of red. I would recommend red pumps with this, it would just make it pop. My curvy ladies, go right ahead this dress is very forgiving despite the intense sparkle.
It was a great dress, got so many compliments! The fit was excellent and sometimes a little shiny when there are bright lights, but overall a fantastic evening dress!
This was the perfect Bachelorette party dress! I'm usually between a medium and large, the medium fit, but the large was more comfortable (and flattering)

This dress was great! I rented this for my bachelorette and I received a lot of compliments.  I can see what people were saying about it being scratchy under the arms, but I didn't find it to be too terrible.  I would certainly rent this one again!

So. Much. Fun. This dress made my night so much more fun! Although it was a little baggier than I wanted, it was still very fun and surprisingly comfortable. It was also a bit low cut but in my opinion when you are wearing a sparkly dress you might as well go for it! I have a pretty small waist and it was big through the rib-stomach-waist area but was pretty snug through the bum and top. I definitely think it runs a bit large.

This dress is super fun and it stands out in a great way! This was my first RTR and this dress was PERFECT! My backup was a Medium, so I had to wear the small even though it was too big on me. The XS would have been perfect. The dress was comfortable, the length wasn't too short, and I received so many compliments. A few times, I felt the sequins scratching me, like the other reviews talk about, but it didn't bother me much at all. This dress definitely stands out, in a great way!

REALLY FUN PARTY DRESS! I wore this or NYE.  I ordered a S & XS and wore the XS. It ran a little large.  I prefer this style of dress to be more form fitting and the S was a little to baggy in areas.  Like other reviewers I found the sequins to scratch my underarms a little, but it was not really bothersome.  I received so many compliments with this dress!  I would definitely rent it again.

Perfect Party Dress for the Holidays! This dress runs big and I'm happy I read the reviews before I picked the sizes to ship because an XS was the perfect fit for me. The only thing I didn't like about the dress is that it's a bit scratchy. Other than that, I felt like I had the perfect dress for the occasion!

Perfect Vegas Dress! This dress ran a little big for me. I am usually a size 6, 34 C bust and 5'2 and have never fit into an XS in my life, but when I got the dress the S was too big do I went with my backup size XS and it was still a little loose, but it worked. You could tell the dress had probably been worn a lot based on stretch, the dress fit mid thigh. However the dress was beautiful, all of the sequins were intact and I received so many compliments all night. This was the best bachelorette dress, perfect for standing out in a crowd!

Wore this dress for a night out with the girls in Vegas! Definitely ran big. I'm usually a size 6-8 and pear-shaped, so at first I rented the medium -- but it was almost baggy! If you have a smaller bust, I would rent the small.

This was a great dress for Las Vegas...I felt like a disco ball!  The fit was a bit tighter than I expected, probably because the sequins are clingy. Also shorter and more low-cut than I anticipated (but that was fine for Vegas!) Definitely need to weak Spanx to smooth things out. Otherwise, it was comfortable and fun for a long night out.

Wore this dress for my bach party in Vegas - really fun dress.  Perfect for a bach party, especially in Vegas. 
 ended up wearing the XS as I felt it ran a little big and while it hugged your body was not too tight. 
By the end of the evening the sequins became a little scratchy but other than that great dress.

Sexy, comfortable party dress! I wore this in Vegas out celebrating my birthday.  It was very comfortable and I felt so sexy.  I received a bunch of complments from complete strangers.  I would highly recommend this dress.

The size small was not available so I tried on a medium which was pretty baggy.  I didn't think the extra small would fit, but the dress was so stretchy it fit perfectly.  It hugged all my curves and I wasn't spilling out anywhere.  Definitely a great dress for an hourglass figure.

Beautiful sleek dress Wore it to my bachelorette party and loved every second of it. I did not find the sequins to be uncomfortable under my arms as other reviews had mentioned. The dress does run large where even the XS still had extra room in the chest/waist and hips for me. It was very flattering and absolutely perfect for my big night out. I had many compliments on the dress throughout the night. It photographs well even in darker settings.

The dress was amazingly sparkly, with multi colored sequins which was great! I got the extra small and back-up small and I was swimming in the extra small. If you're petite or less than 120 lbs. I do NOT recommend this dress. Otherwise, if you're on the curvy side-- go for it! We were celebrating my bachelorette weekend with a "sparkle" night and this dress fit the bill!

Not my style It kind of just hung on me without emphasizing my curves. It's a really popular dress, and it seems to look great on a bunch of different gals and body types. But, I wasn't one of them. I ended up wearing my back-up dress.

Perfect Vegas dress - got tons of compliments from dudes Very comfy, has pinky colored sequins that can't be seen in the photo that make this dress look expensive and classy. I wore this with coral colored pumps.

This dress was so cute and comfy! Pros: I loved this dress for being so comfortable. It was fitted without being tight. I didn't even need spanx. The v-neck also and short length also gave it just the right amount of sexiness.
Cons: At the end of the night, I had so many little cuts on my arms and legs from the sequins. I'm not sure if this can be avoided since the dress is sleeveless and short.

I wore this to a Vegas-themed party and love it! I rented the small and medium, both fit but the small hugged my curves a bit better. This is a stand out party dress! This was my first time using RTR and have to say it was a great experience and I'll definitely use this service again!
Perfect for Vegas Wedding Beautiful dress.  Fun and sparkly!  Very comfortable for dancing the night away.

I WAS THE SPOTLIGHT AT MY 30TH BIRTHDAY PARTY! This dress is AMAZING!! I wore it to my 30th birthday party at an upscale rooftop lounge in NYC. It was PERFECT for the venue and literally made heads turn - which is exactly what I was going for! The dress definitely runs big as everyone says, so go for the size smaller. When you put it on, you understand why it's a designer dress. It sparkles like crazy and completely lights up a room. Women came up to me at the club and commented on how much they loved my dress. I then had to share my RTR experience with them! Of course, men also approached me and commented on how beautiful I looked! All in all, I picked the perfect dress for the occasion. If you want to sparkle and stand out, I definitely recommend this dress. You will not be sorry!

The dress is beautiful, but the sequins scratch your arms. I really loved this dress when I put it on. I was going to wear it for my Bachelorette Party and loved all the sparkle and sequins. However, within minutes of wearing it, I could tell that my arms would be rubbed raw by the sequins. While the dress fit amazingly and looked great, I decided to wear my backup dress instead so that I could be comfortable.

Perfect for my birthday! This dress is hot!  I felt like all eyes were on me all night.  Perfect for my birthday! Just a warning--the sequins are scratchy on your arms, so be prepared for some red marks the day after.

Bachelorette Party Perfection It was my bachelorette party and I wanted something that would make me feel that way. This dress was perfect. It was sparkly, a little bit low cut, mid-thigh and I could wear a regular bra with it. The sequins didn't irritate my underarms which was a bonus.
I did get one dress with a snag in it which wasn't fixable on my end. I left a message with the RTR stylists and the next day they shipped me a new one for Saturday delivery just in time! Great customer service!
GREAT bachelorette party dress!!!!! This dress was perfect for my bachelorette party.  Super sparkly with hints of red and green.  Definitely runs small. I'd recommend 100%.

Perfect dress for my bachelorette party!  Fit perfectly without being too tight. Material was comfortable and you could breathe because it is stretchy.  Sexy without being too low cut. Perfect! Would also recommend for NYE!

Awesome Party Dress! This dress is so fun and comfortable! It does run large though! I read several reviews recommending to size down and I'm glad I did. I usually wear a 4 or 6 and I got the small and extra small. The small was fine but it was a little bunchy so I went with the XS. The dress does have a little bit of reddish/pink in the sequence so I paired some fun pink heels to match! Overall really happy with this rental and got tons of compliments!

Fun party dress! Size ran large.  I wore this dress for my bachelorette party. It was the perfect party dress! I ended up wearing leggings and a jacket because the color of the dress with my skin tone made me look very washed out. I really loved the final look though. The dress does run large. I ended up wearing a S but could have worn the XS if I had it. Overall, it was comfortable to wear all night. It didn't ride up. I loved the sequins in all the pictures!

Bachelorette Party Dress - Stunning! Loved this dress on me! Like many reviewers said - runs big! Nonetheless - the small fit me great! Just what I was looking for for my bachelorette party! Showstopping dress! Would definitely recommend!
Bachelorette Perfection! I rented this to wear to my good friend's bachelorette party and it was perfect!  The sequins started to cut into my skin after a while, but overall it was totally perfect!
Great for the Grammy Awards. Relaxed fit.  Only problem was sitting on sequins.

Fabulous Birthday Dress! This dress was so fun and fabulous!  I got tons of compliments on my birthday and it was perfect for celebrating in Las Vegas.  It was pretty big, I ordered a S and M and ended up wearing the S but I could have worn an XS had I ordered it.  The only negative to this dress is the sequins material really rubs the insides of your arms - I had a lot of red marks the next morning.  Ouch!  Thanks Rent The Runway for making my birthday great!  My friend also rented and wore Herve Leger in this photo.
Loved It! Loved it!!! Fun! So many compliments;))

Wore the dress to a Christmas party! This dress definitely runs large. I ordered an XS and a S, expecting the S to fit, but I still had some wiggle room in the XS. The dress has a stretchy component to it, which made is super comfortable! Also, unlike many sparkly dresses I've worn, the dress did not scratch underneath my arms at all. I received complements all night long. Would definitely rent again! Great dress if you want to stand out.

Comfortable fit except a little itchy under the arms. Fun dress, got lots of compliments I normally wear a size 10, but there was still some room in the medium. I wore this for my bachelorette party and it was the perfect combination of dressy, fun, and comfortable. I highly recommend it.

I wasn't able to wear the dress, it was too big. But RTR made the exchange super easy! I tried it on before the trip and the dress does not really have a waist, it kind of goes straight down, maybe because I have small breasts.  It was baggy, an extra small might have fit better.
An amazing dress for an amazing night with my sorority sisters! Great dress, a little long, pretty deep v neckline, a fantastic dress!

I rented this dress for my friend's 40th Zumba party which has motif of black, silver and hot pink.  I wanted to look different from the crowd  coz i know most of the guests will wear LBD.  This definitely stands out, its silver with a little twist which I love! Very elegant and comfortable with it did not have any negative complaints.
This is my second time using the rent the runway and definitely my experience is seamless.

I want to own this dress. Loved it-- from the length, to the v-neck, to the spangles everywhere!  I've been looking for it to purchase and can't find it, which is truly disappointing.  I styled it with a black jacket, black tights, suede heels and red lipstick and it was a stunner!
I wore this for my bachelorette, and it was PERFECT!  Runs large. Definitely take advantage of picking two sizes to rent. I am a 4 or 6 dress size, depending on the designer. The XS fit perfectly.

Awesome dress for party or NYE! I rented this dress for my Stanley Cup Halloween costume and it was perfect! It definitely runs a little large, I am normally a 6 and the small was even a little big. It hugs in all the right places and I got lots of compliments all night! You can wear a normal bra with it which is nice.
Great Vegas dress for my bachlorette  Very stretchy and comfortable. Def runs big so order a size down. Loved it!
This dress was perfect for NYE!  I wore this to a NYE party. I loved the fit of the dress, and the length was perfect. Thanks RTR!!

THE SPARKLE OFF THIS DRESS IS AMAZING ONCE IT HITS THE LIGHT !!! STRETCHY FIT WAS GREAT ! THE DRESS WAS WAYYYYY SHORTER THAN EXPECTED,  BUT DIDNT RISE ALOT. THE WAS A LIL LONGER BUT TOO LOOSE IN THE MID SECTION. DISAPPOINTED IN HOW QUICK THE DRESS FALLS FLAT WHEN NOT UNDER LIGHTS, BUT ONCE LIGHTS HIT THE DRESS, IT IS A PARTY WITHIN ITSELF !!! EXAMINED THE DRESS CAREFULLY HRS PEIOR TO THE EVENT AND NOTICED MISSING SEQUINS IN THE TOP CHEST AREA SO CHECK FOR THIS DAY PRIOR TO YOUR EVENT. OVERALL GREAT SHOWSTOPPING DRESS !!!

Bachelorette success Like a lot of other reviewers, I chose this dress for my bachelorette party and it was perfect- flashy and flattering but still comfortable for dinner and dancing all night long. I got a lot of compliments all night long and felt pretty and sexy but still classy and modest enough, although I'm tall so the dress was about mid-thigh on me. I wore the small and it was perfect. The dress is the right amount of stretchy so it can be form fitting and forgiving at the same time. I loved it! I hope many other bachelorettes have the opportunity to enjoy it as much as I did and add to all the fun it's seen ;-)

I wore this for my new years party and I was the sparkly center of attention. It actually ran a little large for me but was still cute. I had a hard time pairing shoes with it though. Very classy and worked well with my full bust.

Dress stood out from all others! I wore this dress to a bachelorette party and it was perfect for going out! I received so many compliments from both guys and girls. The dress was the perfect length and fits really nicely to the body.

Customer service was excellent! Great dress, received compliments all night!  

 This dress was perfect for my cousin's bachelorette party! I ordered a small but felt it was a little big on top. Other than that it was comfortable and fun!

Compliments all night long! Perfect in Vegas, felt very pretty, and stood out from the crowd!!  Runs large, the xs was a little bit looser than I hoped, but ended up being super comfortable and easy to dance in. Sequins rub under your arms, but after a few drinks I didn't notice it anymore.

It was an amazing dress for an amazing bachelorette party! You will not be disappointed.  I ordered both the small and medium. I opted to wear the small because the medium was a little to baggy for a night out on the town. This dress made my boob look amazing probably due to being able to wear an actual bra with the dress. It was a little itchy under the arms but I didn't notice it much.

Compliments all night long!!! I wore this dress to a fraternity formal and I wanted something fun, flirty, and sexy. Check. Check. Check. LOVED this dress. I have a true hourglass figure so it is IMPOSSIBLE to find clothes and I was really nervous to order this, but I had to try it. I was relying on another dress being what I wanted so this was the back-up. Loved the other dress, but this actually fit me perfectly!!! Like it was made for me. I have huge boobs and hips and a butt, but I have a tiny waste and with the exception of my bra strap playing peekaboo ever so often (that was my fault, cause I forgot one of my convertible bra straps) I had no problems. I am 5'11" so the dress was very short, but I had no "Brittney" problems. The dress is a tiny bit itchy with the sequins, but if you are drinking at all you'll forget all about it. 

I got so many compliments from boys and girls all night long. Guys were even going up to my date telling him how lucky he was! Loved this dress and I may even rent it again!

Styled with Chamak bangle bracelets and my own amethyst snake bracelet diamond hoops and some red patent leather Stuart Weisman pumps with a silver Calvin Klein clutch.

I felt AMAZING for NYE! I was worried this dress would be too short, but it turned out to be perfect.  When I put the whole outfit together, I felt like I looked exactly the way I wanted to for NYE!  I felt amazing in this dress, but only gave it four stars because I didn't think it photographed as well as I'd hoped.  It seemed especially unflattering around my midsection (below my waste/above my hips) in photos even though I thought it looked great in person.  Still, a fabulous dress!  Just make sure you suck in where you need to for photos :)
Cute Dress Fit perfectly, but was a little too heavy for a nightclub. Meant for a good cocktail party dress as it is lined heavily and the sequins are heavy.
The sparkles were fun!  It fits very large in the waist. I normally were an 8 or 6 in dresses, and I had to wear the small. It is also super short, but very cute!
LOVEEE this dress!  Loved everything about this dress! Runs a lil big but very comfortable!
Not for Wallflowers! All eyes will be on you in this dress, like being a human disco ball!  Wore for Vegas bachelorette.  Super fun, very comfortable, true to size.

OMG I LOVED LOVED LOVED THIS DRESS! This was my first RTR experience and I was EXTREMELY happy! I rented this dress for my Bachelorette party out in Boston, MA. The dress does run large I ordered a Small and Medium and could have really worn either but the small was a little more fitted which I liked better. The material is stretchy and despite other comments it didn't scratch under my arms. I recieved SO many compliments on this dress and wanted to keep it to wear again! I would definately recommend this dress to anyone looking for a HOT dress for a night out on the town and I will absolutely use RTR again.

Perfect for a night out in Vegas! I wore this dress for a night out in Vegas. It was PERFECT! I got so many compliments and I felt great in it. I wore an XS, typically I am either a S or XS and the XS fit well, maybe even a little loose. It's a little more low cut than I am use to but was able to wear a normal bra with it so that was super convenient and comfortable. I would definitely recommend this dress!

This was a great dress that I wore to my veterans dinner. I received many compliments! Pros:
Great length
Warm for a fall evening

Con:
Maybe they can offer an XL, it fit me like a glove but if I was a lb over I would have had issues
n/a This dress is short. I'm 6'0 and it was too short on me. I had a medium and a large. I am usually a size 6, but the medium was too small.

My amazing dress from Rent The Runway made my event perfect!  The fit of this dress was perfect! It was true to size and looked great on my body. I would not change one thing about this dress. I am so happy I chose this dress for my event, I looked absolutely amazing and got so many compliments. THANK YOU RENT THE RUNWAY!

Tons of compliments, very unique Great dress. I'm 5'2" 109lbs but i'm very athletic which made the xs, which is the size i would normally wear, too tight in the arms. Also as a mom i thought the Small provided a little more length. Runs really short i think. Dress is comfortable and easy to move in. Also pretty warm.  overall, i got tons of compliments and had lots of fun in it.

My husbands first response "Wow! Sexy!" LOVE IT
 Mini sums it up for length. Material is sweater-like perfect for winter. Sewing top notch. If ever "on sale" let me know because I LOVE this dress

Perfect for semiformal! This was my second time renting I fell in love with this dress but they were out of any of the sizes I wanted to order as a backup. I decided to ordered this in a Small and another dress as a backup. Luckily, this dress fit perfectly and the other dress didn't end up fitting. Since I'm only 5'2, I was okay with the other reviews saying it was short and it was the perfect length on me! I was also happy that it was so thick because it was 42 degrees the night of my sorority's semi formal. I wouldn't advise renting this dress for anyone who's tall or if it's going to be warm but it's great for anyone who's relatively petite and if the weather's a little cooler!

Sexy and stylish! I wore this dress during a vacation to New Orleans. The material is thick, so it is good for a cooler night. I usually wear size XS or S in shirts and dresses. Even the small was very tight and short on me, so I paired it with black tights. Overall it is a great dress for a fun night out.

My rental came on time, and the return process was so easy! I wore the dress for my birthday party and got lots of compliments. The material was very warm and worked out well for a party in the middle of the winter in NYC. On the shorter side but I like that in a dress and found that other reviewers were accurate
Gorgeous dress! Was short already and the slit in the back made me slightly self-conscious but overall was a great choice!

acceptable, but never again I rented the XS and S, expecting to wear the XS. However, I could only manage to put the XS on halfway! So I went with the S. Like other renters have described, the dress is very thick and heavy. I was pretty warm all night long. Overall, I was pleased with the dress, but I think I would have been more comfortable in something else.

Not what I expected I had such high hopes for this dress when I saw it in the picture. Unfortunately, the fabric and the cut of the dress don't compliment a curvy figure. It seems best suited for girls with straight up and down figures/ boy figures. The dress grabbed me around the hip/thigh area, and was way too loose up top. The fabric was so much heavier than I had anticipated, even despite reading the reviews. Overall, it was just uncomfortable and unflattering. Beautiful print, but not for everybody.....

Perfect dress I usually am an XS or a 0. I had to wear the small because it was so short. I could have worn the XS based on the arms and chest but it def was short. Loved it! Got lots of compliments and I stayed warm because it was an outside wedding. Maybe not an ideal dress if it would have been warmer.

Cozy and gorgeous fit.  The dress fit true to size, if a bit snug in chest and hips. It was a little shorter than expected, but looked fine with tights. 

It was a very warm dress, so it was perfect for the colder season. I wish I could own it!

Sexy long-sleeved number Absolutely love this dress. Nice, thick fabric, very flattering on, and as with every RTR dress, got tons of compliments. The most important thing to know about this dress is it is VERY SHORT. I am 5'8" and had to size up to the M so it would cover my assets. I probably won't rent it again because of that, but it is soooo cute on. For anyone who isn't as tall as me, you can't go wrong with this one.

Flattering formal dress Wow- amazing dress! Super flattering and looks great in pictures. Was perfect for a winter formal! Does run very small though - I couldn't even get the medium on and the large was still pretty short on me, but I still loved it.

Difficult item to wear unless it fits perfect If I were to go a size up the waist and top portion wouldn't fit right but the small kept bunching up making my waist look like it had a poof. Overall, it was great if you didn't move.

Perfect balance of long sleeves and short length True this dress is very short, but not inappropriately. The dress is a nice thick material, I wouldn't recommend it for a night in a club, as it would be too hot. I'm usually a size 4, sometimes I'm a 6. In this dress I wore the medium, and it was a little tight on my bust. Overall, I would rent this dress again, and my fiance loved it.
Classic sofistication great but fit really tight. had to wear tights because it was so short

LOVE this dress. Awesome print I received this dress from the fit pack program. When I saw this was one of the dresses I was getting I couldn't wait to try this one on. I am a big fan of Parker dresses. The dress looks amazing on the hanger but it was sure tight on! I am larger busted and have an hourglass shape and should of tried on a medium instead of a small.
