The dress is short and sexy which is great for a night out especially in the winter. The material that the dress is made out of is very thick and warm. The sleeves were a little long on me but that didn't bother me. This is a hot dress!

NYE 2014 with RTR! Thank you RTR for helping me start a New Year looking Beautiful!!!  I rented this dress in an XS with a Small as my back up. I use to be an XS and now wear a Small but i wanted to decide for myself which size I'll wear depending on the fabric of the dress and whatnot. 
Two days before I'm suppose to receive my rental, RTR had a situation where the size Small got damaged so they quickly contacted me and updated me with the back up plan. They sent me the XS in the dress and upgraded me to another style in a Small. I was so worried because I really wanted to wear Parker Blanche Sheath; I loved it so much I had rented it over a month in advance.
I'm just so glad I was able to squeeze into the XS and make it look good!
FIT: It might be tight at first but once you spend time in it it'll stretch slightly (to my benefit)
Good if you are in between sizes
 I'm a short person so I LOVED that the dress is SHORT (Mini Dress)
This dress was perfect for me!!!
PROS: The style is absolutely STUNNING and EYE CATCHING! Most importantly WARM for this time of year! RIGHT ON!
Again, Thank You RTR for making everything possible for me to enjoy my event! Will rent again for sure ;D

I wore this dress for New Years Eve Definitely go a size up with this dress. I am 5'6'', 124 lbs. and I thought a Small would be the perfect size but I couldn't even get it on but the Medium fit perfectly. It is very warm and pretty thick material but after about 10 minutes in the dress it became very comfortable. I got a lot of compliments and I think the dress photographs very well. I wasn't as in love with it as I hoped I would be but I did really love it in photos.
Wore this to an LA fashion week party in Beverly Hills! A little bit of stretch with the material but not much, fit true to size.
It was just PERFECT! It fits like a glove! The fabric is bit thicker than expected (for Florida) but Overall LOVED it!
Wore it in Chicago Great fit, super flattering, got tons of comments! Wore it to a formal date party in Chicago.

So many compliments! I wore this dress for a formal date party in November.  The material was really thick and sweater-like, which was perfect for the cold weather. It also hugs your body but since the material is so thick and there's a big pattern, it's not bad at all! 

Definitely recommend it!!

Very short (especially if you move) and very thick This dress looks great on both myself and my roommate. The fabric is very thick. If I were renting this in the winter in a colder state then I would love that feature. But I live in SoCal and the temperatures have been in the high 70s to 90s ever since I received this dress. So I haven't been able to wear it comfortably.

It is also very short. Short dresses aren't a problem for me and I wear them all the time (only young once, right?) but because this fabric is so thick and because it is long-sleeved, the fabric doesn't cling to the body at all so it has no staying power. Basically, it rides up immediately when you move. Some black tights underneath fixed this problem BUT again it was already too warm to wear this so with tights I couldn't even handle being in my air conditioned apartment. Plus, adding tights makes it look a little dowdy.

Such a flattering dress, and I recieved so many compliments! Please note that the material of this dress is very thick! It is almost sweater-like, so do not wear in warm temperatures. Also, I fit into the size small, but the medium was just a bit more comfortable. The fabric is very stretchy. Overall, the dress was a huge success.
Didn't end up wearing it, it was heavy and the weather was too hot.  Runs short, tight, and small. The other x-small I had from here was way too big, this one was too short to be work acceptable.
The dress is thick in material but is always a knock out. I have rented it twice and I have loved it The fit is true to size however it is very short! perfect mini dress!
Perfect for the business party I went to, wore it with black booties and got so many compliments pros its very warm

Amazing! I loved the dress! It was very thick material and perfect for a party that was partially outside. However, it was really short! I read another review and got the M as my backup size, but it ended up being just as short as the S.

Charity event in the fall This dress was amazing! Fit me perfectly! The dress is a little short which was totally fine with me. The quality of this dress was amazing. I would absolutely rent this again. Definitely not for a hot  outside even though as the material is heavy. Great RTR!!

I received lots of compliments on my dress!! The small and the x-small fit the same, except the small had longer sleeves which I didn't like because I would have had to fold them under and the x-small was about an inch shorter in length. It was probably a tad short on me because I have longer legs and shorter torso.  The dress is kind of thick and warm but since it is February, it was ok.  It was easy to move around in it too because it stretches. I wore this to my Winter Formal.

Surprisingly tight I forgot to select a backup size (I wish RTR would prompt you with an "are you sure?") so I was stuck wearing the Medium when I truly needed a Large.  The Medium barley zipped, but still looked pretty decent.  The dress is short, really thick, and would have been perfect on me one size up.  I'd definitely rent this style again.

Little White Dress This dress is great but extremely short. I had to wear the large because the medium sized dress' zipper was broken. I would have preferred wearing the snugger medium but had to stick with the large. The length of the dress, however, was the same size for both. I had to pull the dress down a little bit as I was dancing but didn't mind it overall. A great dress for a late fall/winter event!
Rented for a High School Reunion I ordered this in a Medium, along with backup dress (thank god), and unfortunately couldn't wear it! Way too small. It's so cute, wish it had fit.
Warm and comfy for a winter party This dress was incredibly comfortable and flattering. The material is also pretty thick, which made it nice for a winter event. I loved it!

loved it. Great fit. Was a little short for my taste, but still loved it. the dress was very form fitting,  was a little short but for the party I went too was perfect. It was great for the winter the dress was very thick.

This design is very figure flattering! Good dress to wear in fall weather or winter. I had to wear leggings underneath of this dress because the length is quite short. I wore the dress with heels, but I am only 5'4", and thought it would have been borderline inappropriate at the wedding reception had I not worn the leggings.

Perfect Dress for Perfect Night!
 This dress is so beautiful! It is a very tight/short dress, so if you are wearing it to a more professional occasion, i recommend sizing up! It's also incredibly warm, walking in sub 20 degree weather was NOT an issue! I got so many complements and felt truly beautiful!

Short party dress! Super comfy. I'm 5'9", 140lbs, athletic, DD boobs (not real, hehe). Large was perfect but VERY short. Just make sure its a night event and sitting everywhere isn't required. Fun dress and lots of compliments. I'm usually a Medium, but glad I got the Large as back up.

Perfect fit, super comfortable, slimming in all the right places!  I am only 5'2 and this was pretty short on me, so long-legged ladies keep that in mind! I wore this to my office holiday party and I got so many compliments. It is quite thick, as others have stated, so also keep that in mind. I would HIGHLY recommend this dress!
It was my birthday, so I loved dressing up. Made me feel so special to wear a beautiful dress.  It's quite thick, so it worked perfect for colder weather. I added tights to wear under

Unique design. A size up WILL be needed.  Nice dress but I didn't have much luck with sizing. The the material doesn't give at all. I'm a slim women and I had to get two sizes up from what I usually wear. Pattern very unique.Very heavy material so this dress is perfect for fall/winter events.

Absolutely loved this dress.  Super comfortable and got tons of compliments!!! The dress is quite thick but can be worn in most seasons. The dress also runs rather short, so watch out. I am  5'8 and wore it to a rehearsal dinner but it was still appropriate.

Fun party dress!  Loved this dress.  I wore it to a friend's winter wedding in Pennsylvania.  The dress is thick and perfect for a winter event.  I usually wear a size small, but the dress is very short, so I opted for the medium.  If you if are taller, I would recommend ordering a size up.
Very warm fabric Tight fitting but sleeves fit well and great for warmth!

Gorgeous for winter, but very short! I really wanted this one to work, but it was far too tiny for a wedding event where I'd be dancing. I love the design--it's just so special--but even the large is short and would ride up. Probably best for a fancy dinner event.

Such an awesome pattern!  This dress was super comfortable! The fabric wasn't as thick as I thought it would be but I sure did not need a coat. While dancing in it I got a little hot so I would advise against wearing it to an active event. The pattern is so different then anything I have seen before and thats why I gravitated towards this dress. It was a great fit and looked awesome in pictures! I got so many complements on it!

Fun NYE! Rented for NYE - I wanted to stay away from the glitzy but still wear something fun and this was it!  It was super thick so no coat needed, but paired it with tights.  As mentioned in some other reviews it is short so be careful if you're tall - I'm only 5'3.  It was tight - I wore my normal sizing but could have probably worn the 2 and be fine as well.  It sucked everything nicely.

Got a TON of compliments! This dress was great for a February wedding.  The material is very heavy, so I was able to wear it without a jacket.  It is exactly as short as it looks, though, so be aware.  It was a bit tight, but I loved the dress, so I made it work.

Love how edgy it was!  For starters, being 5'9" and wearing a short dress is always tricky, but this dress was truly AWESOME. It did tend to ride up a little and i noticed by the end of the night the bottom flared out a little bit, which was a little annoying but not a huge deal. Another little thing is the arms are tight, I have muscular arms and it definitely was tight trying to put on, but i feel like the fabric gave a little by the end of the night. THE FABRIC IS THICK. Almost as thick as a saddle blanket, but I felt that since the dress was so short it all balanced out. Overall, awesome dress to shake up the fashion scene at prom.

Cute I liked the dress a lot but it was too heavy/thick material to wear for an early fall dance. It would be a perfect dress for winter. It was a little short though so if I rented again I would get a bigger size

Perfect for a winter wedding! I wore this for a wedding that was in Breckinridge, CO in the early spring, so it was still cold outside.  The dress was comfy, sexy, and the thick fabric kept me warm.  I wore the medium just for length, the small fit, but was short and I didn't want to have to fuss with it all night.
This dress was perfect! So cute!! Super short but other than that true to size

I had been eyeballing this dress on RTR for months. I finally caved and rented it and love it!  The dress is a stretchy material and form fitting and like other reviews it is a warm material. I would recommend this dress for an winter event or outside event because it does get hot. I wore black leggings and knee boots with the dress and it complemented it well. I can wear a 2 or 4 and ended up wearing the 4 because like I said it is very form fitting. I received compliments all night and the next day there was a photo of Emily from the Bachelorette wearing this dress so it made me feel super trendy to be spotted in this dress when she wore it the next day.

It was the best dress I have ever worn! I got more compliments in this dress than ever before! I usually wear xs/s but I could have gone medium which I literally have never worn before. It's that short and tight!!

Birthday dress Everyone loved this dress however I was a bit uncomfortable in it. The material was very very thick and made me so hot. I also have a pear shaped figure and this made me look wider in the hips. Additionally, I am very chesty and it barely zipped up the back where the material was stretched so tight around my boobs.

I rented this style for my birthday.  I ordered a 4, but probably would have been more comfortable in a 6. I'm a bit fuller on top so it was a little tight. The material was very thick, so perfect for a cold, winter night, if your on the east coast, but unfortunately, I'm in LA so I was a bit warm. The dress was also a little short and kept riding up from time to time, but I received many compliments.
Cute, unique, flattering Nice an thick, I had to pull it down constantly but otherwise else it was perfect. Would have appreciated longer sleeves but that's just my arms :).
My favorite part was the color. I was skeptical about red but it stands out! If you have big hips or thighs I'd recommend spanx because this dress extenuates that area
This was a great dress and the color works for many seasons It's pretty long. I am 5'7" and a 3" heel was needed.

The dress was amazing!  It is perfect for any occasion that you truly want to stand out! The dress fit true to size!  I am 5'9, and RTR recommended I rent the long, but it was way too long!  Go with the regular unless you plan to wear super high heels!  Otherwise it was perfect!

Great dress for my event This dress was so pretty! Great color. I'm a blonde and never wear red so I was nervous that the color would look cheap. It did not. I would definitely recommend to a first timer if they are nervous about sizing. It is a simple dress but looked great in photos and how do you not get attention wearing red!? Bodice is very structured and the skirt just hangs on you in a really beautiful way. I could see this being best fit for girls who are a B-C cup. Being so structured a flat chested woman would need a serious push up bra to fill the space and a large chested woman wouldn't have any stretch to work with.
Cf gala extravaganza  Fit was great. Had to go up to the 6 but I think that was my fault, not the dress. Very long so wear high heels. Color popped and all in all I was very happy with my choice.

Beautiful Dress This dress is a beautiful color- a vibrant red- and is a great chiffon material.  It is a gorgeous dress and would recommend it.  I wore a 0R and it was still a little long on me even with my highest heels (prob 4 inches and I'm 5'3 or 5'4).  It was also a tad bit large on the top, but not enough to make it an issue.  Highly recommend!
The customer service! Absolutely loved this dress, the red is so vibrant and radiant. I ordered a 6 and 8R, ended up going with the 8. The picture is me in the 6.

I absolutely LOVED this dress! It fit perfectly and was exactly what I wanted! :) I got a 6L because I am tall and it worked perfectly. It fits true to size and was everything I could have imagined. I really wanted to wear red and I wanted the sweetheart cut so I got this dress and could not have  been more pleased.

Super happy with how renting a dress turned out After trying on loads of different dresses in stores, I never found the perfect one. So I am so pleased I found out about RTR. I ordered two different dresses and this one was my favorite. It was a little big around the bust area but I felt super comfortable in it and it was easy to really enjoy my night because of it. Thanks RTR for helping me out!

i didn't end up wearing this dress. i didn't end up wearing this dress only because it felt a little too fancy for the wedding i attended. also, i'm 5'11" so i thought the extra length would be perfect but unless you're planning on wearing tall shoes (which i wasn't) you'd be tripping over the hem all night. gorgeous dress just don't know where i could wear this.

It was very simple and elegant.  Just perfect. The dress fit amazing, it flowed perfectly from the rib-chest area and was very soft.  The fabric was beautiful.  The color is as it is in the photo, very bright and vivid.  The only tiny issue was the bust area.  It was a little tight around the armpits and stuff, and I ordered a 10 just in case the 8 wasn't amazing, and it was too big, so the 8 was just a little snug but it wasn't bothersome at all.  Other than that it was just perfect.  Now, I'm 5" 6' 1/2, and I wore 5 inch heels.  It was perfect length.  I still kinda needed to pick it up when dancing but it was FABULOUS overall. The small chest details make the body look slimmer and the bust look curvier.  Amazing dress :D!

this service was crazy convenient and I'm so satisfied with my choice! fit was great, it's a little long at first but with the exception of 3-4" heels it's totally fine. I got compliments all night long!
Loved the color and the fit. A tad too long even with very high heels, but still took them off to dance no didn't trip or get the bottom dirty.  Beautiful dress!
Everyone loved this dress! I got so many compliments! Fit true to size. I was very comfortable in it and don't have any complaints!
Perfection! Fits the curves, hides the flaws
Other reviewers are spot on Lovely dress, great color, highly recommend!
This dress was very flattering and the color was beautiful in person and in photos.  I wore the 2. I almost went for the long, but the regular hit the floor perfectly with 3 1/2 in. heels.

Great customer service and a beautiful dress!  Dress fits true to size and the color is amazing. The zipper requires man power to zip but otherwise, a beautiful dress. Decided on a primary color scheme with blue tassel earrings and a yellow bracelet.
Fantastic color and it hung wonderfully. Lots of compliments, it made me feel like a movie star.     It was  very comfortable, and elegant. A classic lovely style.
The dress fits amazingly! I felt like a princess the whole night.  Runs a little long
Classic & easy I wore this to a black tie wedding.  The fit was very flattering and would easily fit different body types.  The dress was comfortable and I got a ton of compliments.

Dancing to "I'm so fancy," and feeling pretty fancy in RTR I had my eye on this one for awhile...loved finally wearing it. I really liked how the dress had an empire waist, it was nice to feel comfortable and hide stomach 3 months after having a baby. Shapewear I would recommend to help with zipper.
Stunning dress made the perfect night! I loved this dress! The material is gorgeous and the color was just perfect.  I received many compliments and I felt beautiful every moment I walked in it.
This dress was amazing!!!  My only complaint is that it is long so be prepared.

Pageant Standout I wore this dress for a pageant and it wasn't my first choice. For what I was doing I really needed a sparkly dress and this just didn't have that. I did love the color though, the red really makes you standout. The dress also was easy to walk in, it flowed very easily. I did choose the longer dress just because I was unsure if the gown would reach the ground or not, but I wish I would of chosen the Regular length dress, long was just way too long for me and I am about 5'5. This would be a good dress if you are looking for a simple and classic look.

The red popped and was gorgeous! Very slimming.  Size 8 fit great but i am 5'7 in height. The size scale said if you were 5'7 or taller to get a 8L instead of regular. DO NOT DO THAT my dress was ridiculously long i couldnt walk let alone dance. Will definitely get a regular next time.

A Movie Star Dress This was my first time renting from RTR but it definitely won't be my last. My dress was supposed to arrive on a Friday but due to a weather delay, the post office wasn't set to deliver my dress until the following Monday (AFTER my event!). I called RTR and they rushed me a dress that arrived the next morning by 9:30am. GREAT customer service too!

The dress was absolutely gorgeous! It fit like a glove and I received so many compliments on it. The color is so vibrant, it was nice to stand out in a sea of black dresses.  The length wasn't a huge issue, I'm about 5'5 1/2" and wore about 3 inch heels and it skimmed the ground.  

This was such a great experience. I can't wait for my next chance to rent from RTR :)

I went to a black tie event with this dress and definitely stood out! I'm 5'2" (and about 120 lbs.) and this fit great. I had to wear really tall heels (which I was planning on doing anyway, as my husband is very tall!) and this just skimmed the floor, which was perfect. The bodice fit great (I'm a 34D) and it was very comfortable. Definitely a classic fit in a great color!

The dress was amazing! The dress came right on time and fit great! I wore a 0R and it was slightly large in the bust, but other than that it fit perfectly! I wore 4 inch heels and the length was just right. The color is a very nice shade of red and looks great on. I would highly recommend this dress! Also, the process to rent the dress is very easy and user-friendly. I would definitely use Rent The Runway again!

Love the color and cut! I wanted a formal dress for a gala my husband and I were attending and figured a lot of women would be in black. The red is so beautiful and stands out in a crowd... Unfortunately so did the two other IDENTICAL dresses at the event. I recognized a number of RTR gowns and realized that DC is a city where women go to these kinds of events all the time and RTR is their go-to for dresses. Oh well... we just tried not to stand next to each other. :)

Ordered a 6R and 8R, and managed to squeeze into the smaller size- so glad because although both of the dresses were too long, the 8 was even longer. 6 was great with 4" heels although the dress still touched the floor (an inch too long, but it could've been worse). 

This was my first rental and I'm hooked! Would definitely do it again.

Great dress even when distracted! I wore this for the Barkball in DC which is the Washington Humane Society's black tie ball where you can bring your dogs.  I wanted something easy since I knew I would be distracted with having to keep an eye on my puppy! My only complaint is that the L was too long even with three in heels.  I am 5'7" so I fall into that awkward inbetween R and L dresses.  I had worn a Theia dress the weekend before as a 10R that was too short.  This 10L was too long.  Someday I'll find one that works!! Otherwise though, the dress was comfy and beautiful!
Great Dress! Perfect for a Saturday night wedding!  Loved the color and length of the dress. Even though I am tall and wore heels the length was perfect!

Great Dress! 5 stars!  I wore this gown to my Senior Prom. The dress ran true to size. I was worried about the length as I'm 5'7" however the 6 regular was perfect! In the picture I'm wearing 4 inch heels. I'm flat chested and lack curves in general but the dress still looked great! It flows very nicely when you walk and it's great in pictures. The red is also different from most dresses; Many people were wearing red however my dress stood out from the others

Overall, very pretty dress The chest area was a little large, but fashion tape definitely helped. I'm 5"8 and got the long option, and this also helped, but if I wore heels any shorter then 5in, I would have gone with the regular. The color is a deeper red in person also.

Fabulous Dress!!!   The dress fit true to size.  I am a size 12 and 5'-10" tall.  The 12Long worked great and still slightly swept the floor with a 4" heel on.  It was good for me because the dress highlighted my figure and hid my tummy.  It looked great with a chunky gold necklace.  The color was bright and festive. Not many people were wearing red at the event so it stood out and was different than the typical black dress.  Loved it!!!

This dress was perfect for my work's formal holiday party. I received tons of compliments!  Dress was long, but most are since I am pretty short. I had to wear very high heels to ensure I didn't trip over it

Loved, loved, loved this dress! Beautiful Lady in Red! The fit was great and was so easy to travel with.  No wrinkles, no issues.  I got so many compliments on how it looked at the gorgeous winter wedding I went to. The lines of the dress are so flattering and really made me feel gorgeous.  It was really easy to dress up or dress down.

I looked amazing and got so many compliments, it was a night to remember. I attended my friend's prom wearing this dress. I got so many compliments and people were asking if I was a model since I didn't attend their high school. The dress is and looks beautiful, I felt super expensive wearing this dress. I would definitely rent it again.

The feeling you get wearing this beautiful dress was amazing! This dress was perfect!! I chose this one even though it was my backup dress because this one looked better and was longer on me than the other dress i ordered. It fit great and was not too long with me wearing flats. It was comfortable to be in and it was gorgeous. I got so many compliments! Order it!
I wore this dress for our blog, @reviveandthrive, launch. The color was STUNNING Bust was a little tight, but being 6 feet tall the length was perfect!

I wore this gown to a military ball and received tons of compliments all night!  The RTR experience was wonderful and the dress as well! I would recommend ordering your normal size plus one size smaller. The 6 fit well however the 4 was a bit more snug and comfortable. The bust area is supportive enough that you don't need to wear a bra with the dress. I am 5'9" and I ordered the regular length becuase I wanted to wear flats and it fit perfect length wise. If you are 5'9" and above and plan on wearing heels definitely get the long. Just like the other reviews, the only complaint was the zipper. It took a good 10 min to get up! It will go up just takes some patients! But all in all, I loved this dress and will definitely order from RTR again!

Feeling completely glamorous in a beautiful dress! The dress fit perfectly, and my biggest fear (the length) was not even an issue. The long was perfect and everything about this dress was so flattering and so comfortable as well!! Can't go wrong.
A formal cocktail event  The dress is very christmas pagent-y. The material was very heavy and the bottom dragged on the floor even with 3 inch heals.
Felt beautiful! Great dress, no complaints!
pretty/big it was pretty but it ran big I was unable to wear it.

A showstopper! I loved this gown! Badgley Mischka is an amazing designer. I wore this to prom. I ordered both the 4R and 6R, and wore the 4 because it stayed put better, even though the 6 fit my bust better. I got so many compliments on this dress and was even named the best dressed girl there! Thank you RTR for an awesome experience renting this gown and for how easy the renting process is. I will rent again!

I wore it to our Mary Kay Awards Night Seminar. I felt like a queen!  The gown was fabulous. At 5'7", I always wonder if I need a regular or a long, but the regular was the perfect size for me to wear heels (not super high, but not kitten heel). The bust definitely runs small, so choose your size appropriately for your bra size.

Great dress for a black tie wedding! I am so glad I rented this dress! I had to wear my tallest heels (4 in) and it was still just a tiny bit long.  The 0p was not going to zip and the 2p was slightly big in the bust. I think if I had worn a strapless it might have taken up the extra room. The dress was in good condition when it arrived, and I didn't have to steam it or anything.  I loved the flow and overall fit. It was easy to move in. I would definitely recommend this dress!

Gorgeous dress!!  I didn't end up wearing this dress but I LOVED IT!!! I had two dress options and the other was better for the occasion, but I tried this dress on for everyone and they loved it. It highlights the waist and has great detail on the top of the dress. It's a bight and beautiful color. Loved it! It was slightly too big for me and slightly too short. I'm 5'8'' or 5'9'' and wore 3-4'' heels. It didn't bother me so much, but it was a few inches shorter than I would've liked, even though I ordered the long. All in all, great dress. Worth renting!!

Didn't wear--very simple, comfortable and not too long! Well-made gown that seems like it would flatter just about any body type! Not too long (I'm 5'3" for reference). The bust was a *little* bigger on me than most size 2's I've worn. I didn't wear it to my event; I opted for a more elegant gown. This one was cute, but struck me as a more "prom" type look than I was going for. All in all, a great dress.

Lovely red dress, but not the best fit for a petite girl Gorgeous dress. Got many compliments. It fit well, although I did have to pull it up a couple times during the night. It fit snugly, but was a little loose in the bust so couldn't go bra less. I was surprised that the petite size was still very long. I had 3 inch heels (I'm 5'1") and still had to hold the dress up when I was walking to avoid stepping on it. Also, it has boning, which is great and kept everything in. Unfortunately with my dress, the boning was protruding out of the dress and into my ribs. It was only noticeable when I bent down, but still wasn't comfortable. Lastly, the dress had a funky chemical smell when it first arrived, so I hung it over and open window to let it air out. Good first experience with RTR.

The dress was a big hit, despite a few hiccups.  The color of the dress was the perfect red for a formal affair. I ordered a 2R, which did run long despite wearing 2 inch heels. That being said - I am 5ft tall, but unfortunately RTR did not have a petite in stock. Also, the dress ran small and when I ordered it, the next size up was not available. So, I had to take the risk. Luckily, it fit (barely) because my second dress did not fit AT ALL. In addition, the zipper was very wonky, which ended in a night with my boyfriend trying for 30 min to get the zipper down. That being said, when I mentioned this to RTR they promptly gave me a refund on the dress. All things considered, I will definitely use this site again. The look on my boyfriends face was worth every penny.

I absolutely loved wearing this dress. I received so many compliments! It was very comfortable and easy to move in. I have a bigger bust and didn't have problems with it staying up at all, which I usually do with strapless. The color is very vibrant and stands out beautifully.

first rental loved the idea and convenience!  rented this for a wedding a size 0R and 2L (2R out), 2L for me was really too long but the rest fits perfectly! many compliments and many suggested I should buy this to own!

LOVED it!! I wore this dress to a formal event with LOTS of dancing! Lots and lots of dancing! It was super comfortable wear. I am normally a size 6, but I was able to wear the the 4...which provided a little more bust support. I am 5'4 and wore a 3 inch heel and the length was perfect.
I absolutely loved this dress and got so many compliments throughout the night! This dress fits true to size and was very comfortable to wear!

I got A LOT of compliments wearing this dress. The pros, fits perfect, true to size and has a beautiful flow. The cons, the zipper was a little hard to work with and also it was a tad bit long and I wore 4 inch heels.

Nothing but great things to say about Rent the Runway This dress runs true to size, if not on the larger side - Last formal dress I wore was a size 6 which was way too big on me when the red dress came in (ordered 4R and 6R).  I am 5'10 and rented the regular because I was not planning on wearing heals and for my taste, it was just an inch short - the long one without heels would've been too long on me though, so the reviews were right in terms of the dress being on the longer side even for the regular.  The only bad thing about the dress was the zipper! Took such a long time to zip up and 3 people were trying to do so! Small hassle for otherwise a gorgeous dress though. Once you zip it up, it's perfect and comfortable! Overall, pleasantly surprised with RtR and definitely will keep this site in mind when looking for a dress next time.
Lots of complements on the color and style  Cons were the top as it didn't stay put.  As a petite girl would be good to have long dresses to fit us 5'2 girls.

Showstopper! Will definitely rent again.  Rented for a NYE wedding. The dress was very long- I was planning on wearing flats but ended up wearing 3 inch heels and it was still a little long. The chest was very big also, normally dresses run a little small for me but I ended up wearing a padded bra to ensure it stayed up. Overall very comfortable though, and I felt great. Many compliments on the overall look, the red is a beautiful choice when you don't want to blend in in a sea of black. Very happy with the experience, especially since I hate dress shopping!
Great Dress! I wore this dress to a rehearsal dinner cocktail party and received many compliments.  The dress seems to run a little small but one size up fit perfectly.  Great dress!
This dress:) love this dress!  Very flattering.

This was my first rental, it worked out perfect. Got compliments on the dress all night. The size 6 fit nicely. Form fitting but not too tight, didn't need to worry about a bra which was a plus. The only part of the dress I wasn't a fan of was the strap going across the dress. It seemed to have been a bit stretched out or worn, so it sat a little loose on my back. The dress was elegant and sexy. I will definitely rent again.

Classic look with such an elegant and surprising back.  I loved the length as a woman who isn't in love with her legs. I would have worn the 8, but the strap across the back was too tight (and missing one set of hook and eye closures). The back on the 10 was much looser than I would have liked, but could have been fixed with safety pins if I hadn't been in a huge hurry!

I felt comfortable  & beautiful in this dress.  It is sexy, but understated. I normally wear a 6, but the 6 was a little tight across my butt .  The 8 fit perfectly EXCEPT for the piece that goes across your back. It attaches w/hooks & eyes & it was way too loose.  I called & spoke w/a RTR stylist & she could not have been nicer.  She would have sent me a new dress(no charge), but I really wanted to wear this dress.  I contacted my seamstress & she met me & tacked it so it fit perfectly.  The back of this dress ROCKS!!  My only other feedback is, the dry cleaner needs to be careful to press the lining so it doesn't show around the neckline & arm opening.  Put this dress on the top of your list, it is AWESOME!!

Beautiful black dress I typically wear a 4 but for some RTR designers wear a 6. This dress definitely doesn't allow for a larger chests so I ended up sizing up. From the front the dress looks like a nice black dress, the lace cutouts on the side are not overly see-through but the back is open and really fun. This dress adds some really fun/sexy details to a classic LBD silhouette. The only down side was the dress was definitely on the worn side. The string holding the button at the top broke so I had to safety pin the dress (luckily I had my hair down) and the larger row of hook & eye clasps were all bent out of shape (luckily I wore the smaller row so this wasn't as big of a deal for me). Overall, I received a lot of compliments from friends/guests and would definitely rent this again!

I'm IN LOVE with this Nha Khanh dress and would recommend for anyone who wants to feel their best! I rented this dress for a semi-formal work event.  This dress made me feel beautiful and sexy all the while keeping it classy and work appropriate.  I can't tell you how many compliments I received while wearing this dress and even after when people saw pictures.  It fit like a glove; the lace was a great touch but my favorite part was the surprise open back.  If I had the chance I would've purchased this dress and never sent it back.
Great dress to rent! It was true to size and it fit me well. I really liked it and so did everyone around me.

Great dress and love the detail on the sides. I really enjoyed this dress.  I went out for a birthday dinner with my boyfriend and his family.  It was sexy without being too risky.  The 6 fit more comfortably than the 4. The back strap attaches to the other side of the dress with 3 hook and eyes (I think that is the right term lol). There are two lengths to choose from and I was on the larger fit for both the 4 and the 6.  With the size 4 dress you were not able to see the additional hooks but with the size 6 dress you were.  I am not sure how but that's what was going on.  It wasn't all that noticeable though.  I was able to eat a large 8 course meal without my stomach bulging out or the dress feeling overly tight.  It was perfect.  I def would recommend.

Sexy and elegant! This dress fit perfectly and I didn't have to wear a sticky bra which made it that much better.  I read some of the comments and decided to tuck the strap that ran across the back into the dress for a more dramatic open-back look.  I am extremely short so I was a little bit nervous about the length of the dress- because it was form fitting, the length did not seem awkward at all and actually made the dress seem even more elegant.  I got tons of compliments and felt amazing all night.

This was my first RTR rental and I loved it!! Felt beautiful and got lots of compliments  It runs a bit small in the waist where it zips but was ver flattering. I put the middle strap on the inside like I'd seen on another review and it worked great!! Very happy with this rental!! Loved the length and I'm 5'11. Wouldn't recommend for a large bust with a small waist

Wore this dress to the Grammy's and it was a perfect, not too dressy dress. The dress lining was longer than the beaded overlay, so it looked like a messy hem. The size 4 i wanted was missing the back strap so i had to go with the smaller size and no bra. Did feel like a million bucks and got so many compliments!

Perfect Fit I really liked this dress for my company x-mas party. It is classy, but with a bit of sass in the back. It does run a bit long, but I think that is okay considering the open back and tight fit.

Great Dress For Formal Wedding I wore this dress for a formal (Black Tie Optional) wedding this past weekend in Charleston. This dress was perfect for the occasion. It was conservative enough (due to the length and high neck line), but sexy with the open back. I received so many compliments.

As far as fit, I'd say this dress runs slightly small, so I would size up for my extra size.  I have a wide back, and the back strap did not come close to fitting across my back.  I just tucked it in the front of my dress and nobody could tell. (Honestly though, I think this dress is better without the back strap- I would recommend getting rid of it altogether. The strap is made of a cheaper material and takes away from the overall high quality of the dress). Another perk, since the material was so structured, I did not have to wear a bra/tape.

Very comfortable, easy to move around in and dance in. Loved the open back detail.  It ran very true to size, the fabric was great. I loved the high neckline with the open back - it was a just sexy enough. Also, note there is a back zipper so you can create a slit as little or high as you want.  I would definitely wear this again.
Love this dress! I loved this dress. It was incredibly flattering and perfect for a wedding. I would definitely rent this again! It's absolutely perfect for pear shaped ladies.

Very comfortable dress.
sexy and classy at the same time  could be worn to many places
Sexy LBD! This dress was a perfect LBD for my birthday outing. The back and lace on the sides were the perfect touches to the dress. Wish I could keep this one!

Classy but sexy! I got so many compliments on this dress! This dress was absolutely amazing. I got compliments on it all night! It was classy while still being fun and flirty with the open back and lace cut outs, which weren't too revealing, but added a lot to the otherwise plain front. I ordered a size up (8) when I can usually get a 6, and it fit just right since there really isn't any give to the fabric, and I have a pretty wide rib cage and shoulders. I wore it with a black strapless bra which blended into the strap across the back and ended up working just fine, but I would recommend a backless bra, if you have a comfortable one.  The only thing to note was it was definitely long on me; I'm 5'5'' and it came down well past the knee. Until I discovered the zipper slit in the back of the skirt, it was a little constricting at the knee, so definitely look for that zipper! The fabric was fairly heavy, so it was perfect for this late-fall wedding, but would definitely be hot in the summer.
Can we say LOVE!! Perfect fit... This is the best dress for a wedding.

FAVORITE RTR Dress...EVER! This is one of my favorite dresses to date that I've rented on RTR.  I was a bit sneaky and actually safety pinned the back strap onto the inside front to make it more backless than in the picture.  I received countless compliments on this dress throughout the evening.  The size 4 fit me well, too but I had a little too much to eat before the wedding so went with the size 6 to be more comfortable.  HIGHLY recommend.
Perfect dress for an outdoor wedding Fits like a glove but hugs in the right places. It has a built in bra that actually works. Wore it and danced all night, stayed comfortable the whole time

This dress was great. Flattering, comfortable and I received a lot of compliments.  I usually wear a 6 dress but the 8 fit like a glove. It is a little long, which makes it kind of conservative (and I'm tall). Unless your strapless bra lines up with the dress perfectly, you will need to wear sticky cups.

Wish I had taken a nice photo to show the dress! It was a gorgeous dress and fit great! The 2 and 4 both fit but the 4 looked just a bit better and laid better without any bit of puckering around my hips! It was very comfortable and stylish, the strap across the back was actually a nice support for my bust. I wish I could have kept it!

Great dress, would definitely recommend. This dress fit  great and was very comfortable.  Keep in mind there is no give in the dress so as a backup, order a size up.. I ended up wearing my backup size which was perfect. As for a bra, I wore one of the convertible ones. I had the strap run around the back of my neck and then for the basic, mid-back straps,  they fit right into the loops hidden in that backstrap in the dress. So you couldn't see the bra at all and it stayed in place. I would definitely recommend this dress.

Classy and Very Flattering! Fit was perfect, I normally wear a size 4, and the 4 in this dress fit great.  I wore this dress to a hospital gala.  Would definitely rent again!  Received several compliments.

I want to own this dress forever!  What a GREAT dress! I rented this for my corporate holiday party and I am so sad that I have to return it tomorrow. The dress is classy and sexy all at the same time. I normally wouldn't rent an open back for a corporate party, but the length of the dress, the neckline and the tasteful lace in the front balanced out the open back. The dress is a true definition of "business in the front and party in the back". I really loved the length since I find that a lot of my RTR dresses are a bit too short for my comfort level.  You can't wear a bra with it, due to the open back, but that didn't cause any problems for me.  I normally wear a 10 and the 12 is what I had to wear this time  - and it still was a bit snug. It wasn't a huge issue, but it is something to note when you rent. Loved this dress - I seriously want it for every formal event!

Fit like a glove...loved it! This dress was super classy - perfect for a "not too formal" wedding.  It is definitely true to size and fit like a glove, so some may need to size up on this one.  Loved the lace paneling in the front, though I agree with one of the other posters, that the strap across the back was very awkward (I ended up tucking it in and going with an open back).  The length, something I'm always concerned about, was perfect for my 6'0 frame.  Paired it with some gold jewelry and the look was perfect.  This was my second RTR rental and I could not have been happier.

Beautiful classic dress! First of all, this dress runs small. I usually wear a 0 or 2 based on the brand and as long as the material has some stretch, my larger chest fits. The 2 of this dress was way too tight on the top because there is no give in the material. It's a very durable dress, but it doesn't stretch at all, including the skirt part because I had to hike it up to go to the bathroom. Otherwise, the 4 fit perfectly and I got so many compliments! I wore the sticky cups to have a little more support, but it would also be okay without. I especially like that the back strap has two options for how tight you can make it. I went for the tighter one, but if you're worried about back fat the looser one is a great backup.

Made me feel very feminine and very confident!  Rented this dress for a casino themed fundraiser. Dress was perfect. I'm fairly modest so I was concerned about the back. The back is as bare as it seems, but it is quite tasteful. I never quite understood the extra strap so I kept it tucked on the inside. 

As others have mentioned, the fabric is great quality - heavy with some stretch. The length was just below my knees and it made me appear quite shapely. I ordered a size 8. I am an 8 at the bottom and closer to a 6 at the top with a fairly short torso and small chest, so I had some issues with sizing (at least a size too big/long at the top), but I made it work with some pins and tape. 

One other thing, the dress had a weird smell when I received it. Almost as though it had mildewed at some point. If I had more time I would've put it in the cleaners before wearing, but that wasn't an option. I have not heard similar remarks from others so I'm sure my experience was a fluke. I steamed it and that helped. 

Overall great experience considering I probably would've spent between $300-$500 to buy a similar dress, with no where else to wear it. This gave me the chance to look awesome, and save a big chunk of $$$. Thanks RTR!
Fit like a glove! Hugged every curve perfectly. I didn't have to wear a bra and it's hard to find dresses like that for me. I got a million compliments for a black dress!

Felt very sexy in this dress without feeling like I was showing too much. Ladylike sexy  The top was tighter than I anticipated for an 8 but the bottom fit perfect. My body can be hard to fit I'm smaller on the top than the bottom and I'm 6ft tall but this dress fit me like a glove, vey happy

Chic and Edgy. An absolute show stopper! After reading the reviews I got my backup size one size up and I'm glad I did. This dres runs pretty tight and the hip area is not forgiving. I ended up wearing the 10 and it fit perfectly! Snug and form fitting. The length is very appropriate, which was a relief because I am extremely tall (6'0). I wore it to my brother's wedding, and I completely lost track of how many compliments I received! I felt so elegant and beautiful and the cut out in the back was just the right touch of edgy! I was SO sad that I had to return this dress as I would have loved to make it my new LBD!

Great for wedding/formal event I was pleased with this rental and this was my first RTR so I was nervous, but the dress fit great. I usually wear 8 in dresses, but needed to wear the back-up 10 because this dress is made for smaller bust size. There was a little wear and tear to the back buckles and fasteners, but this was not noticeable to anyone else. The dress is thicker, not sure this would be great for an outdoor summer event, but it was perfect for the wedding I needed it for. It fit great, held in the girls all night (without a bra! plus!), and I was able to dance for hours without feeling restricted. I am tall and this hit right below my knees, I would caution those that are shorter than me (5'9) that this dress may be a bit too long if you are looking for a cocktail length. Overall happy with this rental!

Classy and sexy at the same time! I really loved this dress. It was past my knee which I usually don't love since I'm on the shorter side, but it was so nice for a black tie optional wedding to be on the classier side of cocktail and the lace cut outs made it sexy. LOVE this dress.
This is a classy little dress!  Simple and beautiful  I tucked the back strap in and made it completely backless!

I got so many compliments on this dress - even the bride was gushing how much she loved it! As the other reviews suggested I had to size up to the 8. The 6 fit but felt too snug, especially for a night of dancing. I loved the detail of the back of the dress but needed a little help fastening the strap across the back.

This was such a great dress - conservative in the front and sexy (yet classy) in the back. The dress definitely ran small - I normally wear a 6/8, but I wore a 10 in this dress.  It was very comfortable and felt well-made, and has a zipper in the back on the bottom of the dress which makes it easier to walk (especially up stairs). Bonus: the silhouette around the shoulders/neckline makes your arms look toned.

This dress was the epitome of classy and sexy and gave me a reason to dress to the nines! Dress fit like a glove, but the chest was very tight - i'm only a 38B right now and the back strap wouldnt go across my back so i had to leave it tucked in the side..i guess i have wide ribs? the rest of the dress super flattering and i loved all the complements i got!

Nice dress. Classy and sexy at the same time.  Dress was very nice and form fitting. The strap in the back was a different material and in no way was it going to clasp on. Hugs your hips and length was a little long for me but still in good taste.

Beautiful and sophisticated! Beautiful dress!  Wore it to a fancy dinner, and my date loved it. :)   As noted, it runs a little small, so I'm glad I ordered a size 4 back-up.  It's also a little hard to walk in, but you just need to take small steps!  I was also able to wear a strapless bra, as the black part of the dress in the back hid my bra strap (as long as your bra strap is not too thick)

The little black dress with a nice surprise! This dress is very classy while also having the surprise (and sexy) open back. Wore this to a rehearsal dinner and received many compliments. Also rented the same dress a second time and planned to wear it to a Vegas wedding, but this time the strap in the back didn't ship with the dress and it was way too much back without it.

This dress was perfect for a cocktail attire wedding I really liked this dress. It fit perfectly and was a slightly heavier material, which was good because I wore it to a November wedding. I liked that it was a bit sexy but still classy. Other reviewers mentioned the strap across the back as being loose but I didn't notice that especially if I stood straight and soldiers back (not uncomfortable just not hunched). It definitely cannot be worn with a bra, so keep that in mind. The dress is tight around your knees but does have a zipper that can be unzipped to create a slit or make it easier to go upstairs, dance, etc.

Great dress! This was my first time renting from RTR. It was an all around great experience, from the ease of ordering and returning, to the super fun packaging! I was skeptical about ordering a size up from my normal, but I'm so glad I did! I fit like a glove and hugged all the right curves. It was sexy but classy. It was a little warm for the heat (the dress is made with very thick material), but perfect once we got indoors. I would rent it again hands down!

A random woman (younger than me, 20s) raved about the dress in the elevator when I left the party! This dress was perfect for the work event I went to - a Saturday night cocktail party (colleagues as well as executives were there). I was concerned at first about the back and the lace (would it be too much skin?) but for a Saturday night, this was the right option for sure. I ended up wearing the size 8 (vs. the 6) - even though I usually wear 6s, I'm truly in between sizes and have an hourglass / athletic build - the 8 gave enough room for that, while I couldn't get the 6 over my hips.  The 8 fit like a glove - over the hips, cinched at the waist, just right over the bust & across the shoulders - overall, very form fitting.  The dress was also thick enough that I didn't have to wear a bra (I bought strapless cups and fashion tape just in case, but didn't end up needing them). Also, the back is high enough (over the butt) so that you can wear control-top hose without them peeking out at all.  I felt stunning all night and would highly recommend this dress!

WHAT A GREAT DRESS!!!! I loved the dress. It runs a little small, I normally wear a 2/4 and the dress was slightly small. 
Overall I would recommended. I used the dress  for a formal professional affair and I looked professional and sexy. The amazing thing that i order the dress the day before my affair and I got it on time. Great customer service. Well done RTR!!!!!

Classic with a twist Loved this dress so much I already reserved it for another occasion. The fabric is beautiful and the cut is very flattering. The lace cut outs and back detail are just a little sexy without being too much.  I did not wear a bra but believe you could have attached one to the back strap to keep it in place.

Classy and Sexy Dress I rented this dress for a rehearsal dinner.  I rented the 0 and 2 and found the 0 to be too tight.  The front is very classy with nice cuts to the arms and a classy length.  But the back gives the dress an element of surprise!  It is very flattering and sexy.  I think the combo of the being both classy and sexy is really something special.  I am considering buying this dress.

High quality construction and flattering fit Very flattering fit and high quality construction. The lining was well-sewn and the zipper to adjust the back vent was very nice for keeping the dress appropriate for a work event under a blazer and then a bit more risque for a cocktail event later. Fit was true, and I could have worn my usual size (6) except that there is no give in the fabric, and I have very broad shoulders, so the top cut into them if I moved my arms at all. The 8 fixed the shoulder tightness and was still a very nice fit through the waist and lower body. If you have broad/muscular shoulders or back, I'd size up for your backup size.

An LBD with a sexy twist!  Ended up not wearing this out over the weekend so added a collared shirt underneath to wear to work! A sexy LBD with cut outs became a chic work attire dress. Fits like a glove.

First RTR experience = success! I normally wear a size 4, but knew to order up so I got a 6. It fit like a glove and I got so many compliments. It's was on the long side for me (5'4"), but I just wore higher heels to complete the look. Loved my RTR necklace too!

Business in the front, party in the back! The Mullet Dress!  My measurements are 5'5", 125lbs, bust 32 B/C, waist 26in, hips/bum 36in. The size four fit like it was tailor made for me. This was my first time in a dress that didn't come from like a thrift store, so I am going to say it ran true to size because I really have no idea what size I am in real clothes. I was supremely comfortable for the seven hour affair. I decided to go bra-less with pasties. The back strap I wrapped around the inside front of the dress like a little bra shelf. A touch of support and a great way to hide the strap if you want to go backless! The bride loved it! She told all her bridesmaids to just do LBD. It was modest in the front, so it didn't detract from her in pictures, but I still got to feel sexy on the dance floor! I got a ton of compliments.

I loved this dress and would definitely rent it again. I was sad to give it back.  It fit really well. I loved the thick fabric, it had some give to it, but was rich and form-fitting. I'm 5'11 and the length hit my knees. The middle strap in the back of the dress covered my bra strap, and I used the double-stick tape provided by Rent the Runway to keep the strap in place. The dress is conservative in the front, but it brings "sexy back."

Bachelorette Party in NYC! The dress was gorgeous.  RTR couldn't send the size 2 because they received it back damaged, but they were able to send the size 4.  Luckily, the size 4 ended up fitting perfectly.  There is a zipper in the back bottom to allow for more leg room (especially needed when walking up stairs in this dress!!)  The cut is amazing all around.  The front is a bit more conservative but the back is WOW!!!

sophisticated  I am pretty curvy and this dress worked.  I liked that it was classic in the front but the open back sexy. This dress is very form fitting and I almost did not wear a bra.  I ended up using those stick on support bra things which worked fairly well.
Stunning Dress It's hard to move in, so I wouldn't suggest it for a party or a night on the town, but the dress is very flattering and you will receive tons of compliments!

This dress was just to die for! It was a huge hit. Didn't want to give it back!!  This fit is tight. Hugs the curves. I'm 5'10 and have a muscular physique. Normally have issues fitting things around my but and thighs that also fit in the waist. This dress did just that. Just enough give to be comfy. I would say when  you order it, get your size and 1 up.
Got lots of compliments! The fit was very flattering; however, I did have to pin it up to keep the back fitting properly.
Classic Black Dress with Twist The open back and lace side detail makes a simple black dress stand out from a simple black dress. I suggest pairing with large necklace or multi-string pearls

So great.  Almost... It's not the dresses fault.  But the odd dispersement of fat on me.  Or maybe I have body issues but i think if you don't have a great back.  Meaning little back fat then this dress isn't for you.  

This dress is beautifully and smartly constructed.  When you wear the black strap in the back you don't need to wear a bra. However, unlucky me the bra bulge is never more apparent when fully shown bare like with dress.
Beautiful Red dress! This dress looks amazing on!  The fabric was very flattering and I received a lot of complements. Great for a formal event.

Rent. This. Dress. I wore it to prom and felt beautiful! I rented the size 4R and 6L! I'm 5'6" and wore 3" heels and the 6L was dragging on the ground. The 4R was the perfect fit. It just grazed the floor, but it was very close to being a bit short. As for fit, I am not very curvy with a flat booty and small boobs, but the dress made it look like I had curves and a booty! My tummy is a problem area and the 4 was tight, but in a flattering way! The 6 was more comfortable but ultimately it came down to length. I wore a regular bra with the dress which was a huge bonus, along with spanx to suck it all in! The slight mermaid cut made it so I couldn't pop-lock-and-drop it, but was still easy to walk in. The dress looked very expensive and flowed beautifully! Highly recommend!

Felt amazing for my senior prom! The dress fit like a glove and i was so relieved when it was the perfect length on me. I got endless compliments all night long. This dress is so simple, elegant, and classic i wish i could buy it!

Pop of Color! I hosted a gala fundraiser and I found this color to be absolutely amazing. There was no doubt that people could pick me out in the red dress and it definitely felt like a dress you stand out in. I felt comfortable standing in front of lots of people but still pretty and sexy with the back. I felt that the 4L was long, too long and that even though the dress fit absolutely perfect, it still felt a little big because of the fabric. I am 5'8 and 125 lbs and the zipper just zipped up so I don't think going down an extra size would have worked. I loved this dress and felt confident in it- I just would recommend it more for a sit down formal than a wedding, for example.

Arrived in great condition and as expected!
 I have an hourglass figure and it was a bit snug in the hips. There isn't much give in the fabric. It still was flattering and received compliments all night. The color is the perfect hue of red - very luxe.

Beautiful and Fun Dress! Received tons of compliments! I rented this dress for a black tie wedding and was immediately satisfied with my choice the moment I tried it on. The color is vibrant and really popped with my fair skin and blonde hair. It was comfortable to wear even with the slight mermaid bottom. I could dance and sit easily in it. 

I have a booty bump that the peplum really helped flatter with such a fitted dress. Definitely recommend this stunner!

Ended up going with another dress. This dress is more for a wedding not a ball.  I put it on and it was very plain and simple and the material did not make it dressy enough for the occasion I needed it for.  I would wear for a wedding or very nice dinner date but not for a gala/ball.

Very pretty dress I was very pleased with the color and fabric. The only con was that I ordered this is a long and a regular unfortunately the long was damaged so they sent me a different dress which wasn't what I wanted and I had to go with the regular which was a bit short for me.

Beautiful dress for a beautiful occasion! I felt really beautiful in this show-stopper! I'd recommend the P for short folks. Even with my sky high heels, the bottom dragged on the ground a little. It fit perfectly elsewhere though, comfortably hugging my larger hips with it stretchy material. The material was relatively thin, so I wore Spanx and felt great!

Absolutely stunning gown. I almost felt like buying it!! This gown was absolutely beautiful. I had compliments all night in it. I was surprised that it fit so well, yet had a fair amount of give. 

I also am really top heavy (34DDD), and it had plenty of room for me to feel comfortable. The low back was really helpful. 

I am 5'1 so the dress was a little long, but I actually loved the way it looked slightly pooled on the floor. I would definitely rent again!

Very classy dress. Wore it to a black tie gala. Striking color and received many compliments. The only fit issue with the dress was the straps were loose. Not falling off my shoulders but if I was wearing a regular bra, I would have been concerned that the straps were showing. I opted for a strapless bra and had to use use the backless bra converters as the clasps on my bra was slightly showing in the back. Material is very nice and nice weight. I was concerned that the dress would be too short since the long wasn't available however it still worked with 3" heels on.

Perfect gala dress!  This was my first RTR dress! I wore this dress to a fundraising gala and it was PERFECT for the event. Very suitable for a black tie affair. I received several compliments. I wore a 4" heel and the length was fine for me. You can absolutely wear a bra. I would recommend a strapless bra to prevent any part of the bra showing.

Va Va Voom! Showstopping on an hourglass figure! I did not want to take off this dress! It accentuated my curves in all the best ways, and was sturdy enough to hold in my food baby. The material is thick and stretchy, no unsightly lumps or bumps. It was perfect for a work holiday party: modest but stylish and so flattering.

Once again, RTR didn't disappoint  LOVE LOVE LOVE! I was worried that the dress was going to be too long and too big in the waist for me since normally I need petite sizes, but this dress was literally a perfect fit! Very flattering! Little hard to get up/down stairs in The back is just a low enough that a bra barely shows, so either need special bra, or I just pinned mine. (rented my earrings and necklace too!)

Worn to a black tie event Fit was true to size. The bodice fit perfectly while I found it a little snug in the upper thigh, but that may also be because of the style. I found the regular length to be very long, even in 4" heels.

I got engaged in this dress so it's safe to say it was a hit!  The fabric is firm so it "holds you in," but there is enough give so you don't feel uncomfortable. I like my gown to graze the floor so I am glad I got a 12R.  I am 5'5" and wore 3 inch heels - I would have felt like the R was too short.

Perfect I loved wearing this dress and received so many compliments! I did not want to send it back! I wore the OL just because the OR wasn't available. It was a little bit long (I'm 5'6") but I wore taller heels and it was fine!

Favorite gown ever I think this is my favorite gown that I've ever worn! The color is beautiful and the fit was very flattering. I am short-waisted with long legs (for someone who is 5'3") and the peplum hit me just right. I was able to wear 3.5" heals and the length was perfect. I highly recommend it!

Great dress Wore this for my senior prom. I got the 4L and 6L i think i ended up wearing the 6L. Fit great, perfect length. This dress was awesome, very comfortable, was able to wear a regular bra, curve fitting to its a just sexy enough without being too much.
The dress was so perfect . It fit like a glove and made me feel amazing ! The fit was perfect it hugged all the right areas . The zipper was a little tricky but other than that awesome !
This dress was perfect! It was beautiful! It fits true to size and it was perfect!
Lots of compliments! Fits great, runs a little larger than normal.

Conservative yet incredibly sexy dress! I absolutely loved this dress! The color was a beautiful red like in the model photos and fit beautifully. I'm 5'5 and with 4 inch heels the 4R was the perfect length. The peplum added some great curves and also had the additional benefit of hiding my Spanx line! However, it was a little tight in the bust so I went without a bra. It worked out great. It was easy to dance and walk in ad I got many compliments! I highly recommend it. I wore it to a black tie wedding and it went great with my boyfriends tux :)

**  I am very indecisive and critical, which makes picking a dress impossible. But everything about this dress is perfect. I am 5'8, ordered 4L and love to wear high heels. The length was perfect. The dress fit very snug , but I say that in a good way: grabbed all all my curves perfectly. BUT while it held everything in,  it also had an incredible stretch to it that allowed me to walk freely, take giant strides if I wanted to and dance. Rent this dress, it will not disappoint

I couldn't wear this as it was really bulky and large in the top.  I was looking forward to wearing this dress as it looks simple, clean, ad sexy. I couldnt choose this one for a formal event because the top was just not as fitted as I would have liked. The fabric is very heavy as well.

Fabulous black tie find!  The 2 and 4 both fit, but the 4L was a little too long so that's why I went with the 2L. I wore this to a black tie wedding and it was very classy, comfortable and pretty. I could dance and move around very easily. I highly recommend this dress for any formal affair!
True to size The dress fit great and was long enough for me to wear four inch heels. It's definitely fitted and has little give.

Beautifully made, elegant dress. Loved this dress. I received countless compliments on the dress at the formal event I wore it to.The fit was very true to size and is perfect for those that have a little bit of curves. The red dress is a beautiful, unique color, and the thicker material of the dress gives it some structure. Would definitely recommend!
Such a fun dress! Dress fit like a glove. Hugged all my curves in all the right places!

I have never felt more elegant. A timeless look that received compliments all night! The RTR staff made my first rental experience pleasant and painless. I was apprehensive about the whole process since I was renting a dress I'd never seen in person, nor had I tried it on. I have an athletic, but curvy, body and wanted a dress that would accentuate my small waist, and tastefully show off my backside. This BCBG gown was a perfect fit, and the finished look was exactly what I was going for. I paired the gown with classic statement accessories: Cara Dress Me Up bracelet, and Slate & Willow Solar Flare earrings. I am 5'8", wore gold strappy flats, and the dress swept the ground perfectly. Quality material! If there is any complaint I have, it would be with the finicky zipper. Overall, this dress is amazing. I received compliments all night, and felt like the belle of the ball!

I thought this was a very classy, elegant look. Loved the detail of the peplum and the flared bottom For an extra wow factor you could wear a slip with a tulle bottom to make the bottom flare out more.

Great dress. A little tighter than expected, but wasn't inappropriately so. I was very happy with this dress. I would suggest staying true to size, but know it will be a bit snug -- I believe that is way it is supposed to be, hugging your curves.

This dress was beautiful! So perfect for this formal event. I felt great in the dress! I hover between a size 4 and a 6, so getting 2 sizes of the dress was perfect. It fits true to size (I think!) and I only got the long because when I ordered the 6R wasn't available. It wasn't too long with 4 inch heels. The fabric is thicker than I anticipated and has a great texture. It was classy, yet the peplum and V-back gave it a sexy feel.

bumper friendly  really in love with this  stunning dress , i receive a lot of compliments.. little bit long because im only 5'1 but fits really true to size .  i will rent again from RTR WITH MY EYES CLOSED ...

Such a great experience! Very easy, great customer service and will do it again! My co-worker and I attend several events through out the year - and we both tried RTR for the first time for a formal event. This was such a great way to wear a fantastic dress, with out having to spend all the money or have it take up room in the closet! This BCBG dress was true to size and FANTASTIC!

Perfect Dress for the Perfect Event This dress is flattering on most body types. It was a perfect fit and it had a bit of give for my curvy figure. The accessory options are endless. The length was perfect for my height. I wore 3-4 in heels and it worked really well. I was a bit worried about the heaviness/thickness of the dress. I thought I may be a little hot in it. The weather was really cold and rainy so it worked out really well but I would not wear this dress to a beach hot climate destination wedding. Overall this dress is a very well made dress. One-step away from being custom made.

I got so many compliments on this dress! Perfect for a formal wedding. As a curvy girl, this dress was perfect. It showed off the curves but also was modest enough to not be to risque. Love the feel of the material and was comfortable enough to dance all night in! The dress was floor length on me so I wore low heels with the dress.

Really fun. Get yourself some Spanx.  This dress was really fun and I'm glad I rented it. I normally wear a 0/2, but luckily ordered a 2/4 for this dress. I tried the 4 on first and was a little stressed about how tight it was around my hips. Spanx helped that a lot. My measurements are bust-33, waist-25, hips-35. Looking back, I wish I would have rented a 4/6, just to see how the 6 was. All that said, I got a TON of compliments and don't regret the order. It was an amazing color, nice thick fabric, and comfortable. Because I think it was a little small on me, it kept bunching up my thighs when I walked. I kept having to straighten it and pull it down. So definitely size up! I tend to carry weight in my thighs, but have a small waist, so sizing is always tough with fitted gowns. If you have really thin legs, I'm sure this won't be a problem for you!
The dress looked amazing.  I received so many compliments including "most beautiful dress" Perfect fit. Hugged every curve. Boyfriend loved it!! LOL

I received compliments all night on this dress! I wore it for a Mardi Gras ball in New Orleans. I am short, so I was worried about length being I didn't have platform shoes. I was able to get away with my regular heels in that I was not tripping over the hem of the dress. It fit perfectly with a regular strapless bra. The material is heavy and substantial but not overwhelming. It was great b/c it was not thin or flimsy so that you didn't have to worry about what would show underneath. It flattered my body type to the extreme. I have hips, a booty, broad shoulders, and I am not a full B cup. Beautiful color. I loved this dress. It made me feel like I was on the red carpet. Oh, and it's not confining! I danced all night!

The dress was definitely a show stopper! I wore this beautiful gown to the Zulu Mardi Gras Ball ! The dress hugged all the right curves and the color grabbed everyone's attention.  Wore with an amazing pair of black stilettos, a small black clutch, and big chunky gold jewelry!

I attended a Gala and I definitely turned heads and received many compliments in this dress. I It is a very nice dress but I'm biased because BCBG is one of my favorite brands. The color was amazing. Be prepared for stares from everyone.

The experience with Rent the Runway was so easy, I felt like a princess from start to finish! I rented this dress for a rather swanky alumni event at my University, black tie.  I was the best dressed there in this stunning gown!  I received compliments all night and was extremely confident that I looked appropriate and stood out at the same time.  The dress fit great, a little tight in the bust, but very comfortable all around.  It is long so I recommend wearing some nice pumps with it.  I didn't have to worry about the dress at all throughout the evening since it fit like a glove!
I received endless compliments on this dress all night! The color was vibrant and I felt great in it need a low back or backless bra

This. Dress. Is. Amazing.  Loved it. RTR helped me pick this out after the first dress I ordered became unavailable. The customer service was excellent, and this dress was spectacular. It hugs the curves and is so flattering. You're guaranteed to have fun in this one!

Great dress! The website won't let me choose the option that I wore a 2P and had 0P as my back up - but yes, I ended up wearing the 2P for a black tie dinner and felt fabulous in it! It was comfortable and great quality- nice and thick. I got a lot of compliments throughout the evening. Since it was a high neckline I just wore my hair up in a low chignon, wore dangly gold and diamond earrings and a matching big chunky bracelet. I also paired it with nude heels that can't be seen anyway and a gold clutch. I was really nervous that the dress was going to be too long, so I had to wear 3-4 in. heels. That was really the only downfall since my feet were tired by the end of the night. The other thing to note is that the back isn't as low as it appears in the picture. I was able to just wear my regular strapless bra and didn't have to deal with and special bras. Overall, it was a great dress.

The color and fit were unbelievable.  The dress is gorgeous and it fit so perfectly. I felt very elegant and classy, and so many people gave me compliments. I'd definitely recommend this dress. The one thing that isn't super clear from the pictures is that there are sewn "lines" down the front of the dress but they don't look strange at all. You can also wear a strapless or normal bra with it. I loved this dress!

The color is so vibrant  I wore this to my cousins 15.The material is a little heavy but totally comfortable. I danced for 5 hours non stop and wasn't too hot in the dress.(no more than normal) I wore the regular length with 5 inch heels and it was perfect. I'm 5'3" and when I wore the flats it dragged a little but not too much. I got lots of compliments all night on the color and fit. It hugs all the right curves. Made the night so much better.

Amazing Customer Service! Loved this dress and received multiple compliments! Definitely stood put amongst a sea of black dresses. There was an issue with the availability of my backup dress and the customer service team took great care of me! Can't wait to rent again!

At least I didn't have to worry about someone else have the same dress :) When I first tried on the dress, I thought " oh no, it's not going to fit over my butt" but then I shimmy it up a bit and fit just fine. The top is a little roomy, but I didn't mind too much. At least I could breath and wear a regular bra with it. They also send gum, lotion, and tape for things that need some help staying in places, which is a nice bonus! I wore this for a military ball, which looks amazing with the dark blue of the soldiers attire they have to wear..
The dress was incredible. Received so many compliments Great dress that made waist look super tiny. Danced all night in it without a worry. I would definitely rent again! #blacktie

I rented this dress for a charity ball that I was attending, and it was stunning!  The dress fit pretty true to size. I felt it was a little snug without much give, so if you order two sizes I would order one size up as well.

The dress was perfect for the occasion! This dress was a great fit for the gala I attended. The length was a about .5-1 inch too short (I am 5'6" and wore 4" heels) but overall it was a great dress. I got lots of compliments and the color was perfect!

This gown is epic! I've been renting through RTR for a few years now, and this is absolutely my favorite rental to date.  This gown is beautifully structured and wonderfully made.  The material is high-quality and doesn't wrinkle, and the cut seemed like it was made just for me.  The bottom part of the mermaid skirt moves regally when you walk, and I felt like a freaking starlet in this.  So classy!!  If I ever rent this again (which is likely), I'd switch to the petite length (I'm 5'3).  The regular length *just* worked with five inch heels, but it did drag the floor a bit in the back.   In short, absolutely rent this I looooooooooooved it. <3

The dress is simple yet very elegant!  I got compliments ALL night long and dressed it up with two Chanel brooches. It hugged where it needed and flared where I wanted. Rent the Runway is a true fashionista's blessing!

The dress fit perfectly and was the perfect length! I'm 5'6 and ordered a 4R because I had 4 inch heels that I got to wear with them. It fit really nicely but the fabric was so heavy and it was really warm. It was perfect for prom or any formal event. The black in the pictures is just the slip i got for the dress, it's not actually on the dress!

I wore this dress for a law school formal and got so many compliments on it! It's a showstopper. Very flattering and easy to dance in. Perfect fit for curvy girls.
