You can wear a regular bra without it showing in the back, which is a huge plus. I wore this dress for 8 hours straight and was so comfortable. Perfect length with 4" heels.

This dress made me feel beautiful, classy and sexy.  This dress was spectacular. I had everyone coming up to compliment me. This dress fit like a glove. I could have probably used the 4r and given myself a little more wiggle room but the 2r was perfect. I loved this beautiful dress and the way it made me feel. 

A wonderful first experience with RTR. I will definitely be back.
Perfect for Prom I got so many compliments on this dress, but the zipper was a little difficult to zip up.

So many compliments!  The color is rich and gorgeous.   I could wear my normal undergarments.  The material is a knit.  Could be a bit thicker or more sucky-innie.  A bit tight in the chest, but that is the story of my life...
It was a fabulous dress for a wedding The fit was great, it was good length too.

Classy, sexy, and compliments all night! Occasion: outdoor California evening wedding in spring/summer. Dress was more navy blue than I thought from pictures, and it worked for summer with bright lipstick and bright nail polish. Could also work well in fall with more deep berry and red lips. Pairs well with nude or gold accessories because of the champagne underlay beneath the lace. I didn't wear a bra, nor fashion tape, and didn't feel self-conscious about the deep v neckline. It lays very flat on smaller chests. Arm holes are roomy and great for dancing; weight of dress is heavier, so it doesn't blow up in wind (great if you're wearing it outdoors!). I wore the small and got the medium as a backup - probably could have worn an extra small because it was a tad roomy in the chest and around the waist, but not noticeable. Overall, I'd rent this dress again in a heartbeat for numerous other occasions all season long!

had to return bc wasn't even close to zipping this dress was beautiful in every way - fabric, color, shape, but sadly had to return it.  i haven't order again, bc i don't even know if the medium would fit bc the small was that far off.

A Scenic wedding wonderland The dress was a very flattering cut and very comfortable to wear the entire evening. The only issue was the zipper, which was a real pain to get up even when not trying to zip it on myself. I was worried about the neckline being too deep but it actually was not too much skin and felt appropriate for the event.

Comfy & Classy - the PERFECT wedding dress!  This was one of the most comfortable dresses I have ever worn. It was very snug but oh so figure flattering. The lace overlay detail looked great over the champagne silk. I was getting compliments all night long! GREAT rental.

This was a well-made cocktail dress, great for any formal occasion. I received a lot of compliments from other guests when I wore this to a friend's wedding! I really loved this dress and felt great in it. I was slightly surprised how tight-fitting it was in the torso, I'm quite petite and typically wear an xs dress size and I couldn't zip the xs up!

GREAT dress! Lots of cleavage for full busted ladies I absolutely LOVED this dress! I did not want to take it off! It has a deep v so I had to wear a bandeau underneath to prevent too much cleavage from showing. It was a lace bandeau and it went perfectly with the dress. It was thin, breathable, danceable, and gorgeous. I will definitely rent this again. My fiance could not keep his eyes off of me!

Dress was beautiful, received compliments all night.  Pro - the dress fit perfectly and was very easy to dance in.
Cons - the zipper was a problem. It was quite difficult to zip it to the top.

Ease of renting an amazing dress made this an unforgettable wedding  Loved this dress. Had so many compliments throughout the night. I did struggle with the fit as there is no stretch to speak of. Ended up wearing my back up size (a size bigger) as I felt the xs was too short for a wedding but this did mean the dress was loose for my chest. Bra tapes or no bra is essential for this dress

I wore this dress for NYE in NYC and it was perfect for the event! Got so many compliments! I'm on the taller side with a long torso, so I was worried the dress would be too short, but it wasn't! It hit perfectly at my mid-thigh and was unbelievably flattering.  It is very low cut so I didn't wear a bra, but the thick fabric (in combination with my tiny boobs) held everything in nicely.  Altogether it fit like a dream and I didn't have any trouble with the zipper (that seemed to be a common theme in some of the other reviews). Would definitely rent this dress again!

Definitely made a statement!  Dress ran small so I went with the medium which fit well. Extremely difficult to zip!!! Give yourself a few extra minutes and have help available! Dress is also very low cut which means the boobs are highly visible. Very sexy and flirty!

I wore this dress for my brother's wedding shower.  Beautiful dress, got lots of compliments. I used a little bit of fashion tape to keep everything in the chest area in its place.  I'm bigger on bottom and smaller up top, so I usually wear mediums for tighter fitting dresses and smalls for flowy/looser dresses.

Beautiful dress. Beautifully made dress.  It is a heavier material than I expected which was great because it fell perfectly and didn't ride up or get blown around by wind whatsoever which is important for a short dress.  Definitely a bit revealing with the low neck line and short length but not indecent or anything.  Sticky zipper but once it was on, fit perfectly.

Looked and felt expensive.  Fit great. The wedding I wore this to was at a brewery.  The neckline was daring, but since it wasn't in a church or super-formal setting, it was appropriate and I felt comfortable being more sexy and playful.  The length was short, but so am I.  Dress lengths usually drown me, but this one hit perfectly.  The dress was a show-stopper.  My dad hated the plunging neckline, everyone else loved the dress.

Fun & fabulous!  The reviews are true! This dress is awesome. I wanted to keep it. I run between sizes 8-12 and the large fit perfectly -- even had a little wiggle room. I wore a 'U Plunge Bra' and felt comfortable all night with no tape. It was very comfortable sitting, eating and dancing in. My mom zipped up the dress to where it gets stuck then applied the smallest amount of Vaseline right on the seam of the zipper and it went up no problem! I was relieved because the majority of the reviews had me nervous. I definitely see what they're saying! Highly recommend renting this dress -- loved it!

Stunning dress! Lots of complements! This dress was perfect. It was just sexy enough to feel great in, but not too much to make my grandmother uncomfortable.  I ordered the size small and medium, and ended up going with the medium. I was able to wear a bra with the dress. Others stated that the top of the dress was snug enough to not need a bra, but I didn't really think that was the case for me. 
I styled it with nude pumps, a simple necklace, and earrings; and was planning to wear  a tennis bracelet,but forgot it.

Pros:
-could wear a bra (have some options ready to go. I didn't even need a super crazy plunge bra, but did safety pin  the bra to keep it in place.
-I was able to breast feed my 6 month old without having to find a place to disrobe.
-the fit was great and not too short
- thick heavy material so I didn't have to worry about the skirt flying about as I walked next to fans

Cons:
- the zipper was tricky no matter the size.
- I had to give it back!
-if you can't find a bra that will work, do not assume that you can go braless, it might not be quite snug enough to hold in the girls.

(my sister's dress is also RTR!)

I loved this dress and felt so beautiful in it! This is an absolute beautiful and comfortable dress. The dress is well made, the fit was perfect and true to size. Just make sure you have body tape. I received compliments on the dress the entire night, and I still receive compliments when people come across the pictures. Most importantly, I felt beautiful and confident! I wish I owned this dress, and you will too :)

Charity cocktail party. Fabric was nice, thick & high quality.  It did show lots of signs of wear however.
The dress is VERY low cut so plan to pin it or go without a bra.

Fun, downtown Seattle wedding. This is a very flattering, fun dress.  I ended up wearing a large, because the medium (my usual size) wouldn't zip over my rib cage/bust area.  Because of this, the top was a little big and my nude bra showed a bit, but it wasn't a big deal.  Overall, I felt really comfortable all night and got lots of compliments.

Beautiful Brunchtime Wedding!  Dress was gorgeous...definitely more nude-toned than I expected (I had been thinking it was going to be more silver/gray-ish), but still beautiful.  Didn't even try the medium because the small fit fine.  LADIES: THIS IS A REALLY REALLY LOW-CUT DRESS.  I had to find a "plunge" bra and then tape the cleavage parts onto myself as to not flash the other guests.  That being said, the effect it had on my chesticles was AMAZING, but I was not expecting it to be as low-cut as it was.  I wore it with ballet slippers because it was a picnic brunch affair but it'd be gorgeous with heels.
I got many compliments on this dress! Classy and sexy It fit great, but I do recommend some fashion tape to keep the dress in place up top

This dress is stunning in person (and surprisingly comfortable). Got so many compliments!  The eyelashes along the edge of the dress like to go every which way, but pressing them flat with an iron for a few seconds before putting on the dress helps improve eyelash look significantly.

Gorgeous, comfy dress! Rented this for a wedding; vintage cocktail attire. The small fit great. I am much smaller on top, so it was a little loose, but I don't think anyone noticed but me. I used double sided tape and the dress didn't move, not even in the Austin humidity! I got so many compliments all day/night! Wish I owned this dress, would love to rent it again. As other reviewers mentioned, the zipper is a bit tough getting up over the seam, but with help, it was fine.
Fraternity formal on a yacht  I absolutely loved it and the material was great

Really fun to dance in! Just the right amount of twirling with the skirt.  The zipper was definitely tricky, but worth fighting a bit with to wear this dress!  I don't often wear things that are this low cut, but this was classy enough to pull it off without it being a spectacle.It was really flattering, and I got a lot of compliments. I was concerned the skirt would be too short, but it wasn't. You'll absolutely want some double sided tape, as the dress lays flat fine while standing, but once you bend over or sit down, the neckline can open up. I would definitely recommend this dress, and might even rent it again!

Like

Perfect classy & sexy dress! This was my favorite Rent The Runway dress of ALL TIME! I received so many compliments!!!!! It made me feel beautiful and sexy and was very classy.  I found the dress to run small so size up (I got a S and M and went with a M).  It was also hard to zip (it kept getting caught on the seam), but after a few minutes and a team of three friends, we got it!  The fabric is thick and really camouflages any stomach bulge!  The plunging neckline was classy yet sexy; I have virtually no bust so it worked for me (it was snug and fitting without being uncomfortable), but I do not see how bigger busted women could wear this dress, it would be impossible to squeeze in here!  Overall it's so sexy! I want to buy this dress and wear it 5 million more times!!!!!!!!

I loved this dress.  Wore it for my Rehearsal Dinner.  It did run small.  I think that the 4 would have been better for me. The zipper is a biiaatch! Haha.  But with that said I wanted to keep this dress so so bad.  Very beautiful.  Very low V, good for some occassions a little riskee for others :)
Rehearsal Dinner This dress is perfect, not too much cleavage . I would keep this dress if I could.

Very sexy This dress was another winner.  The neckline was potentially questionable for a wedding, but I feel like it's a classy enough piece & it's all in the presentation.  The dress holds you in & is extremely flattering.  The lace was damaged in some spots, but not enough to be noticed by anyone other than the person wearing it.  And if they do, they're looking to closely ;)

Got SO many compliments on this dress!! Unfortunately did not get a full length picture of me in the dress, but this picture very accurately represents the color. I got the S and M and was most comfortable in the M. I am 5'3" and the dress hit just a couple inches above my knees and was comfy to dance in all night. I wore nude shoes, and truly did get so many compliments. I would rent this dress again!

Got so many compliments throughout the night, and most of all it was comfortable! My first impression of the dress was how heavy and well made the dress was. I didn't have to worry about holding it down during dancing or adjusting it all night. As other reviews have stated, the zipper was hard to get up and down. Fashion tape is definitely a must with this, and it helped avoid any accidental slips. I felt great and got many compliments, though I was a little self conscious about it being so low-cut. The fringes were a little worn, but it wasn't super noticeable. I would definitely rent this fun dress again!

Beautiful detail, flattering fit Very pretty dress.  Very low cut -- which I liked.  Didn't need a bra. It was a bit short, had to be careful when sitting or bending over.
The zipper was really sticky.  Needed 2 people to get it zipped up -- whether it was on or off.
Right now (my weight fluctuates a lot) i am a size 8/10. The M just barely fit, was very snug.
Everyone went crazy for this dress!  This dress is flattering on everyone. I was able to eat, sit and dance all night. I also did not need to wear a bra underneath. Loved it!

Loved this dress! Perfect for a wedding. The dress was classy but sexy, and I got a ton of compliments! The only issue was the side zipper was a little tough to get up, but once you got it the dress fit great. Highly recommended!

The compliment dress! 






  The dress was stunning. I was a little nervous about the fit, but a medium was perfect. The dress is definitely low cut, but nothing a little fashion tape couldn’t solve. As other people said the zipper is a little hard to zip up. The material is a little heavy, which was great during a November ceremony and while dancing! I would definitely rent again!

Beautiful color and sexy cut I wore this for a wedding with my husband (had a sitter for the baby and everything!). He loved it and I felt amazing. Definitely need some fashion tape with the low cut and it is short but I got compliments all night. Only reason I couldn't give it a 5 is the zipper was very difficult with the fabric. Once zipped though it's very comfortable! Loved it
Complimentary fit, great color! Gorgeous dress! Great for a cocktail party.
It fit perfect, wore it with nude shoes! It fit perfect!

Fun dress I was really happy with this rental. It was perfect for a fall, outdoor wedding. I did feel the need to safety pin up the front so it was not too revealing for a wedding. Other than that, it was gorgeous. The fit was really great, it felt really fun and cute.

WARNING: not for those with full breasts!!  photographs beautifully. However, I had to duct tape my boobs to the side and use fashion tape to keep the dress from showing too much cleavage which wasn't very comfortable. If your breasts are smaller than mine, the dress would look great. I had to keep my hair in front of one boob all night to look decent. Beautiful dress though.

Perfection! I definitely needed a little assistance zipping up the dress, but once it was zipped it fit perfectly! I got so many compliments and it was really flattering to my body type (hit all the right places!). I wish I could keep this dress forever - I was so sad to send it back!!

- This dress would have been perfect for the wedding I went to however I went alone and could not for the life of me get the zipper up. Not because of the fit but it did not want to zip over the seam (fabric is really thick). Would not have been a problem had there been someone here to help with the zipper. Super cute, a little shorter than I expected only because everything is usually long on me but not inappropriately short. Great quality of material.

It was such an epic wedding, so much fun!  I'm 5'2" and am a very full 34C. I wore the medium, didn't even open up the small. The medium fit perfectly around the waist, but it was actually a little bit loose in the chest area. But I had the foresight to make sure i had the fashion tape, as well as the boob lift tape to give me some lift. the tape kept everything in place because we were dancing all night and never once felt like i was going to fly out of the dress. the dress was IMPOSSIBLE to zip up. I mean my husband was struggling to zip it up (his poor finger) and it wasn't as if the dress was too small, it was just a really hard dress to zip up. 

I got so many compliments on the dress. I felt amazing. and would totally wear this dress again!!!

Gorgeous dress, great party.   I loved this dress!!!! The zipper is VERY challenging but once I got it up it was fine. I used sticky tape to keep the top glued to my chest. I have a small chest and it was very flattering. I'm 5'9" so it was quite short on me but I expected that. I got a spray tan cause this dress really shows off the legs. I picked this dress because it it looked great on everyone that posted a photo! I do have a large rib cage so I was glad that I got a backup size Large-- I needed it.

Extremely flattering, complements all night The dress fit like a glove, but like other reviews the zipper kinda sucks and took multiple people to get up despite extra room in the fabric (aka not too tight just bad zipper).  However once I got it on I received complements all night and felt sexy with out pushing the slutty side of things.  Overall a great first experience with RTR
Perfect! Loved it. Received lots of compliments. I recommend a deep backless bra and some double sided skin tape to keep the front taped to your skin and avoid an breast exposure.

The dress was perfect to a beachside wedding!  Such a fun dress! Only downside was that you could tell it had been worn many times before as the armpits were starting to fray. It must be a popular dress but you would think RTR would be on top of that...

Fits Like a Glove! I was hesitant about this dress at first because it isn't my usual style but it is perfect!  I am 5'3", 125lbs and the small fits perfectly.  The length isn't too long to overwhelm my petite frame and isn't too short so it's inappropriate.  If I could buy this dress, I would in a heartbeat!

Awesome experience, Amazing dress This was my first time Renting the Runway and overall it was a great experience!  I chose the 4 day rental option and received the dress on Friday night and I had to return it by that Monday before 12 PM.  The dress arrived in time and in good condition.  After a recent weight gain I was very nervous the dress wouldn't fit but the small ended up being perfect. I didn't even try on my back up size of XS because the small already fit so well. The dress is absolutely stunning and the fabric is so elegant.  I will say that the neckline is very low so just be prepared for that.  The only other thing was that the zipper of this dress is very tricky to get up.  Not because it's tight it's just that the zipper is a little stubborn even with extra room in the dress.  So you will certainly need an extra person to help zip it, preferably someone with strong hands!  But once the dress is on it's so worth it because it looks beautiful!  The dress is comfortable too! It's perfect for a wedding, which is what I wore it too. I loved this dress so much that I wish I could have kept it!  You will be sad to take it off and package it back up at the end of your rental.  The dress itself is just so stunning and will make you feel like a million bucks!
very pretty dress, the lace lays beautifully over the chest, got a lot of compliments I am usually an XS. I did wear the XS but it was a tight fit and I almost switched to the S.

Gorgeous dress!  Beautiful dress and very comfortable. Wore this to a rehearsal dinner and received many compliments. Only issue was that the zipper was very difficult to zip up, especially over the seam near the waist. I probably would not rent it again for this reason but was happy I was able to zip it up for this event.

I've worn this dress THREE times! It's perfect for any occasion! I wore this dress to two weddings and most recently for my engagement photos. I love it! It's very flattering and well made. I have broad shoulders so the cap sleeves are a great feature. I got tons of compliments each time I wore it. My only concern was that the plunging neckline would open up a bit when I sat down. I kept checking to make sure nothing inappropriate was showing. I would suggest wearing pasties with this one.
Very cute dress. Sexy but still classy.  Dress is heavy but not too noticeable once on. Got compliments.

Sexy and Classy! Loved this dress! Felt very confident despite the low cut. The small was probably better for my bust size, but I couldn't get it to zip around my rib cage so I had to go with the medium. Used some fashion tape to keep the edges in place, as they would bubble out if I sat down or slouched. Length was perfect for me; hit just above the knee. I wore it to a friend's springtime wedding and it fit the occasion perfectly. I also have broad shoulders and larger arms, but did not have any trouble with the sleeves or shoulder width.

This dress is gorgeous and very flattering! The small fit great! I had a little trouble with the zipper, like others have said - but it always worked. Just make sure you have someone help you zip it up. The dress is a little darker than I thought it would be- it's definitely more of a navy than a royal blue. It's very low-cut but I was never worried about a wardrobe malfunction, even with a lot of dancing. 10/10 recommend!

Perfect dress for a formal party! I got so many compliments and felt great in it. The material is thicker so helps slim the waistline. The front is a deep v so I would recommend fashion tape. The dress fits true to size and can be dressed up for a formal event or dressed down for a more casual party. I loved it and would highly recommend it! I usually wear a size 4 dress and got the size small.

Sooo many compliments! This dress was amazing! The small was tight around my rib cage so I opted for the medium. I'm small chested so the bust area was a little loose fitting but I just put tape on and it stayed all night. I have literally never received so many compliments before! I would definitely recommend this dress!
This Dress was on Point! This dress was super flattering. Heavier cloth and a little darker in person, which I liked.

The dress was perfect for a Newport wedding! Would totally rent again. The medium was very fitted but flattering.  I don't normally wear plunge necklines but loved how this looked despite my small chest (if you're like me I recommend a sticky bra and some fashion tape).  The length was perfect, I'm just under 5'.  The only thing I was disappointed with was the dress looked like someone had put it in the washing machine, the lace was damaged in several areas which I would expect with renting a dress.  Overall -- loved it and would totally rent again!

Lovely Lace - Terrible Zipper! I absolutely LOVE this dress! However, it's not without its issues. The size medium fit me like a glove, however, it took more than an hour to get the zipper up - and let's be honest, that is ridiculous! I ended up wearing the Large because the zipper went up much more easily, but then that meant it was a bit too large in the shoulders and that the v-neck went below my rib cage. Had to stand up really straight all night and pinned the neckline in to avoid any wardrobe malfunctions. The Large also made me look a little bit wider on the bottom because of the shape of the skirt. But honestly, I still felt like a million bucks in this dress. It is one of my favorite rentals to date and received so many compliments and my family told me I should buy this one! If you are in between sizes or getting a back-up, go a size up for sure and expect the zipper to give you problems, no matter what size you end up wearing.
It's beautiful!  Received so many compliments on this dress. If you've got a big booty, it's extremely flattering.

The 4 offers more room, but the 2 is a more flattering fit. This dress was exactly what I needed. I've rented multiple Monique Lhullier lace overlay dresses before, and this one was no different. They fit predictably well, cover up for modesty but skim the body for femininity. The color is rich and beautiful. Because of the color and modesty, it's on the short list for my sister to rent as a bridesmaid's dress for my wedding!
Great but not for me Dress fit true to size on the smaller side of a 6. Ultimately, I didn't wear it because it was tight and I wasn't super comfortable. But the color is really pretty.
Beautiful!  Absolutely loved this dress. The fit was perfect and very flattering. The color is very pretty and I received many compliments on the dress throughout the night. Would highly recommend!

Beautiful dress, perfect for the occasion (formal fall wedding).  Fit well, true to size. The one exception is that the arms are a little bit small. Fits like a sheath dress. Will need a strapless bra since the shoulders are lace.

Wore this to a work holiday party and it was perfect. I typically wear dresses that pouf out to try and hide my pear shape, but after reading all the reviews I decided to go for it with this dress.  I was worried about the size 14 fitting, but ended up wearing the 12!  There was just enough stretch that I was comfortable all night.  I'm 5' 9" and the length was perfect.  Definitely recommend and would wear again.  I'm only sad that I didn't seem to get any full length pics of me in the dress.

Classy, slimming, perfect fit. I wore this dress to a professional event and it exceeded my expectations. It was comfortable, slimming, and accentuated my curves. The color was beautiful - would definitely rent again.

I loved seeing the pics of my daughter in this dress.  Unfortunately, no full body pics. Very pretty.  Snug fit but looked great on my size 2 daughter!  Price was higher when we rented it; this is a great deal!

This was a great dress because I was able to move, dance, eat and breath while looking elegant. I would suggest wearing a jacket or a wrap with this dress. I was wearing it in Denver mountains so it was very chilly. It would be great in the summertime, nice breathable fabric.
beautiful dress, couldn't wear it. runs too small runs too small for a =size 14

Gorgeous color, elegant dress I loved this dress.  The saturated teal color is beautiful, as is the lace detail.  I wore it for an evening religious service where I wanted something fairly conservative but pretty.  This fit the bill perfectly.  As another reviewer noted, the dress does NOT have a sheer midriff panel.  I hadn't noticed that in the photo/description and I'm relieved it wasn't there.  I'm 5/3" and the lace fell past my knees, but the slip underneath was a bit above the knee so it didn't feel too matronly.
It was my daughter's wedding rehearsal dinner at a stunning venue. The dress fit the event perfectly It was perfect; it was for my daughter's wedding rehearsal dinner.
The dress was comfortable.  I received so many compliments on the color of the dress The fit was great.  It was easy to move in, especially when it came to the dance floor

Classic Silhouette in an Unexpected Color I wore this beautiful teal lace dress for an awards ceremony I hosted at the National Building Museum. I wore my true size (size 6) and it had a lovely fit. I may have been able to wear my backup size 4 for a more form fitted silhouette, but it was too tight in the chest and arms. The size 6 ended up being very comfortable and no need to tug at the dress all day long. I received several compliments, especially on the color which was my favorite aspect of the dress. I would love to purchase this dress.

I got so many compliments on the color of the dress.  It was perfect for my company's Winter Party. I am so glad I got two sizes (10 & 12).  The 12, I felt was sized a little small (or maybe just perfect), but a shapewear body suit helped smooth my flaws out.  I loved the dress.
perfect for cold venues wore both the 2 (more form fitting and sexy) and the 4 (looser and good for co-worker event)

Perfectly conservative with a sexy edge. This dress has no stretch at all--it is what it is. And I didn't have a back up size. Luckily, it fit like a glove.  Hugged every curve, but was conservative enough for a family wedding. My impossible-to-please mother-in-law was adamant that I buy it rather than renting it--it was that gorgeous and perfect. I honestly wish this was in my closet. It would be my go-to every time. And the COLOR: So unique yet timeless!
The color is beautiful for outdoor pictures! The fit was great, it was a graduation in Indiana in May and the color looked beautiful and I'd rent this one again!

This dress was elegant and professional. I volunteered at a charity gala and I wore this dress. It was elegant and professional, conservative enough for the setting but still distinctive. I loved the color and the lace on my arms was perfect. It was a little longer than I would have preferred. I have long legs and even on me the hem was half way down my calves.

I wore this to a formal event.  The fit was perfect, runs true to size.  I ordered sizes 4 and 6 and wore the 6.  The arms were a bit tight but overall, the dress fit like a glove.  The color is beautiful--great for holiday events.  The dress is a bit longer. I am 5'6" and it hit just at the knee.  I may rent this dress again.

Dress was perfect for the occasion Beautiful dress - it's a nice dark teal color with a touch of black in the lace. I ordered the 8 and 10, because I do have broad shoulders and based on other reviews some people had sized up, but the 8 ended up fitting me better. The arms were a little on the tight side but it didn't really bother me. One thing I really liked about this dress was that I was able to wear a regular nude color bra (as opposed to strapless) without it showing through the lace. I received many compliments!

Fierce emerald green dress was memorable  The groom's word for this dress that I wore to his wedding in Pensacola Beach, FL was "Fierce". It was a tasteful emerald green dress, much more green than I thought was teal in the picture. It bunched up a bit at the tummy and I choose to not wear the Hanky Panks. The dress got lots of compliments.

Really a beautiful and classical looking dress! I have rented from RTR twice before and have worn an 8 both times no problem, this dress I had to wear the 10. I am short so it looked too long on me, but I still liked it a lot. It's pretty heavy as well, but was not unconformable or warm.

This elegant, timeless dress was gorgeous, sexy - but not ostentatious - and absolutely stunning.  The dress's bold, teal color balances the delicate femininity of the lace fabric for a modern take on a classic silhouette. Similarly, the longer length and sleeves keep the dress classy despite it's form hugging cut. This dress is perfectly balanced in every way. I wore this to a religious ceremony and felt beautiful, feminine, and powerful all while being occasion-appropriate. The color looked a little more green-teal than blue-teal than I expected based on the pictures, but equally gorgeous.
I felt comfortable, classy and awesome! Throw on some shapewear and rock this thang! It was sexy while still being classy. Very comfy. Complements all night.
Gorgeous color!  Felt a little restricting around the waist, however, the silhouette was undeniably flattering. I received a ton of compliments.
Classy dress with beautiful teal lace.  Fell in love with this long dress. Perfect fall color. Compliments the body perfectly. Another awesome rent the runway!

My date. We didn't end up taking any photos at the wedding but I did get one while I was trying the dresses on.  Based on the reviews I got the size 4 and 6 and was expecting the 4 to be too small but I was pleasantly surprised it fit like a glove. For a little more wiggle room or dancing the 6 would have worked but I felt like the fabric around the stomach was a little too loose. The color (which you really can't see in the picture) is more of an emerald green than teal but regardless it is stunning.  Rent the Runway is the only way to get dressed for special events!

The dress is 100% Sheek and Sexy! The lace adds a Classy feel while the color makes it POP!  Overall, this dress was AMAZING! It is absolutely beautiful and the color is bold and sexy. I received so many wonderful comments as well. The only issue that I had was the size and zipper. Normally I wear a size 8; however, that ran small with this specific dress so I ended up wearing a 10 which fit me perfect. The zipper in the back was a bit of a struggle once I got to the middle because it would catch on the inner lining of the dress. Other than that, everything about the dress was perfect. I would definately rent this dress again; heck, I would buy it!
Party after my daughters wedding in a Botanical Garden.  Normally, i will wear a 0 or 2.   The body fit fine but the sleeve were tight and i do not have particularly large arms.
Beautiful teal color! Covers, but very sexy. Arms are snug. Rest of dress fits true to size.

Absolutely stunning! I loved this dress. It was perfect for a guest of a formal wedding (but not black-tie). I'm 5'11" so the length was actually just right. I received compliments all night. I ordered this in my usual dress size, 6, as well as an 8 for backup - I'm glad I got the back-up because the lace is forgiving but the underlining is not.

Even strangers in the bathroom complemented me! As others have said, it runs a bit long for a shorter girl (Im 5'2") but it was classy and elegant for the conservative wedding I attended.  At first it seemed tight in the sleeves but I didn't notice it throughout the night.  The 4 was too baggy on me.  The color is unique and lovely.

The dress looked good and it made me feel good! I typically wear a size 4 but the size 6 fit me better.  The 4 was just a bit too tight.  Dress was comfortable and very appropriate for my event (cousin's wedding).  I got many compliments on the dress and would rent it again!!!

Gorgeous color and form fitting This is one of my favorite dresses I've rented. The color is so rich. I probably would not have rented this if I hadn't tried the hot pink Monique Lhuillier dress in the same cut. I was afraid the length and sleeves might make it matronly, but not at all. I am also unsure of some lace dresses, because some lace patterns make you look bigger. Not this one. It skims curves beautifully and turns it into a sexy, formal looking dress. I would buy this one tomorrow if I could afford it.

Great dress for a January wedding! Very pretty dress but runs small!  I am 5'7" and 140 lbs and I needed the 10.  Snug but has some stretch to it.  I agree with the other reviews that it's pretty hard to move your arms in this, so not the best for dancing.  Loved the color and the length of the hem line.

(Larger size) was very comfortable and pretty.  Wore this dress for a baptism which I was the Godmother. I needed to size up to a 12 for this dress because the size 10 was too tight in the shoulders and I would not have been able to hold the baby comfortably. I thought the lining underneath was going to be separate pieces for the chest and hips/thighs (as it shows on the model) but it was one solid piece which was a pleasant surprise. I wore with a statement necklace and earrings; got lots of compliments. I would definitely wear again.

I loved this dress.  It was very "Jackie-O" and comfortable. I wore this dress for my cousin's wedding and spent the better half of the afternoon and all night in it.  It was comfortable, flattering, and runs true to size.  Everyone loved it, including me!!!!

Beautiful, elegant dress that is comfortable This was a great dress, but I would definitely suggest going for the larger of the "two sizes."  It runs tight in the arms/shoulder area. Very comfortable and elegant.  Very form-fitting. You can definitely wear a strapless bra without any issues.
Received lots of compliments on this beautiful dress! This dress was very nice - definitely very high quality.  It was had a very elegant and sophisticated look.

Very classy. Fits true to size. Beautiful color.  I loved this dress and was pleasantly surprised at the fit. I was afraid it was too small but it fit perfectly. Not to tight in the arms or anywhere. It may just be the way my body is made, but the fabric bunched a little around the 'spare tire' area. I didn't love that, obviously, but it was probably only noticeable to me. very very classy, great color, fun dress overall

Perfect wedding dress!! I got so many compliments! The color is amazing, the size down fit me just right. Im usually a 6 but the 4 was amazing. I really cant say enough good things about the dress. I loved it!!

Comfortable dress! The lace material at the top is sheer, as well as at the hemline. So, if going braless or with a strapless bra isn't for you, you'll won't like this dress.   That said, the dress is a beautiful color and actually has some black in the lace detail which may be hard to see in the pictures. For that reason you will want to pair it with black shoes instead of nude  (which is what I had originally planned before I saw the black threading).  This dress was extremely comfortable, the lace had stretch so it is great for busty girls and it was easy to dance in all night. I would definitely rent again! Size up...it runs SMALL.

Very Comfortable Dress. Works well for Girls with Curves!! I wore this dress for a Bridal Shower I hosted for the Bride (pictured with me!) I received many compliments on the color and elegance of the dress. I would definitely recommend this dress to anyone; thin and curvy!

Dress was a beauty!  Loved this dress.  but material does not stretch.  The arms were tight, couldn't lift my arms more than 90 degrees and the dress was hard to dance in.  Other than that, loved the dress. felt great. and I got so many compliments.

Classic! I actually rented another dress, and when I was picking it up I saw this one in the Flatiron store. Simple and classic. I felt like Joan from Mad Men :) 

Fits tight in all the right places, but still conservative enough for a cocktail event. It was a littttle snug under the arms, but other than that perfect fit, looked like I had it tailored. The color is gorgeous, I paired it with a pink/red lipstick and minimal eye makeup. Great rental, would definitely rent it again.
Elegant dress for a beautiful wedding!  The dress fit really well and the color was beautiful. I’m 5’4 so the dress was a little longer than expected but still was a good length.
Very beautiful dress, just be sure to order larger! The color is a lovely deep green, not the blue in pictures.  It is a tight dress!
Family pictures. I loved this dress- had compliments all day.

The lace and color make this dress perfect! Very little stretch to the sleeves. I wore a nude bra even though you could see the straps if you looked closely. I kept tugging it down throughout the night because it would bunch up right at my hips. And that is possible because I am pretty full around the bottom. I felt so pretty and elegant all night!

Great for a formal rehearsal dinner! This was a perfect dress for a very formal rehearsal dinner at an exclusive club in Boston. I knew I had to be fancy without going too far into cocktail attire. This definitely did the trick - it's young without being too covered up! I will say the arms definitely have no give because they are straight lace. I have pretty small arms and I felt that if they were any bigger, I couldn't have worn the dress. Also, I am typically a 2-4 and the 4 BARELY worked for this, so I'd size up! Compliments ALL night from strangers, so it was all worth it.

Danced the night away!  Dress is tight. I went up a size and it was still tight, almost didn't wear it. The lace does not have stretch. If you are large chested, you may consider not renting it. Lace is beautiful and great for a fall/winter wedding.

This is was amazing, I feel in love with it! This dress fit a little tighter then usual, but I didn't mind because it looked absolutely stunning on. I was so in love with this dress I was sad when i had to take it of at night. I had received so many compliments all night on this dress. I would recommend this  dress 100% of the time.

A beautiful autumn wedding! True to other reviews, this dress definitely runs small and I'm glad I ordered one size larger!  It was the perfect color, perfect fit and just the right level of elegance for an autumn wedding.  I received so many complements; I would definitely wear this dress again!

Nice, but not glamorous The dress looked nice, but not as stunning as ones I previously rented from RtR. It was very conservative, even a bit dowdy. The fit was snug but not constraining--I went one size larger than my normal size. Overall, an appropriate and comfortable dress.

Beauitful dress... for a beautiful night!  The dress is beautiful, it's very classy and still sexy.  I ordered a 2 and a 4 and really went back and forth on which one to wear.  The 2 fit my bottom half perfectly but was TIGHT on top especially in the arms which is rare for me, I have really thin arms and at a 34B I almost never find anything to be too tight through my bust.  The 4 fit my top great but was too big in the hips and just looked weird..... I ended up going with the 2 but would advise anyone with a bigger bust or arms to save yourself the stress of having to find another dress the day before your event, and avoid this one altogether.
Love.  Very body con but in flattering way for fuller figure.  Ton of compliments on the color. Body conscious but for fuller figure

The color was just GORGEOUS and it fit really well There's very little give in the dress due to the lace overlay. I'm a 34D, with a 29" waist and 40" hips. Much bigger than that and I think I would have had to size up. I also have somewhat broad shoulders, due to my largish bust, so the shoulders were somewhat uncomfortable. A little more give in the shoulders would have been nice, since even driving was a bit bothersome. I also had some marks at the shoulder joint at the end of the night from where the seam would cut in a bit. Not horrible, but I did notice it. 

The color is SO vibrant, and the dress is very flattering. I would 100% wear this dress again and would buy it if it became available.

It was a black tie wedding, and the dress was perfect. This is a beautiful dress.  It fit perfectly in a 6, which is my normal size.  I received several compliments on it.  Best of all, it was comfortable too!

On trend color and lace This dress is simply gorgeous: a sophisticated choice for a fall afternoon wedding. I usually take a size 4 but ordered the 6 as backup: while the 4 was very flattering, it was a bit tight - I wore the 6 and it was perfect. The teal color looks more like a true green in daylight, and is totally on trend this season...and was a nice deviation from all the standard black dresses at the event. The lace overlay is beautiful and adds a feminine touch.  This is a perfect rental dress as it is memorable and I wouldn't want to wear more than once. Highly recommended!

Not trying hard but well dressed.   This dress is a little more casual than most of the black tie dresses that I have rented.  But I loved it.  Very cute and fun.  Fits great.  I did size up after reading other reviews.  I am 5'4 and I could only wear short heels (like less than 2 inches.)  Very comfortable. The material is very thick and I think most gals would prefer spanx with it to smooth because the peplum stops/starts instead of going all the way around, so you can definitely notice the break at the tummy.

Attending a military gala and meeting true, selfless heroes.  This was a backup dress sent after my first pick did not fit. I am just over 5'8", 125 lbs, and I am finding with the other dresses, the fit on the bust is very tight. This dress accommodated my frame as well as my bust. Overall, the dress accentuated my curves without being too tight or revealing -- perfect for my event.
The fit was perfect! I needed to wear the long with heels....

This was a black tie event where I along with seven other women were being honored. The dress was a perfect fit!  Loved the simple lines, and sophisticated styling. The navy color stood out amongst the many black dresses that were worn to the event.  I love this dress - the fabric, the flair, the peplum - it was perfect!

Amazing dress! The dress did fit a little snug so I would get your size and a size up when you order. The material was fantastic, it fit so well and I received compliments all night! I would recommend this dress!

I felt really confident in this dress and it flattered my body type. This gown was fun, flattering and suited a corporate black tie gala. I thought the peplum was age appropriate, the gown had a sophisticated look but it didn't age me. Also, it is great for all seasons so I may rent this gown again.
I love this dress and would definitely rent it again! Zipper was tough to get up but overall it was a comfortable, beautiful dress. The fabric was a bit heavy.
Has nice stretch and is comfortable This dress is classy and a nice navy color. It gives a nice shape and is forgiving.
I got so many compliments on this dress.  It really gives a very nice shape.  Flattering! Runs a little small I think but it is beautifully made so it really flatters the body - very feminine!

I received  so many compliments on this dress, it fit great! I wore it to a formal charity event . Runs a little small , I read the reviews and ordered a size up, and it fit perfectly. 
I am 5'1 and the regular wear size 10 I ordered a size 12 and it  fit perfectly with heels.

I am 5'2", so I was concerned about the length, but it was perfect with 1 1/2" heels! The dress is SO comfortable and slimming; it was so easy to wear. I am  thrilled that I chose this dress for a late-night formal wedding! I actually ate a full dinner AND danced all night and this dress remained comfortable, unwrinkled, and flattering, ALL NIGHT! My favorite parts about the dress: very comfortably slimming through the waist and hips, and with 1 1/2 inch heels the dress just skimmed the floor...so I was able to wear really comfortable wedge heels and you could only see a peep of the toe when I walked!
WAs a very classy and form fitting dress... gives you curves where you want them and sways beautifully when you walk or dance

Stunned silence followed by compliments. Runs small, I normally wear an 8. The 8 fit, but was tighter in the posterior than I wanted. If you plan on wearing heels and are over 5'7" I would suggest getting the long. Other reviews suggested it and I am glad I took their advice. I am 5'9" and wore the dress with 4" heels, which gave me the perfect clearance for navigating up and down the stairs, dancing, etc. The material has a bit of texture to it; this was perfect as it made Spanx unnecessary. Fantastic dress. I will buying it as soon as I find it in my size.
Wedding Normally wear 8, but it didn't fit.  Had a 10R which fit fine.  I am 5'6'' and feel the 10L would have been better but it wasn't available.  Dress was pretty and I will definitely rent again.

Classy & Chic Wore to a black tie affair and received compliments from my fiancé's coworkers all night long. The 2 was snug, but the 4 would have been too big. Material is thick, some what stretchy. Great cut for all figures.  Perfect length when wearing 4in heels (normally 5'2).  At the end of the evening my fiancé said, "I am so glad you're going to be my wife." He is a keeper and so is this gown.

Classy, Elegant, Simple Received two compliments from complete strangers before even getting to the event, both saying the dress fit me perfectly :) It was simple and very beautiful, the peplum gives you a tiny waist while hiding any imperfections. The dress was very tight around my thighs, hips, and bum but it still looked great. If you're gifted in those areas keep that in mind when ordering sizes. The arm holes were also a little tight but I have broad shoulders/strong arms so it may not be that way for everyone. The dress has a little stretch which is good, only con I felt was that the peplum top does not have any give so when you sit down it will still squeeze your waist pretty tight. I got the L and it hit the floor perfectly, I am 5'9" and wore flats.

This dress was beautiful!  The dress fits true to size but it was SUPER LONG on me. I followed the suggestions on the site before choosing my size but it still didn't fit right lengthwise. A 0P would have been perfect but I just ended up buying hem tape and fixing it as best as I could. My recommendation is that if you don't plan on wearing huge heels then you may want to older a length shorter than normal. Other than that, it was perfect and I would definitely recommend it to all my friends!

Beautiful dress, but too tight in the chest.  This dress was beautiful. It has a wonderful cut. However I would order a size up. I normally wear a 4 or a 6, but I only had the 4 in this dress and it was too tight in the rib cage. I would recommend ordering a size up.

Black-tie wedding - Great dress!  I loved this dress and so did everyone else. Very comfortable - very form-fitting. I could have gotten away with the 2 as the 0 was a little tight, but the hips/thighs on the 2 were just a bit too large. I would size up if you have fuller hips. Was able to wear a normal bra, which was great! If you're tall, I'd suggest going for the Long - I'm only 5'3" and had to wear short heels with the regular - definitely don't do petite if you're even above 5'0" and want to wear any kind of heel!

PERFECT dress for any formal event!  What a great first experience with Rent the Runway! Received the gown, it fit perfectly. No issues. Even the delivery bag was adorable! This dress was absolutely beautiful! It was form fitting in all the right place, and it was comfortable all night long. The color is a cool navy, and it stands out from your typical black dress. I received tons of compliments! It was a perfect dress for our friends gala & I couldn't of asked for a better first experience with Rent the Runway!
Great dress  Beautiful dress. It was so comfortable and was perfect for a black tie event I was working. I would rent it again in a heartbeat!

Absolutely perfect! This dress is so beautiful! Its extremely flattering in all of the right places, and the fit is perfect. It wasn't too long at all, you could just barely see my shoes! I got so many compliments on it and I won best dressed! Overall, I would definitely rent this dress again.

Dress was so beautiful, the perfect style and color for fall. Got so many compliments The dress was wonderful. It fit me absolutely perfectly. A bit tight in the hips but I expected that as I have wider hips. A beautiful dress, it couldn't have been more perfect

Navy gown plays up blue eyes and is very elegant! This gorgeous, lightweight and comfortable dress was elegant, and looked perfect with a pearl strand of white, gray and dark blue. It had a slight give to it - and ran very true to size. I'm only 5'1", though and was disappointed that the length was way too long with my 3 1/2 " heels (I won't wear anything any higher for comfort's sake). But I called customer service and they said it was fine if I used some iron on stitch witchery to shorten it - as long as I undid it before shipping back. I was the Mother of the Groom, and the colors of the wedding were light beige and navy so this was perfect. It was comfortable enough to eat in, dance in and enjoy the long day and evening!! It has a lovely V in the back, but overall is modest enough for a church ceremony without feeling self-conscious. Like I said in the summary - it really plays up blue eyes!  I've rented several times from RTR and was totally confident that I would get the gown in time and have a wonderful experience - regardless of the magnitude of this event - it just doesn't get much more important than being MOG and having a great dress!  As expected, I was NOT disappointed. It was fabulous and I will rent again for my next big soiree`!

I received so many compliments on this dress, beautiful fit and perfect for a winter event! Dress fits snug around the waist and down to the knee, but the fit is great. I ordered my regular size 4 and a 6R as backup, but it was huge. The dress definitely fits true to size. I was able to wear a regular bra with it and spanks underneath. Fabric is thick, but comfortable and perfect for the winter time. Loved this amazing dress, I'd rent it again!!

Danced the night away and felt fabulous!!! Perfect for a Fall Wedding in Chi-town! This dress is simple, elegant and extremely comfortable. I danced in it all night long. The fabric is thick and yet it is so flexible and flowing. It hugs your body in all the right places. I recommend getting one size up as a back up, it is more fitted in the bust area. I went with the 4L instead and it was the perfect fit and length. The dress is definitely a keeper!  So sad to be sending it back.

Classy, elegant dress for a formal wedding I wore this dress to a NYE wedding and received several compliments! It fit like a GLOVE, aka on the very fitted side. Overall I'd say it fits true to size, but if you're looking for a little wiggle room, I'd recommend sizing up. Also note that the dress is extremely fitted through the hips, so you can't get too low on the dance floor :) This was my first experience using RTR and I could not have been happier with the process/dress!

N/A The fit complemented by figure beautifully. It hid the areas I wanted to hide (kangaroo pouch) and emphasized the areas I wanted to show off (booty)! The length was just right with a heel (Front half of my shoes were showing). I am normally a size 6 so the dress was a little snug but not unbearable. The only con about this dress is the zipper was very difficult to zipper (on and off of my body).  RTR  staff was extremely helpful and courteous when I did not like my first dress choice. Certainly recommend RTR for a formal ocassion.

I absolutely loved this dress! It's perfect for any formal night! I am normally a size 4, but sometimes I have to go up a size because of the tightness through the hips. I decided that the 4 was much better in this case since I wasn't able to alter it. I am 5'4" and needed the 4L in order to wear heels. With my 3" heels it was perfect against the ground and I could dance all night long.

Hugged in the right places... The dress is definitely needs a shaper if you have even a little tummy pooch lol. I loved the way the dress hugged my curves. The only con was that my backup size which was a long was not available. I'm 5'8 so the dress was a little short. Anyone over 5'7 must get a long. I work dark shoes so I was able to play it off. Overall, the dress was simple yet elegant and classy.

Great Dress for a Black Tie Wedding This dress was perfect for a winter black tie wedding. The color is a pretty true navy and was a great "break" from the sea of black dresses. I got a regular, and at around 5'5" could have gotten a long to wear with higher heels. I wore around 1" - 1 1/2" inch wedges and it worked. It does, however, run a little small. I'm normally a 0 or 2comfortably in BCBG and the 2 in this dress was a little snug in the hips. I would have liked to have tried on the 4 just to see if it would have allowed a little more room in the hips to dance. Otherwise, great dress that I would definitely rent again!

Danced all night long! I first tried on the 2P and the waist/hip area was extremely loose on me. So, I tried on the 0P and it fit like a glove. The bust area was a bit tight but I loved that I was able to wear a normal bra with this dress. I'm relatively short so I was nervous about renting a full length gown, but I was able to wear the heels I planned on wearing which were about 2"/3" heels.  Overall, I loved this dress and got tons of compliments the whole night! Definitely worth it!

Non-Profit Gala Dress fit perfectly. I'm 5' 2" and I wore 3-inch heels - it is rare that a long gown fits me so perfectly in terms of length. It was a last-minute rental and I was very happy it worked out!

A sexy, unforgettable dress. I ordered this dress for my Prom, and holy cow, it was incredible. It fit every curve of my body, the color is gorgeous, the fabric is nice but not too heavy- just an overall fantastic dress. The peplum at the waist is a great touch, and the flair at the bottom is classy and elegant. I'd recommend ordering your normal size, and then one down, as the fabric can stretch a little bit. I really recommend this dress!
Black Tie Affair Dress was perfect! If you are in between sizes - go a size up because dress is made of a somewhat stretchy material.

Another formal military event and being able to rent a dress instead of purchase is wonderful! Very comfortable dress. I danced all night in it with ease. It did run a little small, I typically wear a size 6 and I had to wear the 8.

The dress fit absolutely perfectly, it hugs all the right spots it is simple yet classy af. Okay so the dress was a little tight(my decision, thought it looked better) so it was slightly tough to bend over when I dropped my purse. It is perfect for a slightly chilly night as it is a little heavy, but my night was warm and I had no problem. Never thought renting a dress would go so smoothly as it did.

This dress was perfect for a black tie wedding.  This dress has enough coverage for a black tie event in a catholic church but hugged the curves in all the right places to make it sexy! A great color on anyone and something besides just black. I am small chested and it was still a little tight under the arms but it wasn't enough of a problem for me to really notice. 

This dress fit like a glove and makes you feel sexy! The bottom flare part makes it so fun to walk and dance in. I am 5 7' and wore the long with  11/2 inch heels and it was the perfect length!

Perfect dress for a Black Tie Winter wedding! Very pretty dress. The length was perfect for me, but if you're taller than 5'4 I would recommend ordering a Long if you plan to wear heels.  Fit was a little snug especially after eating. If you're in between sizes, size up,
Also the color is more navy than blue in person.

This dress was tighttt. I went up a size, so it worked out, but still... Suck it in! I wore this dress to wedding. I was hoping to wear the 4R, but ended up wearing my backup size because this dress was tighttt. It was super cute and I received plenty of compliments. The fabric is heavier than expected but I was OK with that.

Elegant yet professional This dress was classic and stunning, accentuating all the right features. Hugged close around the chest and waist and flared out in mermaid fashion at the bottom. Perfect for hourglass figure and loved how the neckline scooped in the back. I'm 5'5" and the 6 was the perfect length with 3.75" heels. Arguably, my favorite feature was the material--no steaming necessary even after travel.

Classic silhouette with a special detail! I wore this dress to a recent holiday party and felt great in it! My normal size 4R fit like a glove but the length was too short for my liking. I decided to wear the size 6 instead, which was a little bit looser, but still looked great. The extra length (at least 4") allowed me to wear a short heel without my shoes peeking out. Overall it was a great  first rental experience!

New Years Eve formal wedding  Loved this dress. Truely timeless and so comfortable. I’m typically an in between sizes kind of girl because my bottom half is a little healthier in size than my top so I could fit into the 6 but it was puckering in places it shouldn’t so I went with the 8 and it was perfect. Fabric is very comfortable and felt it hid imperfections I wanted it to. The length was great for me as I wore 3-4 inch heels and it was just sweeping the floor. You can also wear any bra you want with this dress so that is always a big thing for me. Totally loved it!

I got a ton of compliments and felt very comfortable at a black tie wedding! I got a ton of compliments and it was very comfortable (for a formal dress.) I wore 3 inch heels and I am 5' 6" which made it the perfect length. I was able to put it on with a bra (34B) or sticky boobs. For those who are comfortable, it seems like you could go braless if you wanted. Easy to put on/walk/sit in! I definitely recommend it for a formal event.

OBSESSED This is the most gorgeous gown. The fabric is amazing quality - thick and well lined. Color is a gorgeous navy, just like the picture. Wore to a wedding. It's insanely flattering and I got non-stop compliments on it during and after the event. You can wear a bra (#winning) because the straps are just thick enough and the back is low but not too low. DEFINITELY GET A LONG if you are going to wear heels and are a little taller! I also got the 8R because the 6R wasn't available. The bust fit me slightly better on the 8R but it was way too short (like ankle length) and overall the 6L was true to size and I'm glad I went with it. You will not be sorry you rented this gown.

Flawless, effortless I wore this dress to a black tie optional wedding in Newport. The 2P fit like it was tailored for me, and was completely effortless. The material was luxurious, and lighter weight than I expected. It was truly a petite length, and was perfect with 3" heels. It slipped on, flattered my curves, didn't require a bra (although spanx for the belly/butt helped make everything smooth). It was complimented by my husband and wedding guests alike. I'm struggling to not purchase this dress (don't tell my husband!).

I rented this dress as a bridesmaid dress for a black tie wedding and it was lovely. After reading reviews, I decided to rent this dress before the wedding as a "trial run" to determine which size would be best.  During the trial run, I ordered my normal 0P and 2P and the 2P fit perfectly.  For the wedding, I decided to play it safe and rent a 2P and 4P.   Thank goodness I ordered up in size because I couldn't even get the 2P they sent on-it wouldn't go over my hips and butt and was extremely small!  I ended up wearing the 4P for the event and it worked out fine.  I'm 5'2". 105lbs, 32D.  I wore a 2.5" heel and the petite length was perfect.  The bust and waist in the 4P was a little looser than I would have wanted if it were my own personal gown, but it was fine for the wedding.  I was able to wear a normal bra without it showing.  All of the other bridesmaids wore the same gown and it was very flattering on all body types.  I would definitely recommend this for a black tie event.  It was very classy and elegant.  My only advice would be DEFINITELY size up!
Classy, elegant, and perfect for black tie wedding. Received a lot of compliments! Good length and silhouette
Stunning dress Fit beautifully!  I wore 3 inch heels.
I received compliments throughout the night.  I actually ordered this dress as a back up! Fit perfectly.  Very straight fit.  Classic.  I was able to wear a bra which is always a plus.

I plan events for a non profit and this dress was exactly what I wanted.  The fit was perfect. I am glad that I got the 4. It hugged in all the right places and I was able to wear a regular bra with it and not have to worry about it showing in the arm holes or the back. I was able to work, dance, and move freely. The fabric was super comfortable with a little stretch.
Love this dress! I normally wear a size 0 or 2. After reading all the wonderful reviews I ordered sizes 2 and 4. So glad I did! I could barely get the size 2 sipped. But the size 4 fit like a glove!

Great dress for a formal/semi formal event. I wore this dress to a Marine Corps Ball, knowing that there would be some ladies in short dresses, some in cocktail and some in dressy pants. I thought it was appropriate for this event, since it was black tie. So glad I ordered a size up! I wear anything from a 6 to a 10, but this dress ran really small. It was very flattering on my curvy, 50 yr. old figure. I wore 3 inch heels and the length was perfect.
Beautiful dress! I wore it for one of my best friend's wedding and got a lot of compliments. It runs a little small, so I got one size up and it fit perfectly.

Classy Fit & Flare I rented this dress for a Black Tie event and ended up not wearing it. The 0P was a perfect fit for my rather petite frame. 3" heels would have worked perfectly for this goqn. The royal blue color is a very classy and material is quite soft. I had a very difficult time trying to choose which dress to wear, however ended up going with the Badgley Mischka Emmy Gown.
Loved the fit, the color, and the fabric! The fit hugged my curves in a great way. The peplum makes it super flattering, and the skirt is great for twirling on the dance floor!

NOT FOR TALL WOMEN This dress is simple and pretty, but nothing special. I'm 5'9 and 1/2 and the 10L barely touched the ground. I was forced to wear flats but you could still see my feet:-( very disappointed as I was expecting it to hit the floor per some of the reviews. So disappointed:-( But it's a very flattering dress and the material is thick and forgiving.

Comfortable, fun dress-- perfect for black tie events! I wore this to a black tie event and it was incredibly comfortable and I got tons of compliments! The material helps hold you in especially in the stomach area (so you can go for seconds on dessert!) I liked the regular length since I wanted my shoes to show out the front of the dress but I think the long would have worked too. Definitely somewhat different than the classic floor length black gown since the navy and peplum add a lot of interest to the dress. I would absolutely rent this again!

This dress was PERFECT! I have never felt more beautiful! I got compliments all night and it was so comfortable to wear. The length was perfect with a 3" wedge. Now I need another event so that I can rent it in RED! :)

Great gown for a Black Tie Wedding. Sexy and classy! The dress fit true to size and fit like a glove. It shaped my body perfectly and was very comfortable to move it. I felt great in it all afternoon for the ceremony and then into dancing at night. I wore 3 inch heels and the length was just perfect; no tripping or snagging. The dip in the back stopped right at my bra so I could still wear a normal,  regular bra. Very hugging in the hips so be careful of pantie line. Overall this dress was amazing, the rent the runway experience was amazing and I will definitely be renting again!!
got tons of compliments. such a fun dress Fit perfectly

A unique dress for a wedding that separates you from the bridesmaids, received lots of compliments! Runs large, usually I'm a 6 and the 4 fit perfectly.  A very short dress that could easily lift up too far and be revealing, be careful when bending over or crouching or dancing!  Was able to wear a normal bra and underwear though, no lines to worry about through the fabric.  A comfortable dress too, can eat normal and not be too tight around the midsection.  The color is a darker turquoise in person than appears online, but is still very pretty, just different than I expected.

Such a fabulous and classy looking dress! So the color of this dress is this beautiful blue - nothing like the model picture(which to me looked gray). Ended up matching my boyfriends suit perfectly.  This dress was super comfortable to wear and i loved the tutu like skirt.  If you don't like tulle your not gonna like this dress.  I found the dress to be a reasonable length just above the knee, (although I am 5'2" so everythings pretty long on me lol)  The only time i felt it may have been revealing was when I raised my hands in the air to dance, but nothing ever showed.    And when you use the restroom make sure you get the lace to lie flat on the tulle in the back. I almost left the restroom more than once with the lace stuck up and only tulle showing.
My only initial negative was the neckline has some folds of lace that are supposed to rest nicely along your neckline - they unfortunately did not lie as flat as they should so i used my straightener to try and help out.  All in all the dress looked so beautiful I wish I could have kept this one!

Wore this to a Friday night wedding rehearsal dinner; overall a fun, cute, but very classy dress! Loved wearing this dress. I got lots of compliments and people asking about where I'd gotten it! I was the first person to wear the dress (it still had it's tags on when it arrived!), so no issues with the tulle being crushed at all. 

I own dresses in everything from a 0 to a 4, but found this dress to be quite true-to-size (I wore the size 2). 
 If you are trying to decide between two sizes, though, I'd aim for the smaller size. 

The size 2 was fitted perfectly around the bodice; not too tight, but still definitely fitted. The tulle makes the skirt seem a bit short, so that's something to keep in mind, especially if you have really long legs. Though you can't tell from the photos here, there is a nude dress liner the extends all the way down below the tulle, so you don't actually have to worry about showing off too much. 

I wore this dress with nude flats, but this dress could be dressed up a lot if it were worn with heels.

Didn't end up wearing this dreSs I ordered this for a wedding bc it looked beautiful online. The neckline is stunning, the lace is beautiful and the tulle is princess-like. However, the silhouette is too short waisted and fluffy for it to be flattering. The arms were flattering. I didn't like how there was a line where the slip ended and the tulle began. 

I would probably rent this again for Easter brunch, a Christmas party, or my own bridal shower. It's a lot for a wedding and when I got to the church I was happy I found a new dress.

Perfect for my engagement photos.  Fun and romantic. My fiancee said we needed to buy this dress! My only issue is at the wrong angle sitting down, it can make you look wide. Overall, will rent again.

I got lots of compliments on the dress! The dress fit true to size.  I read some reviews before deciding to rent this dress and many people said that the dress was a little short.  I'm 5 ft. tall, so length-wise, this dress was perfect for me!  It was cute, hugs you in the right areas, and still leaves room to move.

Flattering and fun party dress! The color is a prettier teal-blue in real life than in most photos. The shape is really flattering, especially with the adorable puff of tulle at the bottom - it starts low enough in the skirt to not add any fullness to the hips. Perfectly stylish for an outdoor wedding (at an antique barn).
I wore this for my engagement photos. It was STUNNING!  Beautiful dress.

Cute but too poofy This dress is very cute and playful, but the skirt was just too poofy for my tastes, so I ended up wearing a backup dress instead.  I have a small chest and upper body, and the size 2 was definitely too big -- if you're small up top I recommend sizing down. You won't have to worry about the skirt being too snug!
great dress, lots of compliments  great dress, lots of compliments
Loved this dress - it was perfect for a day wedding. The dress was true fit to size. I received many compliments in the dress, even from strangers.
This dress made my engagement photos so amazing! It was a perfect fit! The fit was great! I'm very tall so it was on the shorter side, but it still fit great.

Super fun and flattering, but depends on the tulle... I've rented this dress before in navy--this is the teal version (NB check customer photos for how the color looks in real life) and is just as flattering. Size down for the best fit and fluff out the tulle before wearing for maximum impact. Loads of fun and get ready for the compliments! BUT: I ordered a size 8 as a backup and it looked like the original tulle (which is more of a nude color, and essential to the "fluff" effect at the bottom) had been replaced with a much less fluffy, off-white tulle, which made it an entirely different, unflattering, deflated dress. So, approach with caution. My size 6 had the original tulle intact, fortunately, so it was a successful rental. Keep the accessories minimal since the dress is really the statement piece here. Also--RTR customer service was particularly amazing this time around when my shipment was delayed--thank you!
Amazing dress for our beach photo engagement pictures!!  Beautiful color and style. Fit was perfect!
Completely Obsessed  I wore this dress for a wedding and I couldn't have asked for more. I got a ton of compliments and felt beautiful all night!

The bride complimented my dress! I loved this dress, it was super comfortable and I got so many compliments including one from the bride, the first second she saw me!  I've had problems with my wide shoulders in dresses like this in the past, so I was pleasantly surprised that both the 0 and 2 fit me perfectly.  I almost went with the darker indigo color because of the price, but this color is beautiful and so unique compared to the typical dress you wear to wedding. I got to try it on in the store and after seeing the color in person I knew I had to have it. My only complaint is that I probably would have worn the 0, it was a bit of a snugger fit, but the tulle on the 0 was so worn it had lost its shape, the 2 was much more flattering due to this.
Gorgeous dress, flattering fit! This dress is beautiful, feminine, and forgiving. I am usually a 0 or 2 and the 0 was still a little roomy but not in a way that made it look too big on.

Gorgeous, original and comfortable dress - perfect for a summer wedding! I received compliments on this dress all evening long.  This dress is classy, fun, original and surprisingly comfortable.  One would think any dress with three layers of tulle might be fussy, but the lining of the dress is so soft.  The cut of the dress is extremely flattering and the hem hits right above my knee.  I am 5' 2" so I imagine it might be a little more provocative on a taller woman.   However, the neck line is fairly modest and the material demure so I doubt a taller girl would look scandalous if she were to reveal a little more leg. In addition, you can wear this dress with any undergarment out of your drawer.  I wore a standard bra and it looked lovely.  The dress paired well with my nude heels.  I don’t think this dress calls for excess ornamentation (the blue lace overlay is beautiful – it should really be the focus).  I wore a small pair of blue topaz earrings.  I wore my hair in a flapper-ish chignon and the entire look came off sweet, vintage and slightly sexy.  I think all shapes and sizes of women would look good in this dress.

GORGEOUS, FUN DRESS!!  wore it to a beach wedding in Fla in Oct.  So many compliments! Fit was perfect - I didn't wear a bra.  It was short, but worked for me - I am 5'3".  Absolutely loved this dress - dancing in it was so much fun.  Danced all night.  Received so many compliments on it the entire day - from people at the wedding, and also random people in the hotel.   Loved every minute of having this on! :)

I received so  many compliments in this dress! People kept asking where the dress was from. RTR obvi The fit was slightly large.  I usually wear a four but  the 2 fit perfectly.  the tulle on inside part of the dress was ripped at several places, but it was unnoticeable.  I separated the different layers of tulle to get some more volume, thereby making the dress slightly shorter. The dress is so figure flattering. I didnt need to wear  spanx and I was able to eat as much as I pleased without having my gut show.  The color is even more beautiful in person.  The only downside was that the lace on the neckline was not pressed stiff, so it was a little floppy and tucked inside on some areas.  I would definitely rent this again.

It's just darling!
 its comfortable 
not itchy
fun, cute dress!

I wore minimal accessories and let the dress stand out

Loved everything about this dress! This dress completely surpassed my expectations.  I ordered for a cocktail affair at our country club in June. To start- I was a bit smaller when i ordered the dress as I am now about 12 weeks pregnant (and in secret) in the photo/ event time. and about 140 lbs. I ordered a 4 and 6, thankfully the 6 fit. Given the choice I probably would have preferred an 8.  It quite hid problem pooch areas and was so cute and flattering. I loved the neckline, length, sleeve and color! I thought that my husband/ guys in general would not like the girlie ness of the dress, but in no exaggeration, I have never received so many compliments from men and women. It really stood out from the typical sea of black & white this season. I did neutral makeup & shoes and simple hair/accessories to let the dress take focus.
Wore this to my bridal shower and got tons of complements! Beautiful lace with dramatic skirt!  Runs a bit large, possibly because the lace is so delicate. Can be a bit short though.

Super Fun Dress! I was apprehensive about the color/style for a fall wedding, and after both my husband and 4 year old told me I looked like a princess, which isn't exactly the look I was going for... but at the end of the night I was so happy with my rental. It was so fun to wear, lots of compliments, and super fun to dance the night away with the tulle skirt!

Great, Fun Dress! This was a great dress.  Wore this for engagement photoshoot and it was fun and flirty and took great photos.

Highly recommend it.
So comfortable and classy! Such a cute dress, wish I could keep it! . A little too short for me when wearing heels, but otherwise fit perfectly.

I got so many compliments on the dress, even from the bride herself!  I felt like a princess! This dress looks stunning in person.  The greenish color somehow does not transfer well in photo.  It fits me perfectly.  The shape is very flattering.  High quality workmanship and fabric, as the lace is soft against my skin, not scratchy at all.  This is my first time renting from Rent the Runway and I was so impressed with the whole experience.  I am telling everyone I know about it.

Second only to my wedding dress! I cannot say enough good things about this dress. It is SO flattering and comfortable. The color is beautiful and the nude tulle is so fun. I have also worn this dress in the navy blue color and loved that as well. I am usually between a 2 and 4 and ended up wearing the 2. A bonus was being able to wear a normal bra. Rent this dress!

Fun, Flirty Dress RTR sent this dress as a back-up because the dress I originally rented was not able to be sent. I am so glad it worked out like this in the end because this dress was perfect!
