It is true to size and a beautiful color. Perfect length for a 5'2 - 5'3 frame. I had two weddings to attend that day and I wore it to both & it was flawless. Received compliments all night.

Beautiful dress for a summer wedding!  Loved this dress for a summer wedding, it was so comfortable and I got compliments all night! I ordered a 4 and a 6 and went with the 6 ultimately for length, the 4 fit a little better on top but since it was a bit windy I didn't want the dress length to be an issue. Would def rent again LOVED it!

Loved it so much, I extended my rental! Rented it for a special celebration for my husband's birthday. He loved it, I got so many compliments from random strangers who stopped me to ask where I got the dress. Pros: Gorgeous and comfortable, and you can wear a regular bra with it. Cons: the shoulders do run a little large, so if you have a small frame like me, all it takes is either sticky tape, or I just pinned the shoulders to my bra straps, and no issues all night. 

Also,  I have to say RTR made me a believer with their customer service for this rental. I loved the dress so much I ended up extending it from 4 day to 8 day rental, and customer service was on point. Since it was a Sunday, and I was frantic that I wouldn't get anyone in time, I contacted them on FB, their email, and the website and I got responses from all 3 in a timely manner.  Huge win for RTR, I'm back and will be renting again and again!

Lots of compliments on the dress. This is a really fun dress. You may want to think twice about wearing it to an event where you will spend a lot of time sitting down because the tulle is kind of scratchy and the skirt is very short. It has a cute retro/ballerina vibe between the lace and the tulle. It's a great combination of trends and I'm really glad that I got the chance to wear it.
Got tons of compliments, looked great on Fit is true to size
Perfect summer wedding dress! Great fit, comfortable dress. I got lots of compliments on it!

Absolutely Beautiful! The dress was slightly bigger than I anticipated, which was GREAT because I was able to freely move and eat as much as I wanted. I loved the dress, so most of my cons are nit-picky. In my opinion, the dress wasn't as short as the other reviews say, but I would avoid bending over too much. The lace fringe at the neck kept tucking itself in, so I had to keep adjusting it. Only big complain about the dress is that the sleeves are a bit restrictive, so I wasn't able to lift my arms up too high in fear of ripping the lace.

Perfect for pear shapes! Flattering & super forgiving, great for dancing. Having recently had my third child, I needed a dress that would flatter my figure and forgive the extra curves. Not only did this gorgeous dress accomplish those objectives, it was also super comfortable. The interior lining is very soft and the dress moves with you. The crinoline makes it just glide over the hips/thighs. The neckline was perfect - not too low, showing just a slight amount of cleavage, and I'm currently about a 34 DD/E. The color is amazing too, great for red heads like me with fair skin and freckles. It's a deep teal/peacock blue. Lace pattern is beautiful. Overall just a really pretty, girly party dress that's sophisticated enough to be worn at 30+. Overall it was a great choice for the outdoor garden wedding we attended.
The only reason that I gave it 4 stars is the non-petite fit. I typically chose dresses with a petite fit because I have a short torso. With this dress, the 8 fit perfectly in the hips but was way too big in the torso, most obviously in the neckline, while the 6 fit perfectly in the torso and neckline but was about an inch shorter and more fitted in the hips. I went with the 6 and it looked great, but I did have to be careful dancing, bending and sitting due to the short length (and I'm only 5'1"). If you are tall, definitely give the length some consideration when choosing your sizes.

This dress made me  feel classy and cute. Making my first Homecoming a comfortable one.  The dress was beautiful, it made me feel like I was from Alice in Wonderland. It was a little big around the waist but I easily fixed it with a mid-waist belt. Adding a cute look to it.

So many compliments! I fell in love with this dress from the moment I opened the box. The color was a little darker than the photo online, but I honestly liked it better. I ordered a 0 and a 2 based on other reviews saying it runs large. Both sizes fit, but since I was going to be dancing and socializing all night I opted for the 2 since it was more comfortable. The wedding was held in an art museum with a higher class crowd and I received an unbelievable amount of compliments all night long- even from complete strangers! I would absolutely rent this little beauty again, thanks RTR!

Sooooo fun!!  this dress made me feel like a mini princess :D  Received so many compliments! Fit was great.  I recently had a baby and this did a great job of hiding my tummy.  it is a bit on the short side which me being 5'4" I'd caution someone who is taller that they may end up exposing more of their backside than they want to.

This was a wonderful dress for my rehearsal dinner! It was a great dress and fit very well on top. I am normally a 2, but needed the size 0 for this. The only problem is, I'm 5'9 and the 0 was a little shorter than I would've liked. It looked beautiful anyway I just had to be careful about bending over!

Got so many complements on this dress, everyone loved it. BUT SHORT! This fit very well and was very flattering, but beware if you're a tall lady like myself, this dress is SHORT! I had to watch myself all night about bending over because the slightest tilt forward and this dress and all of it's tulle would flip right up and expose my rear. If you're a shorter gal, probably no problem.

Great girly dress - lots of compliments Wore for a formal occasion with a blue theme.  Great color and stood out as different from all of the navy and royal dresses.  Cute fit and flare style was very girly.  A little bit of a ballerina style with the pinkish underlayer.
Beautiful dress and I got tons of compliments!!! Fun and flirty dress! I got to wear a normal bra underneath which is great for dancing! I also tied a ribbon around the waist which I think it needs!

I got so many compliments! This dress was actually my extra dress! After deciding that my first pick was too formal, I went with this and it was perfect. I got a 10 and a 12 (I normally wear 12) and I could have fit in an 8. Loved the 10, though. It was comfortable, easy to dance in, and fun! The whole dress is lined so I didn't need a bra. 

Love!

Classy, Chic, and Comfortable!  I rented this dress for a southern evening wedding so I wanted something feminine, classy, but still fun. The nha khanh- On Cloud Nine dress was absolutely perfect. The color was very unique. I would say it was in between an aqua color and a light blue. The petty coat and lace gave it such a sweet feminine feel and whatever the stretchy material was felt great. For the ladies that don't want to draw attention to their hips and thighs- THIS IS YOUR DRESS. The dress was very movable and comfortable. I could eat, dance, and prance without any restrictions. I was worried that the skirt would make me look even shorter than I am, but it cut in just the right area. I added a skinny metallic belt to help break up the dress. I wish I hadn't posted so many pictures and gotten so many compliments (from both young and old- men and women) because I would absolutely rent this dress again. Another home-run with RTR. This sight is truly a God-send.
Great fit, easy to wear, fun party dress! Short, light weight, structured skirt.  Great party dress!
Great dress Dress really did fit great and I got a lot of compliments. It was fun and flirty and comfortable.

Wish I could keep it! This is one of my favorite RTR dresses. I wore this to a bridal shower and it was perfect. I loved everything about it and was so sad that I had to return it. The color is gorgeous and the fit was fantastic. Even the cap sleeves were flattering, hitting at the right part of the arm. The skirt is fun and the tulle is very soft (it does tend to get a little wrinkled just out of the bag from travel, but a quick steam fixed that right up) and restores the flounciness. I got a ton of compliments on this dress and people were shocked to hear that it was a rental.

STUNNING dress!! I didn't end up wearing this dress strictly because my plans changed overall and it no longer felt the mood. HOWEVER, it was GORGEOUS! it came with tags on, was gorgeous, pretty, elegant and perfect for my body type. it wasnt too baggy on my small chest. i normally wear a 4 but the 2 was perfect. such a stunning dress.

Beautiful, fashionable dress for a Fashion Design Graduate I rented this for my (2nd) college graduation.  I was graduating with a Fashion Design degree, so I knew I wanted something to stand out (seeing as I didn't have time to make something myself).   This dress was gorgeous, and the moment I took off my cap and gown, people immediately began exclaiming "Oh my god, that dress!" It's so feminine and lovely, that it makes you want to twirl around like a little girl, yet it feels grown up enough that it's perfect for a day at the winery (which is where I spent my grad after-party!)  The tulle is just enough fluff not to overdo it.  It's formal enough to pull off for a fancy event, but the color makes it easy enough to wear to something a little less pretentious.  Great for a garden party/outdoor wedding/winery/etc.  I paired it with the Kendra Scott Grayce Necklace.

On sizing - I am a size 10-12, depending on the brand.  I generally ere on the side of 12,  because I am curvy and hippy.  Because this dress is a-line, and the waist is not super-tight, I wore the size 10 which fit perfectly in the length and shoulders. (I'm only 5'3").

So feminine and pretty! This was my favorite RTR dress I have ever rented. Rented it for the Kentucky Derby and it was PERFECT. Very feminine and the fit was right on. Paired it with a big Derby hat, and I got many compliments! I was sad to mail this one back since I really, really fell in love with it.

Wore this to the Canadian Embassy holiday charity gala! This dress is SHORT. But so am I, so it wasn't a problem. I have no clue how the 5'10" model in the picture fit in it, though. 

Loved this dress! Got a million compliments from strangers, it was comfortable, it fit perfectly, and the color was gorgeous. My husband got drunk and kept telling me I needed to go online and buy it because it looked so good.

This dress was so comfortable and so much fun to wear!  I rented this dress for a friend's fall wedding. The color was amazing--- I think I was the only person that wasn't wearing black! It's very comfortable, stretchy and soft fabric, I probably could have gone down a size to the six, but as a larger chested girl, it was more comfortable in the eight. It was a lot of fun to dance in, but a tad short, so be careful!
Beautiful color, very comfortable! The only con is that the back blue layer can get caught up on the tulle so I was always checking to be sure that my bum wasn't showing.

LOVED this dress! Received compliments all night!  This dress was perfect - it runs a little big, so I'm glad I ended up ordering a smaller size as my back-up. The color was beautiful and I've never received so many compliments on a dress before. People kept coming up to me and telling me how much they loved it. I'll definitely be renting this one again!

I LOVE this dress!  Fun, feminine and classy This was the perfect dress for an outdoor summer wedding.  The fit and color was very flattering and I loved the flared skirt.  If i were any taller it would have felt too short but it was perfect for my height.   I got so many compliments on this one! Thanks RTR!

I got so many compliments on this dress! I wore this dress to a family wedding. It fits great! It was a little short so you have to be careful with bending over or walking up stairs. I am 5'5" and it was borderline too short to wear for me. Overall the fit was great and I loved the dress.

Perfect dress for the occasion Overall it was a great dress for a summer wedding! I got size 4 and a 2 for backup. Both fit fine but both dresses had a little fluff in the back where my bum was (the layers were sewn together there) so it was a little annoying. It was less visible in the 4 so I wore that. Other than that it was great to dance in!

This dress is made for the dance floor!  I rented this for an outdoor evening wedding in late September and it was the perfect cocktail dress for the occasion. The fit is excellent and I actually wore the Size 2, which made me very happy. This dress runs large, so size down for your backup.  The color is amazing and photographs really well. I'm short waisted and the natural waist of the dress was perfect for me. I didn't feel like this was too short at all. The only fit issue for me was that the lace in the V neck kept folding under, but that wasn't a big deal and you could probably address it with fashion tape. I'd rent this dress or this brand again for sure.

Amazing rehearsal dinner dress! I wore this for my wedding rehearsal dinner and LOVED it. I didn't want to give it back! I received countless compliments throughout the night and it fit just so perfectly. Unfortunately I didn't have a better picture, we were so busy this night! Very flattering around the midsection and the slight sparkle was just beautiful. And can we talk about the back?! So stunning. 10 stars for this dress, rent it now!
Bachelorette party I wore the same style in blush for my sister's wedding, and loved it so much that I changed my order for my bachelorette party.  This dress is sexy yet classy and super fun!
Show Stopper Hit me right above the knee, which is great with my height. Very comfortable and easy to wear! Loved it
I wore this for my wedding rehearsal dinner. I got loads of compliments & was very comfortable. I wore NuBra with the dress & it worked perfectly.

I wore this for my college graduation and it was perfect! The dress fit true to size. It's a snug fit on the bottom half but very comfortable. I wore this for my college graduation so unfortunately a lot of the pictures were with the gown over the dress, but I got lots of compliments and was happy I chose this dress. I would highly recommend it. The back is beautiful!

I looked great ;-) 
 Great dress.  Fits well and fabric thick enough to wear braless.  Elegant and simple, but still sexy enough. Wear with an undo and statement earrings.  I wore vintage Chanel earrings and the look was very Vegas without being over the top.

Bride-to-Be  I wore this dress in gold for my 30th and loved it so I got it in white for my bachelorette - and felt like a million bucks! I'm a true pear shape and was able to wear this dress without a bra. The dress has give and is fitted but relaxed so you can still sit and eat dinner.

This dress was perfect for the "white party" charity benefit event I attended! This dress fit like a glove! True to size, and maybe even a little small b/c it was perfectly tight where it needed to be :)  The dress has  lot more sparkle than shown in the model picture which worked out perfectly for my event.
This dress was amazing! so many compliments. I wore it for my Rehearsal Dinner.  perfect fit. True to size. I am 5'4" about 120lbs and it fit perfectly.

very comfortable and elegant! I ended up wearing the smaller of the two sizes I got (2 and 4), it was very stretchy material that was sexy but not too revealing. Just a teeny bit itchy on the back at times!

Perfect shower dress. Made me feel like a very special bride. Loved it. Very flattering, got tons of compliments. The dress was very comfortable and i felt pretty in it. The only draw back was that it kept twisting as I wore it. It was not too small at all, so i am not really sure why it was twisting. Since there is a zipper up the back it was pretty noticeable. I even had several people tell me about it, but there was really nothing i could do. Still loved the dress though. No regrets.

The perfect dress to end a perfect evening. This dress could not have been better.  I wore this for the after dress for my wedding.  I got so many compliments.  Everything fit perfect.  I felt like the perfect bride.

I loved this dress!  It was so flattering!  I loved this dress!  It was so flattering!  I am short so I worried that it would be wayyy too long.  It was perfect for a political event then to a nice dinner with my husband.  Not a great picture of the dress.  It was not scratchy even though its full sequence. The cut of the dress is unique and beautiful.   I can't wait to rent this in the other color as well!  Thanks RTR.
I wore this dress for my bachelorette party. I have an athletic frame and it formed it well. Hard to dance because legs have to stay close together. Other than that, everything was great!

Sexy!  But not right for a holiday party I somehow thought this dress would look great for my husband's upcoming company holiday party.  It is super sexy, very comfortable, very flattering in all the right places!  All the other positive reviews are on spot.  It's perfect for a bride after-party (as many other reviewers have done), or a summer formal party - even for New Year's Eve.  Will definitely rent again...for the right occasion. Kudos to RTR for exchanging the dress in time for the Christmas party.  Easy-peasy!
I wore this dress for my Rehearsal Dinner before my wedding. The dress was perfect! Fit beautifully and flattered my pear shape!

love love love this dress! It was perfect for the occasion and got a ton of compliments In the pictures the dress doesn't look like it is made entirely out of sequence so I was a little hesitant that it would be too much for this charity event I attended but it ended up before perfect and super comfortable.
Loved the dress! Wore it more my engagement party and I felt super comfortable and beautiful.  Fits true to size. I'm 5'2 and 115 and wore a 0.

I wore this gorgeous dress for my doctoral graduation. It felt very appropriate for the occasion! The dress was very flattering, fitted through the hips and thighs but a stretchy material, so had some wiggle room.  The dress was very flattering. I went braless, but wearing a adhesive bra with no back would be best for this dress.  I loved wearing this dress for my doctoral graduation! It was classy and slightly sexy, and i received many compliments while wearing it. Slightly scratching on the underarms due to the sequence, but it wasnt as bad as other sequenced gowns i've worn in the past.  The size 4 is slightly damaged, where part of the fabric draping on the back was detached, hardly noticable, but it made a difference. i felt there was no big difference between the size 4 and 6, so due to the damage, I chose to wear the size 6

Beautiful! I was a little nervous that I got a size too small but I only was able to get one size for the weekend I wanted. It ended up fitting perfectly! It was quite stretchy and very comfortable! When it came in person I was a little freaked out by how it was so sequin-y but it came out well in pictures and I got so many compliments. The back really made the dress amazing! Wish this dress was mine! I would definitely rent it again.
It will make you feel fabulous!  It itches some in the armpits will dancing, but overall very comfortable.
It felt great on and I received many complements.  People wanted to know where I got the dress!! Perfect fit and length.

Was okay, not as becoming as I'd hoped I have a dress just like this that fits amazingly... this one not so much. It just wasn't super becoming, made me look wider than I'd like... maybe it was a size too large? Or too small? Not sure, but I didnt end up wearing it as a result.

The dress was comfortable and elegant and fit perfectly!  Loved how I felt in it.   I'm small on top (32C) and it worked well.  Just enough stretch in the skirt to fit over my hips without being too snug as well.  Not too heavy despite the thick lining and sequins.  Not see through at all.
perfect - did not realize material was sequin so I couldn't wear for work but stunning! tight stomach but very flattering overall!

Gorgeous dress! Tons of compliments! This dress was perfect for Diner en Blanc!  I received the 10 and 12. I really wanted to wear the 12 because it was very white and had never been worn. Tags were still on it. The 10 you could tell was not as bright and had some minor snags.   I went with the 10 since it fit perfectly.  Very comfortable and easy to dance in.  The only issue I had was the zipper did not stay down the middle.  It kept moving over to the side and I kept having to adjust it. But overall this dress is amazing!

Beautiful dress for a night out on the town. The way the sequenced fabric flowed was elegant.  It fit almost flawlessly, the dress molded my torso beautifully, complimenting my shape. I had so many compliments.

Just perfect! I wore this for a elegant all white affair and received so many compliments. It was comfortable, dance'able and kinda warm which was a plus since the event was outside.
Oh and it's sequined!

It was the perfect Christmas Party dress! I had doubts about this dress but looking at all the pictures and reading the reviews sold me on it. It isn't pure white and doesn't sparkle as much as I had anticipated but it was beautiful. I ordered a 4 and a 6 and ended up wearing the 4. When I first put it on it was a bit tight at the top, once I took my strapless bra off it fit perfect (no bra needed!). The dress does stretch out a little bit over the course of the night but not enough to notice. The length was just below the knee which was perfect for an outside holiday party. It you have doubts, just get it, you won't be dissappointed!

The dress is absolutely amazing! It fits very well, while also adding the wow factor in the details. Pros: Everything. 
Cons: I couldn't keep it.

Loved this dress! RTR has yet to fail me. I went to an all white wedding and this dress was hit!  The fit was very comfortable. I wore the 4 instead of the 2 because it gave me slightly more room in the hips. Since I'm very "hippy" it worked out well.
Worn for an annual White Party.  Great for dancing and moving around.  Lots of compliments. Lots of stretch in the bottom for narrow or broader hips.  Not as much stretch in top, but fit perfectly.
Sparkle and Shine This dress was absolutely perfect for a charity event.  The dress looked stunning and got many compliments throughout the evening!!

Beautiful for a special night I didn't end of wearing this-only because the other dress I ordered ended up suiting the location of my anniversary dinner better. If I were going to a semi-formal or formal event, I would've worn this in a heartbeat.  it was GORGEOUS and sexy.  I tried every type of bra I owned, including a halter and it wouldn't work.  A halter showed the side bands, but I think it's because I have a small rib cage.  If it came in a 00 (runs a little large) it would've been perfect.

I rented this dress to wear to my graduation, it was a little tight but the fabric has stretch  Definitely need to wear spanx with this dress but otherwise very stretchy and beautiful dress, would rent again
Stood out in a sea of black! I typically wear a 4, but am short waisted, so went with the 2 based on other reviews.  Fit perfectly and super-comfy.  So many compliments!
The dress looked amazing and made me feel great at my wedding rehearsal dinner. The dress fit well, but the sequins became a bit itchy after a few hours.
i used it for a photo shoot where we all rented white dresses from here- worked great!!! I liked the length and all the sparkle, lovely dress!

This dress is so gorgeous!! I had so many compliments on it all night long!!  I normally wear a size 6, but decided that the size 8 was a more comfortable fit - it allowed more room in the knees and bust for me! The size 6 way just a bit too tight. Also, it hit perfectly at my knees (I am 5'6"). The back was stunning!! Make sure to wear you hair up because the back of this dress must be shown off - plus your hair will stick to the sequins anyway if left down!! This dress does not need a bra with it either, the material is thick enough to go without; however, I ended up wearing one just to boost my bust and was fine too.

I would highly recommend this dress for any formal party, it was perfect!!

Tons of compliments! The dress is simple, yet elegant. Very comfortable. It fit perfectly! I'm usually a size 2 or 4. The 2 fit well but a bit tight across the chest/back. I was worried about snagging everything on the sequins but it was not an issue at all.  I also rented the mint green drop earrings which totally complemented the dress without going overboard.

Prepare to stand out in a sea of black dresses!  I can't say enough good things about this RTR experience. First off,  I ordered 2 dresses (a 6 and an 8). They arrived on Thursday, and didn't fit. In fairness, the 8 was snug (if I had starved myself for the next 48 hrs, I probably could have worn it). After a friend talked some sense into me, I called RTR and asked if they had a 10. They shipped it overnight and it fit perfectly for my event that Saturday. I didn't wear a bra, I could eat dinner, and I won an Emmy. Great dress, great service, great night!

Perfect for My "Melania" Costume Inspired by Cecily Strong's knockout "Melania" impersonation on SNL, my partner decided to do a comedic sendup of DJT and his spouse for Halloween. So course I needed the perfect body-conscious white dress! 

The Badgley Mischka Maria dress fit the bill exactly. It is figure-hugging so if you have curves I recommend some good shapewear to keep things in check, so to speak. It was very comfortable to wear and had some stretch so it was comfortable easy to move in. The sparkles are just the right amount of bling without being tacky. Rent it!

Gorgeous, stand-out dress! Rented this dress for my summertime rehearsal dinner - could not have been more perfect. Hugs all the right curves, but doesn't feel too tight or uncomfortable. Hits at the lower knee. The sequins are amazing and really made me feel like the bride! Will definitely rent B.M. again if I have the chance...

Perfect dress for my bachelorette party!   Sexy and glittery, but I still felt covered!  I was able to wear a regular strapless bra, which I was surprised by with the opening in the back!  Dress hit just at my knee which was fine with.   Great party dress, I got many compliments!

Beautiful and very comfortable.  This dress fit perfectly and it was extremely comfortable. I received so many compliments that I will definitely wear this dress again. I have big thighs and the dress was very slimming. Loved it!

Fun night kicking off a Championship Event This dress was perfect!  We were hosting an event at Nikki Beach in Miami and this dress couldn't have been a better choice!  It was comfortable and fit great.  I got multiple compliments throughout the night.  The only downside was that since it was sequins, it was a little itchy but was definitely manageable!  I would highly recommend.
Beautiful sparkling dress that got many compliments. True to size.  Fits great.

Love the Shimmer and the back I rented this dress for a christmas party, and loved the pop of white among all the red dresses. The sparkle was great and the material was dense, and heavy in a good way. It's probably a no-bra kind of dress, so the weight is definitely a comfort. And for white, there was never any concern about it being see-through. 

However, the fit was just unflattering. It was lose around the natural waist, which is where I'd rather highlight the slimmest part of my figure, but then it hugged around the belly, accentuating some of the curves I would have rather had a little coverage of.  And it was kind of an awkward length, hitting right at the bottom of my knee.  Maybe it just fit me wrong because I am on the shorter side. Were I 5'9 the length would probably have been better and may have hit a different part of my waist.

It worked for the event, and I got nice compliments, but I just didn't love it.

Perfect dress for Diner en Blanc I loved this dress.  The fabric was really forgiving - I didn't even need a bra.  The back is really fun, and the sequins were small but added great movement for the dress.  My only complaint was the zipper didn't lay flat on the bottom, but otherwise the dress was in perfect condition.

FIT PERFECTLY I rented this for my own wedding. I am a curvier woman on the bottom half and I worried about renting a straight fit dress.  This one had stretchier email and fit so nicely, I was SO happy!

Good fit with the right size, comfortable. I originally ordered this dress in 10 but had to exchange it for a 12. I typically wear a 10 but the dress runs small. It was a nice fit once I found a good size. The sequins did irritate/scratch my chest and under arms during the night. I also noticed that the 12 hit below my knees because it was longer than the 10.
Great Dress! This dress fit very true to size.  I honestly felt incredible in it.  I was fun to dance in and I was able to wear a nude strapless bra with it.
The dress is elegant while bringing a flashy element! I felt super glam for my college graduation! The fabric is thick so it laid nicely. It wasn't too itchy - very impressed!

Wasn't what I expected I had rented this as a potential dress for a wedding dinner. The top didn't really lay right for me. It was beautiful, but ended up not look all that flattering. It did have a cute back too.
Night on the town with my husband, great little dress! Super comfortable, looked great, loved it!

Stand out dress for a Great Gatsby party! I got this a as last-minute backup when the dress I ordered wasn't available in my size the week of my event. I wore this to my work's Great Gatsby-themed Christmas party and it worked perfectly. In a sea of dark dresses, the white really stood out. The length was perfect and the fit was very flattering on my tall, straight frame. The back is stunning and the sequins are sparkly without being over the top. I loved it and wish I had more occasions to rent it again!

Gorgeous little white dress This is a beautiful unique dress.  The sequins are small and add the perfect  amount of shine.  The dress is super comfortable because it is stretchy.  I was able to wear a strapless bra and pin the dress to it in the back so that the bra would not show.  I am 5'9" and the length was perfect just above the knee.

awesome dress.  I felt like a million bucks it fit well.
Im an athletic 5'4" and the 4 fit great. Lots of compliments

The dress was everything I wanted to wear that day and nothing I expected I'd want. It was perfect! I really wish I would have been able to get the size 6 (it wasn't available for the dates that I needed).  It fit me a little big on top and loose on the bottom.  Thankfully because of the material, it didn't look big and the draping on the back and overall shape worked well with the fact that I have a short torso.  That is truly the only thing I would have changed.

I wore this dress at my wedding! It was my after party dress and everyone loved it. The fabric was forgiving enough for my hips and butt and fit well with my small bust. I'm 5'8" and 145 lbs and I have no complaints for the size four.
Knockout Wore this for my company's grand opening celebration. Lots of big people to impress/mingle with. Dress was a huge hit! Fit wonderfully well and was gorgeous!

Classic navy dress with a dramatic back  I loved everything about this dress. I was worried the narrow neckline would make my shoulders look broad, but it was very flattering. I am a DD so I was worried about not being able to wear a bra. It wasn't ideal, but didn't look bad and the dramatic back was more than worth it.

The embellishments at the waist are subtle but add great shape to the dress. The dress is fitted through the bodice but does poof out over the hips, so don't it is forgiving in this area. I wear an 8 or a 10 normally, and was able to go with the smaller size. 

Would rent again!
Gorgeous dress! I rented this dress for a wedding in May.  I received lots of complements on the dress and felt very comfortable in it.  I wish I didn't have to return it!

Stunning  Dress! Very beautiful dress, perfect for a holiday event.  As always with every RTR - tons of compliments!!  Color is beautiful midnight blue in person, and a bit shimmery.  Very fitted around the waist, so I would size up or down depending on your middle.  Bust was a little loose on me.  The zipper is a bit tough to zip up due to the beautiful jeweled belt, but isn't a detractor.  The skirt is very full, is an appropriate length (not too short - I am 5'7) and has a fun effect on the dress.  I would recommend silver jewelry.  WOULD DEFINITELY RENT AGAIN!

Unique Beautiful dress, received many compliments. Fit well although I could have worn the 6  I went with the 8 since the top  was fitted. My only thing with the dress was the hem kept flipping up and would not stay down so in pictures and when I would move around i had to keep fixing it. It could have been the way it was pressed and maybe just the one I had. The back was gorgeous, definitely cant wear a bra with the dress. Length was at my knee.
Rehearsal Dinner!  Paired with nude pumps and a low pony! Felt so pretty. The fabric weight is amazing and the back is to die for! Recommended!
Everything The dress fit great! I loved everything about it!

Fun and Flirty! LOVE!!!! THIS. DRESS. IS. AMAZING!! SOOOOO many compliments. It fit LIKE A GLOVE and was so comfortable. The pockets were amazing! Length = perfect! I felt so confident, fun, sexy and skinny in this dress. Was so sad to send it back, would love to wear it over and over again!

This dress is amazing!!  So many comments! The dress was a little big in the chest but it was no big deal. I can't wait to rent this dress again so I can take pictures of the back! The hem line of the 8 needs a little help but it wasn't noticeable at all.
Perfect for a wedding.  It was nice to wear for a wedding. I got so many compliments on it.

Loved this dress, perfect for a work holiday party! I loved this dress, I wish I could have kept it. I wanted something appropriate for a work holiday party, and this was perfect as it didn't have a low neckline, it wasn't overly revealing, and was comfortable. It even had pockets, which I loved so that I didn't have to bring a purse. The criss-cross back was the right amount of skin to be shown, and I loved the detailing around the waist for a slimming effect. I'd definitely recommend getting this dress!

Gorgeous, comfortable dress; received LOTS of compliments! This dress was so beautiful and classy. I wore it to my junior prom and everyone loved it. It was extremely unique and i knew no one else would have the same one. Super stylish and pretty. Bonus: it has pockets :)

Loved wearing this dress! This dress was extremely comfortable and I loved that I didn't need a bra. The back is gorgeous and I received a ton of compliments. Perfect for a wedding! My only criticism is it was a tad more poufy than I anticipated and the zipper was a little sticky but nothing to be disappointed by. Would definitely recommend.

This dress was sent to me when my original pick was unable to be sent out-and i was in love! It fit really well. I didn't have to wear a bra, it was tight enough to go without and still be able to dance at the wedding I attended. The zipper on my specific dress was hard to get up and down, it fit perfectly, but that was the only issue.  I loved the open back and pockets.

Beautiful dress! I wore this dress to my friends wedding and loved it. The only con is that while the waist fit perfectly, the bust, arms, and neckline were a little loose but not noticeable to others. It was a winter wedding in Boston so I wore opaque black tights and black heels. I also wore an adhesive bra for some support.  I received many compliments on the dress and was sure to refer them to RTR!

Perfect fit - received lots of complements! I'm very short and the straps were not too long. Loved the pockets for my phone and lipgloss :-). Did feel like I needed to wear a NuBra, but if you have a bigger chest you would probably fill it out without one!

Classy, elegant with a pinch of fun and sass!  I rented this dress for a friend's wedding and it did not disappoint! The color was absolutely beautiful and the dress was really comfy and good for a night on the dance floor. The open back was a fun element to the dress and still classy enough for a southern wedding. I highly recommend this dress and would definitely rent it again!

So comfortable and glamorous! I normally wear a 12, but the 10 fit perfectly. It looked a little short on my 6' frame, but I never felt uncomfortable. I loved the pockets and the silhouette. I received so many compliments.

Beautiful dress with a surprise in the back! Wore this for my office holiday party. Although the back is open, it was a very tasteful dress and I felt very comfortable. Pros: POCKETS, flattering fit, easy to put on. I got a lot of compliments, and it was very easy to pair with silver accessories. Cons: Despite running true to size, the waist offers no give at all. When I tried it on, it felt very tight, so I took it easy on lunch the next day and drank a ginger ale before hand to lose some bloat! Even though the waist is tight, the top was quite loose, and I did not have the bust to totally fill it out. This didn't look obvious, so I ended up wearing it anyway. Overall, the dress isn't the best fit for the wide waist, small bust crowd, but it is so flattering that it can be overlooked. Also, POCKETS! Considering ordering your size and the size up.

I received non-stop compliments, even one from the bride...!  The fit was slightly loose around the arms which I expected for my bust size but wasn't an issue. The length of the dress hit right at my knees; comfortable and classy. It was hard for me to find accessories based off the modeled picture. I couldn't tell which colors were in the embellished belt (silver and black). I went with silver shoes and clutch, then with blue dangling earrings.  I wish I utilized the pockets more but  really a dress with pockets- the best idea ever! I wish I could wear it all over again...
I received nothing but amazing compliments on this dress!! I highly recommend!! Fits like a glove, has pockets which is a plus and made me feel absolutely gorgeous and glamorous.

I was complimented on this dress all evening! Fit like a glove, no need for a bra. This dress was perfect…I mean, it has pockets and you don't need to wear a bra!  I was complimented by complete strangers all night. Would definitely rent again.

This is a beautiful dress. A few fit-issues but overall, I loved it! The dress runs very small in the waist. I usually wear a size four in dresses with a fitted waist/open hips, but I had to size up for this dress. While the waist is small, there was a gap under both arms, and in pictures I had to make sure to keep my arms down.

The color is beautiful and the bead-detailing at the waist is great (blue and rhinestone). I didn't wear one, but I'd recommend a stick on bra to help fill out the top.
I wore this as a bridesmaid dress and it was great!  Some of the bridesmaids had issues with the zipper, but overall a great dress. Flattering on all shapes.

Felt so elegant wearing this to a beautiful wedding at the Historic Renaissance Hotel in Cleveland! Fit well, hid my uneven hips (due to scoliosis), had to wear a backless bra. I received so many compliments on this dress!

The dress was perfect for a cocktail rehearsal dinner & I received so many compliments. It fit like a glove. I wear a size 8 and this dress ran completely true to size! It also was the perfect length...not too long, not too short which is sometimes a problem for me. I am obsessed with this dress and want to rent it again!
show stopping dress- I almost felt bad because it got so much attention! Fit was true to size- just needed a hand from the hubby to close the back part- bonus: I was able to wear a regular bra!!!
Such a great dress!  Loved the color and sexy feel to the back of this dress! The fit was great and the dress was very comfortable! Perfect for an October evening wedding!

This dress was a hit! Received lots of compliments and my boyfriend loved it.  I was a little devastated when I found I had to go up a size in the dress, but it fit like a glove. Beautiful open back and just enough sparkle. I paired this dress with light gold shoes and gold chandelier earrings.

Comfortable and Chic Wore this for a black tie optional wedding.  The length was perfect for my build (right above the knee).  It was very easy to move in and the sheen of the material was beautiful.  One critique was the neckline bunched up.
This is a fun dress to dance in. Fit true to size, not too tight. Received many compliments on the color and dress back.
Not as pretty as photos  Dress is very low in the back
perfect dress for my work holiday party what a hit.  beautiful dress, great fit, sophisticated sexy.

Perfect Fit! I'm always looking for navy dresses with interesting details, and this one fit the bill! Hated sending it back! I could have worn either size (2 or 4) but the neckline on the 4 was a bit more comfortable so I went with that one. The dress is fitted enough and thick enough to get away without a bra. And the pockets are a fun addition. I got compliments all night and can't wait to rent it again!
Great cocktail dress for a DC wedding I'm almost always a 2, and while the 2 fit, it was a tad snug to zip up. You may want to size up for your backup size.

I LOVED it. Such a classic style but the cut outs in the back give it just the right amount of edge. For a short girl, its a lovely length. the skirt does flare out a bit more than how it looks in the RTR photo.
Great fit, very flattering, super comfortable! Received tons of compliments all night!  Zipper was hard to get up because of the fabric but once it was up, it was very comfortable and flattering!
Amazing dress!!! I loved this dress! The fit was perfect and it was so classy for the formal event I was at! I wish I owned this dress because I would definitely wear it again!

Loved! Very fun and flirty! Felt very comfortable! Pros: Great Color, material was light and breathable which is a must for someone like me who likes to dance. The stone accents on the waste were  a little tight and did not move but that was perfect for not having to wear a bra. The bottom of the dress was not steamed correctly and some of the "bubble" hem hung lower in some places. But, this was an easy fix with some fashion tape. 
I got a lot of complements on this dress and it was great for a 5:30 wedding.

Perfect Dress!! I can't even begin to explain how much I LOVE this dress! I'm normally a size 2, but that size was kind of faded. Luckily the 4 fit somewhat the same (extra room to pig out and dance!) and it was BRAND NEW! You don't have to wear a bra, which is awesome. It has pockets for your phone or lipgloss! I got compliments on it all night!

Lots of compliments! The dress was a great combination of being fun but not too revealing.  The beaded belt and the criss-cross back made the dress a lot of fun!  I typically wear a 4, but the the zipper on the 4 was broken, so wore the 6 and it worked out well!  It's definitely fitted through the top and waist, but wasn't uncomfortable.  Just an all around flattering dress!

The dress really feels so  special because of the fun back and the big skirt. SO many compliments! The top is pretty tight across the chest, which was fine for me, but just something to be aware of. I absolutely loved the dress and wanted to keep it!!

Gorgeous Monique Lhuillier!  Love this dress! I previously wore another dress, a ball gown, by Monique designed just like this dress so I already knew I would love this shortened version and I absolutely did love it. The navy color was so pretty and the dress was stunning but also very comfortable, which is important. I also love nothing more than a dress with pockets!! GREAT feature. I did encounter a little problem with the zipper on this one, but not with getting it on. It zipped up with no problem BUT about 2 hours into my event, it completely busted and opened up to the point where my entire left side was exposed and I had to leave the event prematurely. FORTUNATELY, it happened closer the end of the event and not in the beginning. The great thing though is that RTR Customer Service is OUTSTANDING and they took care of me in the aftermath. :) I have rented several times in the past and will continue to rent from them because this is certainly not a typical occurrence. That was actually the first time I ever had an issue like that. Anyway, the dress was beautiful! I would rent the other short and long versions in a heartbeat!

Wore it to a office holiday party - was a hit!  zipper is difficult like people mentioned, just tug and it'll come up
pockets are a nice touch
back of dress is so pretty
thick enough for no bra, even with larger boobs

The rhinestone belt and criss-cross back opening  This dress was amazing for an outdoor wedding! I received so many compliments. I wore a size 8 and it was tight around my waistline I believe only because I've recently gained some weight. The dress is not stretchy at all. Thankfully the dress balloons a bit so it covered my pudgy mid-section. I had trouble getting the dress zipped when it came to getting past the rhinestone belt area. I thought about getting a size bigger but did not. I think in a size 10 the bust area would have way to big for me because I am only a 36B. Also, I didn't need a bra with this because the dress provided enough support. I will definitely rent this dress again.

Looked Great, Tons of compliments!  This dress was perfect to kick off wedding season with! I ended up wearing the 10, my backup size, only because of the sequinned band. There is little to no give in it, so take that into consideration when renting! I'd rent this again, it was fantastic !

The pictures do NOT do it justice. It was a very beautiful dress. I did not want to return it! I wore this dress for a BYX Formal. The color was deep navy and the beaded belt did not look cheap at all. I wish I had gotten more (and better) pictures of the back because it was gorgeously done. I got quite a few compliments :P
Pros: Pockets! The dress was a relatively thick material, but it was very light and airy. I danced the entire night but sweat was not a problem. The skirt had volume without being poofy. The back was a show stopper and the dress was overall, very elegant. Perfect if you want to be classy yet sexy! 
Cons: I am by no means small chested, I think I'm about a 36D, but the dress fit perfectly everywhere except for the chest! It was unnaturally large. If it had been tighter, a bra would not have been necessary. Unfortunately I did not have a bra I could wear with the dress, so I went without, but was able to make it through the night without any issues. The bottom of the dress folds up weirdly at times, so I would pin it or finds a way to steam it (?), The straps of the dress tended not to lay flat, maybe because I have broad shoulders, so I had to adjust them often to make sure the front  of the dress and the back straps laid flat. Once the straps were where they were supposed to be, the loose chest area was less of a problem. I would also suggest that you keep very straight posture! I had to do a sorority squat for a picture and it was not flattering. The front of the dress bunched up and made me look wider than I actually am.
*I realize that seems like a lot of cons, but I just wanted to be thorough. I would absolutely recommend renting this dress! It was beautiful and you'll have trouble parting with it when your rental is over ;)

Beautiful dress but ran small Pros: beautiful color, sexy back, perfect style for a wedding. 

Cons: the zipper was sticky and hard to zip up, which only made the issue that it was tight in the waist more problematic.

In the end, I still really enjoyed wearing the dress and was glad I ordered it, but probably won't again. Also, I used a backless bra for this.

Gorgeous dress Very pretty in person. Thicker fabric than I expected but actually was great for a chilly wedding day. Has hidden pockets which came in handy for keeping my phone/speech on me throughout the evening. The zipper was tricky to get zipped past the belt but I was able to do it after a few attempts.

Flattering and fun The back and the belt are the distinguishing features of this dress and make it fun.  I was a little heavier than I usually am when I wore this dress and it felt and looked great.  It came in at a nice place on my waist.  Great for the occasion.  I often will wear a 4 in dresses that come in at the waist like this one, and the 6 looked better than the 4 (6 is my usual size) so I wore that.

Overall great dress! This dress looked great and I got a lot of compliments on it! I loved that I didn't have to wear a bra and everything felt well supported (I did use nipple petals). The 0 (my usual size) was really difficult to zip up and required a lot of effort by a second person. The size 2 was huge on me. Another issue that I had was that the dress wrinkles easily, so it wasn't ideal for bringing with me on a plane as it had some bends in it (some bends were present just from shipping!).
Great dress This dress was my backup dress but ended up wearing it for the event. It was very comfortable and I didn't even have to wear a bra because the fabric was thick enough. Pockets were great!
Great color and silhouette Fits great and the back is stunning.  Would expect nothing less from a Monique dress.

Perfect for a black tie optional  Other reviews helpful. Runs small and zipper gets stuck, needed someone to zip it even though it was the right size. The 4 fit, but was too snug to be comfortable and the 6 was much better. Loved the details and the unusual back. Still conservative enough for a church wedding but not too much.

The color was classic and the back was tasteful! I wore this dress to a charity event for a Children hospital.The dress fit true to size. I  have a bigger bust and this dress fit perfectly without a bra. I am 5'4 and the dress hit just below my knee. I received tons of compliments on the back of the dress.

Perfect for a DC wedding I was a little worried about the back of the dress and the fit of the top, but it turned out perfectly. I would totally buy this dress, I felt so great in it. I did wear a sticky bra because the dress didn't have quite enough structure to go without.

This dress is SO much fun to dance in. Perfect for a wedding. This dress is my absolute favorite dress. The back is adorable - I got so many compliments throughout the night. It's formal enough for a black-tie affair, and the dress is so much fun to dance in. I wore the 4, and it was tight enough to wear without a bra. I would highly recommend this dress.

This dress was so cute and comfortable! The fit was true to size. I did not wear a bra with it because the back is so open, just a little fashion tape. I danced all night in it and did not have to worry about anything! I received so many compliments and I would definitely recommend this dress!

Sexy, classy, but a bit too tight I love the cut and style of this dress, but the beaded waist band had NO give. I wore a size 8, and I feel like a size 10 would have been too large in the chest, otherwise I might have gotten a backup size. While standing and taking shallow breaths, the dress looked great! Sitting down to dinner however, was a new challenge. I wore a sweater over the dress out in public since it's Ohio and it was a high of 12 that night, but that sweater also gave me the ability to unzip the dress so I could eat my meal and just be more comfortable.

Black tie wedding Rented this for a black tie optional wedding and was not disappointed. This was my frost time using RTR and I will definitely use it again. Dresses came in excellent condition. Fit was perfect though zipper was difficult and required an extra pair of hands. Received a ton of compliments all night, and the back definitely made the dress. 
My hips are pretty wide but my waist and bust are small so a zero fit perfectly without a bra.

Great Club/Party Dress I wore this dress (XS) for my friend's bachelorette party. We went out dancing for hours and this was the perfect dress for that kind of scene. I loved the lace sleeves and I wore a nude bra underneath. My only issue with the dress is that you constantly have to pull it down because it rides up. Not sure if something could be worn underneath to prevent that. Other than that, the dress is a cute, fun, sexy number. I wouldn't have rented this dress for any other occasion since it is very short. It was a great last minute order!
The dress was very comfortable  The sleeves were a little tight and it didn't allow for room to wear a bra, otherwise it was nice. Complemented my figure well

Perfect, Unique LBD for a Cocktail Party! Wore this for our "night before the wedding" cocktail reception, and it was perfect - a great twist on an LBD with a very sexy back!  (I wanted something a complete opposite of my wedding gown, so this was perfect in that regard.)  I am glad I had the S back-up as the XS was just a bit too snug overall (I'm usually a size 2/2P, and Small fit perfectly).  Rides up a bit when you sit, so I recommend this for events where you expect to be standing/walking around most of the evening.

Dress fit almost perfectly!  Fit was almost perfect, a little big at the torso and butt area. Not as tight on the bottom as a wanted. But, otherwise, I loved it! It was perfect and no one had anything like it!

Classy yet fun This dress was perfect for my work holiday party! It was a simple black dress but the lace back and sleeves made it stand out. There was a slight tear that I noticed when I inspected it in the bicep area, but it was hard to see with the lace pattern and I only noticed it because I was looking for it. The zipper seems to sit a little oddly at first, but if you're moving around it's not noticeable. Probably didn't have to wear a bra with it, but I wore a Nubra anyways. And the length was short but I didn't have any problems with it riding up like I sometimes do with mini skirts!

This was the inaugural wedding of "wedding season" and it was a high-energy Indian ceremony! I was looking for something classy, sophisticated, and able to adapt to the unpredictable weather of early May in NYC. This dress fit the bill perfectly. The dress was a little loose in the side/tummy area, but other than that, it fit really well. It is backless, but I went without a bra and was fine as the material is pretty thick. This was a very high energy wedding with a lot of moving and dancing, and I didn't feel uncomfortable at all. The ONLY issue I had was a small hole in the back of the dress. In retrospect, I should have tried the dress on earlier and noticed it, but I was able to conceal the minor hole without a problem. I would DEFINITELY rent this dress again.

PERFECT DRESS! This dress fit like a glove. It was absolutely perfect for my boyfriends Christmas Party. The only thing is... it rides up. Like a lot. I'm tall so dresses being short is nothing new to me. The Large fit better in the arms but left the stomach area looking too big. I decided to go with the Medium even though the arms were a little too short. I tugged them up just a tiny bit more and loved the way it looked. There really isn't a difference in the length of the dress between the Medium and Large. I would definitely rent this dress again! I got compliments all night. Even had someone tell me "that dress really proves you have an amazing body!" LOVE LOVE LOVE!
Perfect Dress for Fashion Week Party Loved this dress! Even though it was tight- I still felt that it was flattering and looked great in pictures.

Super comfortable but fancy I wore this dress for a formal New Years Eve party and it was absolutely perfect.  The dress was beautifully form fitting (I opted for the XS over the S because it looked a little better tighter).  The stretchy fabric was also incredibly comfortable, while still looking upscale.  It was a huge hit.

Only one with that kind of dress. The fit was very tight, especially towards the bottom. I have a bigger chest and it was kind of tight there and in the butt area. The waist was a good size and it was very short. Overall very nice dress and very sexy.

This dress made me look and feel amazing! I didn't want to take it off!  The fit of the dress is definitely snug and form-fitting but that was what I was looking for so it was perfect. The lace sleeves and back are much softer than expected and not scratchy at all. The material is really thick and hides any little imperfections that you don't want to show. It rode up a little throughout the night but any dress I wear does that so it was expected. I wore a backless bra and it worked perfectly. Only downside was there was a small hole on the seam of the skirt. Other than that, the dress was amazing and made a great night unforgettable
It was a formal cocktail and was a great night This dress fits your body perfectly. It is very sexy but it has a great look. Loved it!

I wore this dress to my junior year homecoming and I received SO many compliments! The fit was perfect considering I'm pretty tall for my age. I absolutely LOVED the lace sleeves and the lace back! It was such a stunning dress and I got so many awesome compliments! The only con about it was there was a small hole in the lace, but it was barely noticeable. This was my first rental from RTR and I did NOT want to send it back!

Sexy LBD!!! Wow - this dress is smokin' hot!!! I am just under 5'7" / 120lbs and the small worked great (medium was a little too roomy for me). I'm guessing I could have fit into an extra small (so if you prefer a really snug fit, size down) because the fabric is stretchy. But the small fit well around my hips/butt with a little room in the waist (which is weird because I don't have a narrow waist - I'm pretty straight). The dress did ride up in the back a little so I had to adjust/pull it down after sitting usually, but I wasn't bothered by that. You can see through the lace, so be careful if you're wearing a bra. I wore a Victoria's Secret Style Secrets underwire with adhesive sides - worked like a charm! To complete my look, I paired the dress with a statement necklace and some black pumps, and just like that - holy hotness!

I have rented this dress twice now. It's the perfect combination of classy and sexy. I wish I owned it!
Even better in person! Looks great - much better than I expected!

Having two sizes to pick from was awesome and stress free! I read reviews Bc initially I wouldn't have thought I was a small, but in the end, the small was perfect. Dresses were in great condition, and return instructions were very easy to understand!! I wore this with a nubra, which worked great for the lace back!

Wore this out for a bachelorette party and got sooo many compliments!  I ordered a medium and a small, and the medium ended up a better fit for me so that the dress wasn't super super short . It was really comfortable and flattering! The material was thick enough that I didn't have to wear a bra or pasties. I was so sad to have to send this back!

Perfect for a Black Tie Affair! The xs fit perfectly and was a great length! I'm 5'2". It shows every curve, which can be good or bad! :/  I couldn't wear my sticky bra because the lace comes in too much.  It worked out fine because I don't have a large bust.  I got many compliments.  Definitely a fun dress and I would love to have it my wardrobe!

Love the lacy back! Wore this for my fiance's 30th birthday! Got lots of compliments, but glad I went with the Medium and not the Small... It's a little tight to be drinking beer in. Also glad I wore some tights with my heels because it is pretty short.
Super sassy It was a little big in the back but overall everyone loved it

Sexy, fun, and comfortable! I rented this for a girls weekend in NYC in November.  Very flattering and sexy without being too revealing.  Good for cooler weather too as it has sleeves and can be worn well with black tights.  Lots of fun!

Wore this for NYE hotel event. Very sexy but still classy. Fit like a glove, went with the XS because it shaped my back a little nicer than the small. The lace looked beautiful and got lots of compliments. On the shorter side but I'm short so no issues. Wish I could wear this every NYE!!

Great, flirty dress for a night out! I was skeptical how this dress was going to work - but I loved how it looked so I gave it a try. The material is very high quality, and this fit is great. I went with the large over the medium to have a longer fit (cold fall night) and a little bit looser around the midsection. I am a 36 DD and I wore a Nubra with it, and it was great! Lot's of compliments :)  It was really warm too, which I was OK with. Would rent again!

Great fit! Perfect for winter event! Wore this to a "Tickled Pink" charity event.  Paired it with bright pink heels & sheer black tights.  Fit was excellent.  Great fabric- just stretchy enough to wear without a bra (and it didn't flatten the chest area either!!) but tight enough that it holds you in.  The lace is a quality fabric too.  It is a bit short- which is fine for me but, if you're tall, be warned.  Overall- happy with the rental!
The dress looked great it gave me good curves. I wore this for homecoming and ending up wearing the large being 5'10. It was really short and tight but my date didn't mind.

Perfect for date night! Amazing! Holds everything in - no bra needed! He won't be able to stop staring at you :) I am a size 6 and wore a small - the medium fit fine but small held me in perfectly! I wish I owned this dress.

Chic The fit was pretty good. The length was definitely short and rode up while I was dancing, but it wasn't a big problem. I'm curvy and petite, and the waist got very loose throughout the night. Otherwise, it was extremely flattering and held it any imperfections. I didn't even bother wearing a bra, and it looked great. This was my backup, so I kind of wish I would've worn something a little less boring. Still a great LBD!

I wore this for my birthday which was fun and sassy.  The lace spiced up the LBD. I wore a stick on bra as I wanted to be comfortable.  I could see how others would go without if that is something you are used to.  It rode up a bit as I was dancing/walking, but I do have a long torso.  The material has a bit of stretch to it which makes it easier to breathe.  Great dress!

Rented for bachelorette -- fun LBD. The medium worked also but was a a little short on me. I am large chested and did not need a bra so don't worry if you are concerned about the lace back. The bottom rides up a little as you walk but not a big deal. Overall, I'd rent again!

Great fit! Sexy without being too revealing :) I loved this dress and, of course, wanted to keep it. It wasn't as short as I thought it would be, thank goodness. The lace is very thick so I didn't feel like I was wearing a backless dress. I was able to get away with wearing a nude colored strapless bra without it being noticeable and little booty spanx to help the dress fit smoothly.

The Perfect Little Black Dress!  This black dress is perfect for an holiday date party! The front of the dress is very plain but when you see the all lace back you will fall in love. The only bad part about this dress is finding a bra to wear under it! one of my favorite rentals so far.
Understand Sexy This dress was great! The lace cutouts were an amazing step up from your regular LBD. wore it in Vegas and got many compliments.
Sexy! Very flattering fit and I felt super sexy in this dress!  It is definitely a mini but not too short - perfect length to dial up the heat, in my opinion.  ;)

This dress just makes you feel like a million dollars. The fabric is fantastic and it is well made.  great fit, it runs true to size, the arms aren't too tight. I wear a 6/8 and the Medium was perfect.

Incredible!!!!  This was originally my back up dress however I fell in love. Its the perfect dress for a night out.. The only downfall is its a little short. If you got a booty beware that the dress rides up VERY quickly (which is why it lost one star) I used a stick on bra because I can't stand going braless. However you really don;t need one. I didn't want to take it off.
PERFECT  Could not have loved this dress more!!! The fit was perfect and the dress was extremely flattering. Received so many compliments!
This dress was absolutley stunning on. The lace back is a beautiful touch.  Very Comfortable one. Slimming appearance and I did not have to wear a bra with it. I would rent it again.

I went out to dinner and then to a casino for my birthday. I got so many compliments on this dress! The small fit perfectly. I didn't wear a bra although you could probably get a way with either a backless sticky-type bra or even a nude strapless. The material of the actual dress was thick enough that I felt like I was wearing a substantial garment and not some cheap fabric, and it didn't ride up. The lace detailing is so flattering and will get you many compliments! Would look great with or without tights. Honestly, I wish this was part of my wardrobe.

Very sexy classy dress This dress looks amazing on, the picture does not do it justice. It is extremely sexy and the arms and back are see through lace so it has a little sex appeal and hugs in all the right places.

BEST DRESS EVER I seriously wanted to buy this dress the minute I put it on. I think I'll rent it again, honestly. The fabric was AMAZING and I felt so sexy and gorgeous the whole night. Got a ton of compliments :)

I'm tall with long legs, but the dress wasn't too short, it was just short enough to be cute :)

Nice short winter dress. I wore this to a work award dinner/party.  It was a great choice to cover "winter arms" and get a little more coverage for a  late winter event.  I rented both the small and medum.  They both fit, but I wore the small.  The lace fabric on the arms and back was soft, and the solid black material was on the thick side with a good amount of stretch.  I wore it with sheer off-black panty hose, black high heeled leather boots, and some Kenneth Jay turquoise drop earrings.  The earrings (not on yet in the picture) were a nice pop of color, which the dress as I wore it needed.

Loved this dress.  I absolutely loved this dress. It was so comfy as well as sexy & elegant. I don't recommend if you're planning on dancing a lot but other than that I loved wearing this dress. I felt so sexy!
Sexy Chic Great dress for a low key night on the town.  Sexy yet conservative.  The open lace and higher hemline give an added allure, but the long sleeves keep it modest (and warmer).

Absolutely gorgeous! Lovely dress, looked fantastic on, hugged my curves well. It did seem to press against my chest after a few hours. Really fantastic :) I completely suggest trying it out. It does not ride up. The lace is exquisite.
PERFECT LBD! Amazing dress! My only regrets were not talking a photo on my own phone and having to send it back, LOVE

Love this dress more than words could explain! I wore this dress out to a bar for my birthday. As soon as i put it on I fell in love. The material was super thick and looked amazing on. I am in between a 0 & 2 when it comes to dresses and ended up wearing the extra small. Needless to say I was sad to send it back. I will definitely be renting this again!

Felt sexy all night The dress was short but the perfect amount of sexy for a NYE party. A little short but still classy.The extra small rode up less than the small because it was a little tighter. So many compliments all night. Everyone wanted to see the cutout lace back.
The dress was comfortable all night!  First time using RTR and it was great! I got both of the dresses in time for my events and they fit great. This dress was flattering and comfortable!

I wore this dress to my senior homecoming.  It was a little too baggy in the stomach. I would pull it down to try and make it less baggy, but then the dress would be an awkward length. Other than that everything was great. Really thick material which is nice!

Perfect dress for an early spring bachelorette party! Both my friend and I rented our dresses from RTR for her bachelorette party. I got a ton of compliments on the dress. Both the M and L fit but I ended up wearing the M. The dress material is very comfortable and kept me warm even on a chilly April evening in Chicago. I did have a little trouble getting the sleeves on with the delicate lace because my arms are more muscular. Once on, however, the sleeves never bothered me throughout the night. I was nervous wearing a backless dress since I have a larger bust. I ended up wearing a nubra with the dress and felt really comfortable especially since the fit and material of the dress kept everything in the right place. I did try on the dress with a regular nude bra though and it was barely noticeable through the lace back. If I could buy wear the dress again I definitely would!

True to size, little short, GORGEOUS in person. I got amazing compliments on this dress all night long. I wore it to a winter wedding and put a maroon pashmena with it. The only downside was towards the end of the night the seems on each side of the skirt were starting to come undone so it looked like i had little holes in the sides of it... Which was a little bit of a bummer. But I would buy this dress because I loved it so much! It was a sexy twist on a classic black dress. Definitely would wear it again - but this time maybe bring safety pins!

Subtly sexy, many compliments I loved the design of this dress. I loved the lace sleeves, deep side cut-out, and all-lace back. I didn't need a bra, and I never felt uncomfortable with the length or exposure on the side. I thought the sleeves were a little itchy/irritating, so if you have really sensitive skin it is something to note. I also thought some of the appeal/allure was lost when it would ride up on the bottom (as all tight skirts/dresses do) because it would cause the lace in the back to bunch and eliminate the smooth, painted on lace look. Overall, great dress, but wish it was slightly less irritating.
Comfortable & sexy dress! Not too warm for late summer/early fall. Sexy without being too revealing. Would rent again!
Perfect black dress! This dress is fabulous. Classy and sassy! Super comfy and flattering! I wish I owned it!
It's tight but the material keeps it flattering. I felt like a sexy mama! If you  want a night to feel like a sexy woman this is the right dress

Loved this dress!  This dress was fantastic. I loved the way it fit. I am not the type to go without a bra and the front of this dress was tight in a way that still make your chest look perky however stretchy  material so not too snug and it was super comfy!

Excellent Customer Service, Great Dress I rented this Vita dress after the madeline dress I originally rented was not available.  The customer service experience I had was excellent and I work in customer service.  RTR was prompt to call me answer any questions and help me pick out the perfect dress for my occasion.  Although this was my 2nd choice I'm glad I rented it.  It was conservative enough for the church and the back was sexy enough for the reception.  I received plenty of compliments on the dress.  I would def suggest this dress to anyone and have been raving about RTR!

I loved this dress! It's tight but still classy.  It fit well. I thought it might be too short but it was the perfect length for me. There was a tear in the side but it wasn't too noticeable so I just stuck a safety pin in it.

Amazing LBD Seriously loved this dress. It is so flattering and the material is amazing. Wore this for my bday celebration in Las Vegas. My only (very small) complaint is that the dress would ride up a bit when I walked. But I would definitely recommend this to everyone.

Classy and comfortable! The material was stretchy and comfortable to wear all night for a fall wedding. I got many compliments on the dress and I would definitely rent it again. The only con I have for the dress was that the shoulders can be a little restricting with the lace sleeves, but it was completely fine once I got used to it. Overall it was a fantastic dress that I recommend for almost any event!
Perfect dress for a beach wedding! Absolutely loved it. Tons of compliments and super comfortable. It's a must-rent!
perfect for black tie optional wedding I wore this dress at 24 weeks pregnant, plenty of room for my small bump.  Straps are big, had to pin them back.

Beautiful city outdoor wedding in the perfect dress. I wore the 6R and it fit very well. The only cons were: 1. The straps were too long for my short torso (I just did a temporary pin on them and it was perfect) 2. Making sure I wasn't showing TOO much (should have worn a little something to cover my girls) - probably due to the straps

The top was Way too big waste was perfect! The fit in the waste was perfect. However, the top was huge and fit horribly. There isn't enough tape to help hold it up and it cuts way to low to wear a bra. 
Probably perfect for the 5'9 size A super model - and for that I say you go girl this will be amazing in on you.

Classic and sexy! I loved this dress! I had to take the straps up quite a bit but when I did, I felt supported without a bra (that's very rare with my size)! I got tons of compliments - even from my mom (who I thought would HATE it). I was comfortable, able to dance, sit, and eat! I WISH I could afford to own this dress!

Striking, flattering and comfortable I ADORE this dress. The structure to the skirt made it extremely flattering - I have a pooch from having kids and it smoothed everything out, no need for shapewear. The length was great on my 5'4" frame with heels and the 10R size. The only real issue is the top. It was somewhat loose, I had to shorten the straps in the back and safety-pin them which made a huge difference. I also absolutely needed tape to keep it from showing everything when I leaned forward.  I did wear a sticky-bra but it was more of a pain than it was worth and I took it off. Be prepared for how low-cut this is - it looks extremely classy, but I was a bit self-conscious. That being said, I felt AMAZING in this dress and would absolutely rent it again.

I loved feeling beautiful and confident in this dress, even while being 21 weeks pregnant! I was 21 weeks pregnant at the time, but the fit of the dress was still flattering and accommodated for my bump.  The straps were a little long and not adjustable, but I was able to manage with the size 4 dress with some safety pins and fashion tape.  The dress was super comfortable and I received a ton of compliments on it -- I'm sure a lot of people from that wedding will consider renting from Rent The Runway now!  My details in my profile have changed a bit, so I was probably about 140 pounds and I was probably closer to a 32C when I wore this dress!  I also only wore about 2 inch heels and felt that was perfect without it being too long.

I loved this dress!!!  Stunning! I rented this dress and wore it 4.5 months pregnant - although my belly was still pretty small.  The dress was gorgeous.  Similar to some other reviewers, I did have to tie the straps in the back or else they would have been falling off all night.  I used a broach to keep them together.  The color in the skirt is almost a pale pink which doesn't completely come through in photos.  I absolutely loved this dress and highly recommend it!
Beautiful dress for a formal wedding. This dress was gorgeous!  The shorter front hem made dancing easy.  The top fit me very well--definitely not for anyone busty.

Awesome Dress, be careful with the deep V. And Pockets! I absolutely loved this dress; however, I have a pretty full chest.  So it was definitely pretty revealing. 
 I never had a problem, even while dancing.  It is just something to make sure you are comfortable with, or that you are attending the type of party that this is appropriate.  Also, the fabric does not stretch very much around the chest/upper-waist.  So keep that in mind while ordering!

I felt so beautiful/comfortable!  I ordered the dress in a 12 and 8 (because 8 was the only backup size available). I got SO excited when I found out they send a 12 and a 10, the 12L ended up fitting perfectly, albeit it was a little tight around the ribs, though I do have a wide ribcage. I didn't have to wear a bra but I did end up putting fashion tape to make sure it never came loose. I felt so beautiful and everyone loved it! I wish I could keep it!
Lovely, lovely dress. I felt very glamorous. Low cut, but I didn't wear a bra. Just double-sided tape along the seams and under my arms. Perfect fit, easy to dance in, with pockets for the win.

The fit of the dress! I never had to worry about a stomach pooch or my boobs falling out! This dress was amazing and the fit was perfect! My only con is that the straps were too long but nothing a few temporary stitches couldn't fix! I do have a short torso so this is ALWAYS a problem for me. Pros- the fit is flattering and true to size, it's snug in the right places and flowy in the "troublesome" areas! I absolutely loved this dress and wish I had the money to buy it! I will definitely be renting this dress again!!

This dress was a dream to wear! It's gorgeous in person, easy to dance in & got tons of compliments! I have a pear-shaped body with a small waist so the cut was perfect. I also have a larger bust, and even with the low-cut fit I never felt too exposed. And the fact that this dress is elegant enough to wear to a black tie wedding, but is super comfortable and has pockets was a win-win!

Beautiful dress. Tons of compliments. Straps too long. Pockets are key. The dress fit well, though I should have rented a size down (they were sold out). I think the 8L worked well, but the straps were way too long on me. I had to wear a bra underneath, which I only needed because the straps created a lot of extra space by my chest. The length was perfect with heels, and it is a very comfortable dress for dancing. If the straps were shorter or I was able to alter the length a bit, it would be five stars.

I had SO many compliments on this dress.  Hands down my best rental ever and wish I could keep it! Fit was perfect.  Can't wear a bra with it; even a Nu Bra shows a bit in front but the fit was snug enough below the bust line that I was able to put "cutlets" in the cups and use fashion tape to make sure they stayed in place.

Stand out dress for a black tie affair  
Overall very pleased with the order! The dress stood out at a black tie event amongst a sea of long black dresses. I ordered the 0R and 2R based on reviews. I'm 5'2, small busted and slightly pear shaped. I ended up going with the 0R because the fit was overall so much cleaner, and better suited for my small frame, though it was admittedly a bit hard to zip up and crunched my ribs throughout the evening. If I went with the 2R I would have had to put in inserts for the bust, and safety pinned the straps, so I chose the painful fit ;) I wore the 0R without a bra. Can't go wrong with the style, compliments all night.
