This was the perfect dress for a black tie wedding in Napa.  I received so many compliments on this dress! I did use tape to help keep in the ladies. I ordered a size 6 and backup size 4. I ended up with the 6 because it was a tad longer. It is shorter than I expected and with heels barely touched the ground.

I felt so glamorous and sexy in this dress! LOVED IT. It was nearly perfect, except for the bodice. The straps as other people have mentioned were a bit too long for me to stay put, and I couldn't wear a bra with it. We pinned the straps to make them tighter and I used a bunch of fashion tape to make myself feel more secure, and it worked. I was a bit paranoid throughout the night but everyone told me I was fine. 

I loved this dress so much. It was perfect for a Cape Cod wedding - it amped up the glam factor a bit but it wasn't too formal for a cocktail attire situation.

So, so many compliments!! This dress runs big. I normally wear a 4 and ended up wearing the 0R. It was long but ended up being the perfect length when I had 4 inch heels on. The skirt material wrinkles easy so I has to press it first, but no other complaints!!

Perfect elegant but fun dress for a chic wedding! Wore this dress to a black tie optional wedding. It was so perfect for the occasion -- fit the dress code well, but was also fun and festive! I got so many compliments all night long. It was also so easy to wear -- the shimmery skirt needed very few accessories.  There are some bits of pale, pale pink in the skirt that aren't super clear in the photos online -- but I found that to be really pretty with all the other shades of gold/cream. 
The fit was just right too. I have a small A-cup chest, so the deeper V neckline wasn't an issue. Might be a little more difficult if you have more going on up there! As for the length, I'm pretty average height-wise and wore 2.5 inch heels without the dress touching the floor at all. Definitely would recommend this dress and would rent it again myself!

Perfect for black tie event I'm originally in between a size 6 and 4. I went with the 4 because, with my height, the 6 had about an 1-2 inches dragging on the ground. The straps fell down a few times throughout the night, but it wasn't excessive (get boob tape). Also, I originally thought the dress had a thin, silk texture bottom, but in reality it's a much thicker cloth. Regardless, the dress still works for a summer wedding.

Unique and comfy Loved this dress and would have kept it if I could have. The bottom has a slight shimmer in some of the stripes, and one of the stripes is actually a really pale pink. With my dark hair and that accent color in the skirt, a pale pink drop earring was perfect. The skirt fabric has enough structure that it's flowy without being floaty (i.e. fun to dance and twirl in, but won't blow up in a breeze). I had a pair of nude heels and black strappy sandals and because of the colors in the skirt, I could have worn it with either pair. I have a size 32E chest and at times, the girls were close to falling out but it's definitely not possible to wear a bra with this dress. That's my only warning! Either rent this dress if you're smaller than me up top, or be aware that your girls will be seriously out on display.

My event was a lavish, fun-filled, elegant wedding of a very dear friend. I loved the fit but felt that the back straps had to be adjusted to keep everything classy.  I absolutely adore any dress that has pockets and these were hidden, which I also liked.  I definitely went against the old adage about horizontal stripes and I think it paid off. I popped the muted colors with a pair of green suede shoes that had metal adornments and a jade necklace.  This was a great choice and as I am a fan of Badgley Mischka, it was an honor to wear their design.

Classy and sexy dress for my rehearsal dinner This dress was very beautifully made, had a wonderful silhouette, and made me feel incredibly beautiful. The hi-low cut worked well with my 5'3" height + 3 inch heels along with my pear shape. The only reason I can't give this 5 stars is because of how incredibly low cut it was. I have a smaller chest (32B) and the cut of the dress was well below my breast bone. So women with larger chests need to be mindful. I managed to pin the front of the dress just slightly which made it perfect. RTR was, as always, wonderful with their packaging and delivery. Overall, I would absolutely recommend this dress to anyone with a smaller chest who is looking for a unique gown. I personally loved it! Thanks RTR!

Obsessed I am so in love with this dress! The top definitely runs big and is a wider V than expected, so I wish I'd had double sided tape but it was okay- just had to have great posture all night!  So many compliments and so unique.  And the pockets are great as you can see :-)
Loved the dress! I received so many compliments, both in person and from comments on social media. The dress fit perfectly. It's very flattering and comfortable.

Love this dress! Perfect for pear shapes. Shows off the chest without being too showy! This dress is gorgeous! Shirt is substantial and heavy, top has a wonderful fit with a cut that flatters. I would suggest going down a size if you are a pear or petite up top.  Some said teh straps were too long and for me, they were borderline too long, but i used double-sided tape it that worked. You can also pin the straps in the back to make an X shape to shorten. Perfect for pear shapes. Shows off the chest without being too showy! LOVED IT!

Perfect dress!! This dress was absolutely perfect for a wedding on the hudson, I loved it! I received compliments all night. I rented a size 2R and a 4R after reading reviews that the chest area was small. I thought that it fit perfectly in the chest, if you have a larger bust around I would go for the next size. This dress fit almost perfect all around. I will say that it was a little big long in the back even after heels. It was extremely comfortable and had pockets (amazing!) Don't forget fashion tape for the top!

Stunning!!  I used the larger backup size because it was a little tight in the ribs but overall I LOVED this dress! Already thinking of the next time I can rent it to wear again. I wore it to an outdoor wedding and it was perfect! I liked the high-low hemline which made it feel formal but not over the top. Definitely recommend!
Comfortable. Has pockets. Many compliments on it!  I wanted an 8- but there weren't any available. The 6L was snug- but worked! True to size.

Wore this dress to an outdoor wedding in AZ.  Got so many compliments! Very flattering fit.  With a 34D the straps dug into my shoulders a little but wasn't too bad.  It was a little windy and the weight of the fabric was no problem at all; high quality.

Flattering for those with fuller hips b/c it emphasizes the contrast between tiny waist & wide hips I barely squeezed into the size below my standard size - since I have large breasts and had to go braless with the silhouette, the smaller size helped give me support.
Awesome dress This was my first rtr and this dress was amazing! It is large on the top but nothing a little fashion tape can't fix! I got compliments all night long!

This was a back up dress. I did not choose this one for my event. This dress is so fun and cute. It's comfortable enough that you can eat in it, which is a huge plus haha. The skirt is super cute and fun but it is not as sequiny in person as it appears online which I felt made it a little less formal than what I needed it for.  I also have a 19 year old mistake of a tattoo on my back that I didnt want to bring to the formal affair as well, so the plunging back didn't work for me. I loved this dress just not right for the occasion. I would rent again though for a fun party or something like that.
Amazing dress, endless compliments Very revealing if you have a big bust!!  Use tape, pockets are amazing

GORGEOUS dress! I ordered a 6, but received an 8--- I have a large ribcage so this actually worked out in my favor! I got compliments all night long. The dress photographed beautifully and was so comfortable. I definitely recommend fashion tape for the chest or safety pinning the straps together in the back (if your hair will hide it). I would rent this again in a heartbeat-- it was perfect for a semi-formal wedding!!!

Perfect dress for a New Years Eve wedding! I rented this for a New Years Eve black tie wedding and I loved it. It does run a little small, especially for bigger chested girls. I wear a 36C and the 6 was a little tight. I'm also not used to super low cut tops and this definitely was, but I got used to it!
So comforatable Fits great! V in the front is low, but very flattering.

I loved wearing this dress!  I loved wearing this dress! 

The dress was very comfortable and the fabric was thick, but not heavy. I received many compliments throughout the night. I'm usually a size 4 and was planning on wearing the 4R, but actually ended up wearing the 2R because it was slightly tighter in the bust area. I would highly recommend!

Beautiful Dress I absolutely adored this dress. It was so beautiful. I got so many compliments on it. The pockets were amazing, it made it easy to hold onto my phone and lipstick while staying on the dance floor all night. The hem made it easy to walk too, since i'm clumsy and tend to trip on long dresses.

I rented a 4 (my normal size) and based on the recommendations I sized up for my back up, and I should not have. I have a smaller bust, and the top on the 4 was WAY too big. I did order a back up style but really had my heart set on this one. Luckily I read one of the other reviewers with a similar problem tied her straps in the back to make it a racer back style so the straps stay up. I had a nice ribbon with me, so I had one of my girlfriends tie it in the back for me. Worked like a charm, and it was amazing!!
Gorgeous! This dress is beautiful in person.  It was comfortable and was the perfect length.  Many compliments!

Residency graduation I got a ton of compliments on this dress all night. The skirt is thick, but moves well. The straps were too big on me to keep the top up, which was concerning, however, I pinned the straps together in a criss-cross to remedy this. It worked well and I wore my hair down which covered the pin and no one noticed and I felt much more comfortable.

Great dress for prom! Amazing dress! It is extremely comfortable and the pockets are a huge plus. I ended up pining the straps because they were too long. I also used some fashion tape on the underarms because it was a little baggy. There are small pleats on the top and the skirt has a metallic sheen to it. But it laid so nicely and I got compliments on it the entire night!

This dress is so flattering, so fun, and so stunning in person!  I had ordered the 4R which fit snug but well, and the zipper began to separate when I tried it on. I was bummed because it was a much better fit than the 6R. I ended up wearing the 6R to the formal wedding I attended. It had more fabric to it, but was certainly comfortable. The straps were a little long, and there was some gapping in the chest, but all in all the dress looked great. The fabric is super thick, on top and on bottom, and you do not need to wear a bra with it. The dress comes quite low in the front, and you may want some double sided tape for the top, but it's not necessary. I got so many compliments on it throughout the night, and the pockets were great for keeping my phone and lipgloss. I would wear this dress again and again if I could. Favorite rental from RTR yet!

comfortable, elegant, & sexy. perfect for a summer wedding, indoors or outdoors. Many compliments! This dress made me feel beautiful from the moment I tried it on. I was worried because I initially I thought it felt too elegant to wear to an outdoor lakeside wedding. I was wrong, it was perfect. The material on both the top and bottom is top quality. The top: ran a bit big; was perfect without a bra for a smaller bust but would have been perfect on a larger bust; wish I went with the previous reviews and wore double sided tape to keep the material in place. The skirt: a beautiful thick fabric that would keep you warm in wintertime but felt weightless in summertime; had a subtle shimmer that was classic; and had pockets! I am still getting compliments on this dress and would recommend it to everyone for a semiformal to formal event.

I LOVED this dress and received a crazy amount of compliments throughout the night. Fits true to size. I loved the pockets. It was nice to be able to go bra-less while still feeling supported even though it does have quite a plunging neckline.

worn to my brother's wedding... 6 months pregnant and first time in a formal dress! eek! this dress is AMAZING.  Definitely bump-friendly, but would totally recommend to those without a bump too!  so flattering on the chest, and a beautiful style and color... tons of compliments.  Would rent again without hesitation!  Would have likely been a 6R without my extra assets :)

Loved the dress, got many compliments! I run between a 4 and a 6, the 6 was too big up top and the 4 was a bit snug around the ribs, but it worked fine.  Just a little tape to keep everything in place.

Beautiful dress, very low The dress was made perfectly except for the fact that you hang out of the dress. Looking back, I should have bought clothing tape for the low neckline. If you don't mind "the girls" hanging loose, this is the dress for you. If you are a bit demure, pass on this dress.

I felt so glamorous in the dress and it was very flattering and comfortable. Tons of compliments!  I loved everything about this dress!! And it has pockets! It was perfect for the black tie event I attended.

I felt great in my dress, got to celebrate a couple I love and got some huge news! I loved this dress so much - it looks even more beautiful in person! My one complaint was that it wasn't supportive enough up top and you obviously can't wear a regular bra. I had read other reviews saying that it was tight enough to go bra-less, but I didn't feel comfortable without one, so I used cutlets and they showed in a lot of my pictures, even using double-sided tape. I'd say they can definitely work, but invest in some good double sided tape and not the main brand because it didn't do the trick for me. It definitely wouldn't stop me from renting it again - I got compliments all night :)

One of my favorite orders of all time! I wore this to a black tie wedding in Miami & it was a HUGE hit! The dress fits and moves beautifully, and the pockets are a major plus! If you don't have a full chest, I would suggest a size or two down, as there is still plenty of room in the hips and length.

I did not want to send this dress back! Omg I wished I could keep this dress forever! It was so comfortable and looked so perfect! I ended up wearing the 2R even though I'm usually a 4 because the straps fit better. It was perfect for a black tie optional wedding, I got tons of compliments, and it has pockets! Loooooooove this dress!

Beautiful Houston Wedding  Loved this dress! I received compliments all night long. I typically wear a 4 or a 6, and I ended up wearing the 4. I have a very small bust, and the top of the 6 was huge. I still had to pin the 4 for it to work, the straps are insanely long, but you can safety pin them.

Perfect Ensemble I've always been happy with my rentals from RTR, but this dress (and Mystery Bling - gorgeous Kate Spade statement necklace) was as perfect as I could have wished for! The design is unique and it was SO COMFORTABLE! I got tons of compliments at the gala we attended. I'm usually somewhere between a 4 and a 6 (mostly due to my hips), but with the A-line cut of the skirt, the 4L was the ideal size. I'm 5'9" and wore 4-inch heels and the length was perfect. I'm a 34C and was never in danger of falling out of the top, but at times wished I had used a little bit of double-stick tape. I would rent this dress over & over & over again. 100% recommend!

Beautiful dress. I got so many compliments.  I normally wear a 0R, but I was invited to a last minute black tie event and my size wasn't available on one day's notice so I had to go with a 0L, which was fine with a pair of 5" heels.  Overall it was a great dress. Comfortable and fun, yet sophisticated.  I got a ton of compliments. I loved everything about it, especially the pockets - fantastic! I will definitely rent this one again.

I want to get married in this dress! (Tape needed!) I've never felt so pretty in a dress. The skirt has a beautiful amount of weight to it that makes for a flattering, somewhat dramatic drape without being hot or cumbersome. I had to invent some new techniques for rigging as far as medical tape and double sided tape go- but I'm a DD and I made it work and was comfortable. Definitely showing serious cleavage, but it stayed where it needed to.

Perfect for the occasion I absolutely loved this dress. I was a little nervous about how low cut it is, but I got used to is and received tons of compliments. I put in sticky cups on the inside and they worked perfectly, you definitely cannot wear a bra so this was a good alternative.  I am 5'2" and the regular length was perfect, I was nervous about that because of the reviews. I wore 4 inch heels and it was above the ground and after awhile i put on flip flops and it barely dragged.
Elegant and beautiful So many compliments all night. Gorgeous dress. Straps were a little loose, but otherwise fit was great. I am 5'5", 118lbs and I wore a 2R.

Staple Piece I was obsessed with this Elizabeth & James style. The cut-out and the slit were to die for. This look was extremely flattering, however, I definitely had to size up because it runs pretty small. Overall, it was great to wear for a night out in NYC with my friends.
This dress was a show stopper. Seriously, people couldn't get over it. And neither could I.  I have big hips and a small waist, and this really accentuated that. Fit like a glove. Breathable.

Sexy but classy!  I loved the side slit and the black and white was eye catching. I worn in Vegas for a night out. It was a little big on my 5'2'' 115 lbs. frame but it wasn't too bad.  The slit was sexy. It's a midi length on shorties like me but I was okay with that, much shorter and that slit would have been unseemly!

Felt sophisticated and sexy I wore this dress for a rehearsal dinner.  I feel most comfortable in thick dresses that fit the shape of my body.  This dress was exactly that.  Hits just below the knee (for my height) and was sexy in a classy way.    Definitely go one size up- the white part of the dress shows any bumps or lines and you do not want it to be too too tight.

I wore this to a Bond-themed party and it was perfect. The dress is incredibly tight, so be careful to go a size up or wear seamless underwear.  Otherwise, the dress is very comfortable and the slit is sexy without being so high that it risks scandalous flashing.
Loved this dress! Very fitted, but enough stretch.

THIS DRESS IS EVERYTHING! I rented this dress for my birthday party and it was absolutely perfect. Sexy, yet still classy. Such a great dress to wear your hair up with and have a great time in. It fits snug, so I would size up for your backup size. It's very comfortable and you can still wear a nude, strapless bra :)
Edgy but classy!  This was great for a more formal holiday party. The dress definitely runs small so size up one size. If you're looking for something that borders unique and classic this is it.
Dress fit like a glove. Classy but sexy. Loved it, would definitely rent again.  Dress was a tight fit but very comfortable soft material.

In LOVE.. didn't want to return it! Wore this for my college graduation in December. Material was thick & I was able to wear a strapless bra with it. I am 5' 3'', 34B, & size 27-28 waist. I ordered a 4 & 6, but ended up wearing the 4. I will definitely order again!
ENGAGEMENT PARTY I wore this dress to my engagement party. I have never ever loved a dress more than I loved this one! I got so many compliments and I truly felt a million dollars!

Different The coloring and tight fit of this dress make it a real show-stopper. It's very snug and not too forgiving through the midsection, though. I did not need to wear a bra- I think a strapless would make it look bumpy, particularly on the white half of the dress.

Stunning for a winter wedding Usually a size, 4 but decided to wear the 6, so I would have extra room for dancing and dinner. Classic and modern that will look best on an hourglass figure. Loved this dress and got lots of compliments. Came to just below knee length which added an extra touch of elegance and class.

I had an amazing time at my friend's wedding!  I absolutely loved this dress and felt so amazing in it! I got so many compliments. It definitely runs small. I usually wear a 0 or 2, but I ordered a 4 and 6. The 4 ended up fitting perfectly.

Perfect fitted, sexy and classy dress! Perfect fitted, sexy and classy dress. Wore it to a black tie event (didn't want to wear a gown) with my boyfriend and his family. It looked beautiful. I got compliments from many people.
I will rent this again in a heart beat or buy it when it becomes a sale item :)
Comfortable enough to dance the whole night. It was a great dress! It fit like a glove. Received a lot of compliments. Highly recommend it.

"Hello" was replaced with "WOW" all night If you're looking for a gasping reaction, you've found your dress. I wore this for "the biggest party" in my city that is put on every year by a hospital group. It's at the race track so the black and white contrast was ultra fitting, although it's a bit more cream than white. This thing is form-fitting but not uncomfortably. I was worried my extra skin would bulge out the side of the dress where the small cut is but I didn't have that issue. It might be worse if you were sitting down, though. I used some fashion tape to adjust the location of the slit because of my small tattoo on my ribs. I also used fashion tape to keep the slit hugging my leg - just in case. The fabric is nice and thick. I would totally rent this dress again. Everyone I walked up to gasped with "WOW" before they even said hello.
I felt sexy yet the cut was classic and understated. Fit like a glove on me.  I would buy it, but like to wear something different to parties.
Stylish & Comfortable I wore this for my bachelorette party. It fit great and was very comfortable. Sexy yet not too revealing. Tons of compliments.

Stylist Review This dress is great for a fun night out. I love the seductive slit and cut out as well as the color blocking in the dress design. I however recommend going up a size or 2 as the fit is extremely tight.

I am a size 0 normally and 32a bust and felt a 2 would have been a better fit.
Great dinner date dress. Form fitting, elegant, sexy and very tasteful.

very sexy Pros: slimming
Cons: the white part of the dress appeared yellow-ey

This dress was great for my husband's company holiday party! I felt sexy and sophisticated. This dress definitely runs small- order one size up, at least. I normally wear an 8 and even the 10 was a bit too tight, but the 12 was too big. With the dress being tight, I felt comfortable enough to wear without a bra (I'm a 34D)- which was a good thing because you can't really wear a bra with this dress. The bottom of it will show where the cutout is. If you use a stick-on bra or nipple pasties, be sure that they fit well and are seamless because the white part of the dress is very unforgiving of whats underneath! Also, being 6 feet tall, I was tugging down the dress quite a bit because the darts just didn't hit me at the right places. May not be the best choice for a very tall woman. But it was cute enough to be worth all that :)

Super sexy dress that will give you an amazing silhouette. This is probably my favorite dress I've ever rented. The fits beautifully and the cutout at the side and the slit gives it a very sexy look. The high neck keeps it from feeling too revealing. (However if you're tall, the slit will come up dangerously high on your leg, so you'll need to sit carefully.) I paired the dress with silver flats and a cropped black blazer to dress it down. 

It does run small - I usually wear a 2 or a 4, and ended up wearing the 4. It fit like a glove (without much breathing room) so definitely size up.

Bachelorette party in NYC. As mentioned by others, the dress does run small so order a larger size. The dress is very flattering. I'm a thick women and this dress made me feel sexy. It isn't too revealing but hugs your body well. I would definitely recommend to everyone!
Unique and fun! This dress fit like a glove and was super comfortable- got compliments all night!
Great dress! I thought the 2 was a little snug but I still loved it! It looked great paired with my marigold pashmina.

Just the right amount of classy & sexy! I loved this dress! It was very snug, but still comfortable. I received tons of compliments on it! The hardest part was finding undergarments that would stay hidden.

I wore this for a jazz gig and it was the perfect fit and style for the show It fit very well and the material was thick enough to smooth everything out. It looked great on stage and I got so many compliments afterward!  I would definitely purchase this dress and I recommend this brand to anyone with an hourglass shape

Classy with a fun twist! This dress is super flattering. The white breaks up the black to give the look of curves but is still slimming. Nice material so I felt like I was held in well. You can easily wear a strapless bra with it too. I am usually a size 4/6 in dresses, but after reading reviews to size up I ordered a 6 with an 8 as a backup. While the 6 zipped up and fit, the 8 just seemed to look better. I received lots of compliments all night. And it's totally dancing friendly :).

Great dress - felt classy, but was still sexy. Got lots of compliments.  After reading the reviews, I am glad I got the extra size up - I normally am always an 8, but felt more comfortable and looked better in the 10. Sturdy material (the white is not see-through) and very comfortable. Would definitely recommend this for multiple occasions as it can be dressed up for a wedding or dressed more fun and casual.

Having a fun night with my love I ordered a 6 and an 8 and went with the 8.  The 6 was too snug across my chest, but I normally wear a 6, and dont have any size 8s in my closet! The dress has a bit of give so its comfortable in that way.  I felt the zipper was uncomfortable all night and it didnt lay flat on me.  I'm thinking this might be because I have a round butt, but not sure.  The dress was sexy, fun, and my husband loved it.

Unique dress, received lots of compliments  Definitely a fitted dress. I usually wear a 0 or 2, and I felt more comfortable in the 2.  The slit came up pretty high on the thigh, especially when you sit, but with the longer length, it was ok. I really liked this dress with simple pearl stud earrings and black heels.

Loved this dress! Overall, I loved this dress. I got a TON of compliments in it and really felt like a show stopper. It runs small, so I would recommend going a size up. I'm 6'2" (plus I was in 3" heels) and I was nervous about the overall length of the dress and the slit being too high, but I never felt exposed or inappropriate. The cut out on the size was close to my traditional bra line, but I was still able to wear a strapless by pushing the band up higher on my side (although the fabric is thick enough, some women probably wouldn't need a bra).
Great statement dress for a fun night out!

Fun dress! True to what other people have said, this dress runs small. I generally wear a size 2, but I wore a 6 in this. The 4 fit, but it didn't look as good as the roomier 6. I'm not usually one that wears form-fitting dresses, but I really loved this one. The material is thick, which makes it feel less revealing. Overall, I loved it. I took one star off because the slit is a little high when sitting, and I had to cover it with the wedding program. Also, while the dresses I received were still in good condition, they've obviously been worn quite a bit. The white is starting to fade and the seeming was beginning to pull.

Sexy, elegant and classy. Absolutely loved! Would definitely order again I never thought I'd wear any tight form fitting dress because I never thought I'd have the curves to fit one, but this dress made me feel differently. I felt sexy and classy, and I received so many compliments. I would definitely order this dress again! Lady Gaga, Tony Bennett, Paul McCartney, John Travolta, Bruce Willis, Stevie Wonder, and other celebrates were at the event I went to and I felt like I belonged and It was all because of this dress!
Great dress to dress up in!  Runs small so definitely order up one size.  Could have worn the 4 but was way more comfortable in the 6.  Length is past knees so plan for a higher heel.
Fit phenomenally well.  Loved it so much I bought it!

Loved this! Fits really well. Think fabric. The slit is definitely high but with the long length I thought it was completely appropriate. The top is a smidge looser than the bottom. Overall loved this and wish I owned - it would be a great staple.

Walking Confidence. Perfection. Eye-catching, sexy dress. I definitely worked out a little harder and was very nutrition conscious all week because as the reviews state, the dress has no give. Fit like a glove though! I will say the dress is for standing. It has such a high slit you have to be careful when sitting down. Perhaps a shawl or something to put over your lap would be a good idea if you're attending a dinner or something. I found I did not need a bra since it was so fitted, which was nice. Extremely good, expensive fabric and well designed dress. Rent it and feel fabulous.
Loved this dress.  Sexy and classic at the same time. Be sure to size up. I usually wear a 0, but wore the 2 in this dress. If I had any booty at all, I would have worn the 4.
Such a great fit! Dress hugged all the right curves and with the color-block, it works for so many body types! I felt comfortable and for an NYE event, it was long enough that I didn't need tights.

Definite show stopper! The subtle cutout is what made this dress pop! Fits snug, I felt like it was made for my body, but in the best "tight-and-right" way possible. The slit is just high enough that it caught the attention of my husband, but I could keep it semi-professional enough at a work event. I ended up wearing no bra, because the lines would have been obvious with how snug this was, but i felt comfortable regardless. If you're not ready to receive a TON of comments and compliments, dont wear it! This is one of my favorite rentals so far!

So flattering for my curvy figure!  I wore this dress for my 30th birthday party. It sucked me in all the right places and complimented my curves. I have pretty wide hips so I was nervous about wearing something so tight, but it looked great. I received so many compliments. I had originally ordered a size 12 as my main size and a 10 as a backup, but the 10 looked much better to my surprise. I also didn't need a bra, which was great because I wore the dress for over 8 hours. It was super comfortable!

Perfect dress for a night out in Vegas! This dress runs small- I typically wear a size 6, but I ended up wearing the size 8.  The dress was SO comfortable and stayed in place nicely - though the leg slit is somewhat high I never had an issue with it, even when sitting down.  The material is nice and thick so I didn't have to worry about underwear lines; I did, however, end up wearing adhesive silicone cups because the cutout on the side did not allow for a strapless bra.  I loved this dress- highly recommend!

Classy and Sexy in One Classy and Sexy in one!
 I was worried because my backup size wasn’t available.  I am usually a true size 10, per the reviews, I went for the size 12 and crossed my fingers.  The reviews were right!  I’ve learned that the Elizabeth and James line runs small.  It was form fitting, but the thick material made it super forgiving and kept everything in all the right places.  Overall it was very comfortable, including the bit of side skin that’s perfectly sized for a flattering cutout.  It actually hits at just the right place and is the right size to show a little bit of skin, but not too much.  The best part was that I was able to wear my favorite bra with regular back.  Because the neckline is high, I wore a simple bracelet, and earrings, but no necklace is needed.  The cutout is definitely the “accessory” and offers that “wow factor.”  I really like the longer length, as it allowed me to wear high heels.  The slit definitely adds some sex appeal to this classy dress.  It’s a matter of how you wear it, in my opinion.
 Ps: I loved the simple gold zipper down my back… this also made my butt look great!  Two greats in one dress… Classy and Sexy!  I’m a happy customer.
Did not wear, definitely size up! Would have been perfect in a bigger size, fabric is a great weight.

Definitely a showstopper!!  I wore this dress to a 10 year wedding anniversary event. The theme was black, white or black and white and this dress represented both. This dress was so classy, yet just the right amount of sexy. I reserved both 6p and 8p based on the reviews and wore the 6p. It fit perfectly. I did not need to wear a bra, only breast petals. I received so many compliments (especially from my husband) and was definitely the best dressed. This dress pushed me out of my comfort zone and I am so glad that I did. I said "yes to the dress!"  This was my first RTR purchase and it definitely won't be my last. The dresses arrived early afternoon on a Friday, which definitely provided ample time in the event I needed a last minute dress change option. I loved the overall presentation of the garment bag and the note inside. Thank you RTR for making this experience so smooth. I'm already planning to reserve another dress for an event in July!

I wore this dress to a formal alumni event at my college. It was a hit! I was worried about bulging out of the small slit on the side of the dress but I was pleasantly surprised! It is very form fitting and the slit is the perfect height. The color is not as white as it seems in the picture, it is more of an off-white. I got many compliments on this dress and wish I could have kept it for myself!

Beautiful, sexy but classy dress!  I wanted to keep it! I got so many compliments. I rented the 0 and 2 and wore the 0 because the 2 puckered above the butt. The only thing is when the 0 was on the zipper split while putting it on after I tried it on a few times!!! It was fine all night until the end of the night when it split again but it was fine when I took it off and zipped it up again. I would totally wear it again and take the risk. It's SO beautiful and fits like a glove but is stretchy and comfortable!

SIZE UP! Super cute dress but make sure you size up.  It runs very tight.  I ordered a 6 (I'm typically a 4 in dresses) and I should have ordered up even more.  Super cute dress though that has nice and thick fabric so you don't have to wear a bra.

Get a size lower than your usual. 5'9" and 165 lbs, I'm typically a size 10.  I'm wearing a 12 in the photo, which fit snugly but fine. I also found that a racer back bra worked perfectly without showing. Aggressive slip, but still workable. I didn't wear this dress to my event, so not sure how it works while sitting.  The light side is more grey than pure white. I thought I would hate that, but didn't. It looked unique instead of dirty.  Main reason I didn't wear it was the light side showed off my not flat stomach too much. I couldn't deal. Overall an amazing dress for someone else. :)

First time rental. This dress is a stunner - I received tons of compliments! Snug for sure, but the 2 fit perfectly as the fabric is a little heavier and has some stretch. After reading previous reviews, I was worried because most advised to size up and the 4 was unavailable but at 5'4", ~115lbs, athletic build, this fit like a glove. Comfortable both sitting & standing for 6+ hours. I didn't want to take it off! I would definitely rent again.

Super sexy, yet classy dress! It made me feel like a million bucks!   It runs true to size and I'm used to dresses running larger.  I wear a 4/6 and wore a 2 in this dress.  It was a little snug and I actually couldve gone one size up. I absoluvely loved it nonetheless.

LOVED! The perfect blend of sophistication and sexy. I wore this to an outdoor wedding in July and loved it. The fit was great, and the little cut outs weren't too revealing. The material was thick enough that I didn't have to wear a bra just with it, just some stickies. Definitely recommend giving this a try.

Insane dress Took everyone's advice and sized up -- it was necessary. My hips are a bit wide for my size and even still, the 4 was tight. That said, this dress made me feel so sexy even with the waist cut out--and I don't have a flat stomach. I did had to move it around to cover up any "rolls" but I don't think anyone but me noticed! I got compliments all night long. I think this dress looks good on any body types--straight and narrow or curvy. Wish I owned!

The dress itself was very well fitted, and the slit made it sexy without being too much. I normally always wear a size 0, however in this case I wish a size 2 was available because the dress is tight and does not have a lot of stretch to it.  You can make 0 work but on the safe side, I would go with a 2.
LOVED THIS DRESS!!!  Trendy but not scandalous! Fit like a glove and super comfortable.

Sleek and sophisticated  Rented this dress as a backup for my high school reunion, and even though I thought the cutout, high slit, and tight fit might be too risky, I felt so hot in this dress that I went for it! Got so many compliments, and felt both glam and comfortable. I am between a 0/2 and the 4 was just right so size up.
fit like a glove great material, form fitting but not too tight, really beautiful, wore to a black tie wedding - lots of compliments!
